Name: Adventure Island
Description: Adventure Island is an outdoor water park in Tampa featuring thrill rides, a wave pool, and a lazy river. The facility offers restrooms, on-site dining and bar service, picnic areas, shaded seating, locker and cabana rentals, Wi-Fi, and party services. Wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms are available, with free parking and multiple payment options accepted. The venue provides active-military discounts, live performances, and is designated as LGBTQ+ friendly and a transgender safe space. Advance ticket purchase is recommended.

Name: Adventure Reef Water Park
Description: Adventure Reef is a 3-acre outdoor water park in Kettering that operates from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day, with the 2026 season opening May 23rd. The facility features Montgomery County's tallest and fastest water slides, a splash pad, and a large interactive water playground with ample deck seating. Daily admission includes discounted rates after 4 p.m., and season passes are available. The park has restrooms, locker rooms, onsite lockers, a first aid station, picnic areas, and permits small coolers; a pool lift is available upon request for accessibility.

Name: Alma Aquatic Park
Description: Alma Aquatic Center is a large outdoor water facility located within Alma City Park, featuring six slides, a diving board, climbing wall, and a main swimming pool alongside a shallow zero-to-three-foot beach-entry pool and covered wading area. The park also includes a water play zone and on-site snack bar serving food and drinks. The grounds incorporate picnic areas, playgrounds, pavilions, and walking trails, with certified lifeguards on duty throughout operating hours. Pavilion rentals are available during regular hours in two-hour increments, and private event rentals can be arranged outside standard operating times.

Name: American Dream
Description: American Dream is an amusement park with water attractions in East Rutherford, New Jersey. It is a paid facility. On-site amenities include restrooms, an arcade, picnic areas, an adjacent playground, and Wi-Fi. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. The venue provides paid parking and accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments. It is open daily.

The facility includes a toddler interactive area and is located within Camelback Resort in Tannersville, Pennsylvania. Guests can access poolside shops, restaurants, VIP seating, private cabanas, and an adjacent two-level arcade with video games and virtual reality experiences.

Name: Asbury Splash Park
Description: Asbury Splash Park sits on the Asbury Park boardwalk and features water spray elements ranging from gentle to vigorous, including a tipping teacup attraction, designed for children ages 18 months through 12 years. The fenced park operates Saturdays and Sundays from 10am to 7pm starting May 30 through the summer school break. Admission is $15 for children 15 and under, $8 for adults, or $42 for a family pass covering two adults and two children. The venue offers group rates for 10+ children, birthday party packages with private deck rental and party privileges, and is steps away from the beach and other boardwalk activities.

Name: Atlantis Waterpark at Bull Run
Description: Atlantis Waterpark sits within Bull Run Regional Park and features two waterslides—a 230-foot open slide and a 170-foot enclosed slide—along with a main swimming pool, baby pool, and a sand play area. The park's signature attraction is a 500-gallon dumping bucket that anchors an interactive water play structure with covered and open slides, water cannons, and sprayers. Admission is free, and the facility includes a snack bar called Neptune's Reef with outdoor seating under shade umbrellas, plus restrooms and picnic areas throughout the grounds.

Name: Bahama Beach Waterpark
Description: Bahama Beach Waterpark sits just south of downtown Dallas and features a mix of water slides and play areas for different ages and thrill levels. Attractions include 45-foot enclosed tube slides (Riptide Slide and Bahama Bullet), a body slide trio (Bermuda Triangle), a boomerang slide, a lazy river with two zero-depth entry beaches, an interactive rain fortress playground with a 1,000-gallon dumping bucket (Coconut Cove), a 300-foot mat racing slide (Tortuga Express), and a shallow splash pad for young children (Lil Paco's Splash Pad). The park offers shaded seating areas, picnic spaces, reservable private cabanas, restrooms, a concession stand with food and drink options, and a gift shop. Open Saturdays 10:30 AM–6 PM and Sundays 12–6 PM with paid admission.

The facility maintains a tropical environment year-round at 80 degrees with glass walls and ceiling for natural light. Additional amenities include a swim-up bar for adults, private cabanas, and dining options on-site. Day passes are available, and the park is open 10 AM–8 PM Sunday through Thursday, extending to 9 PM on Friday and Saturday.

The park includes a splash pad area and waterslides (with a 48-inch minimum height requirement), along with restrooms, picnic areas, and a designated adults-only deck. An on-site concession area and changing facilities support visitors, and season passes can be purchased at the nearby Deer Grove Leisure Center.

Daily hours run noon to 7 PM Monday through Saturday, with Sunday hours beginning at 1 PM. Admission costs $12 for adults (14+) and $9 for youth (13 and under), with season pass memberships available; cabana rentals are also offered. The facility requires adult supervision for children 13 and younger and mandates swim diapers for non-potty-trained visitors, while outside food is prohibited unless a $10 cooler fee is paid.

Description: Camelbeach Outdoor Waterpark at Camelback Resort in Tannersville is Pennsylvania's largest outdoor water park, featuring 37 rides and slides including attractions like Rival Racer and High Noon Typhoon, plus a lazy river and toddler interactive area. The park operates seasonally during summer and offers day tickets and season passes purchased online, along with amenities including poolside shops, restaurants, picnic areas, restrooms, and rental options for strollers, wheelchairs, picnic tables, and lockers. The resort also features Aquatopia Indoor Waterpark with 13 additional slides and a wave pool operating year-round, plus VIP seating, private cabanas, and arcade games available to enhance visits.

Name: Canyon Springs Waterpark
Description: Canyon Springs Waterpark is a Christian-themed water park in Weatherford, Texas, featuring slides, a wave pool, and a lazy river. The facility includes a snack bar for refreshments and provides wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. Picnic areas are available on-site, and admission is charged to enter.

Name: Catapult Adventure Park St. Pete
Description: Catapult Adventure Park St. Pete is an amusement park with water attractions in St. Petersburg, Florida. On-site amenities include restrooms and picnic areas. It is open daily.

Name: Chesapeake Beach Water Park
Description: Chesapeake Beach Water Park in Chesapeake Beach, Maryland is a family-friendly water park offering pools, slides, waterfalls, and a lazy river. Admission is free, and the facility provides complimentary parking, restrooms, food service, picnic areas, and lockers. Private cabana rentals and party services are available, and the venue accepts credit cards and debit cards.

Name: City of Gaithersburg Water Park at Bohrer Park
Description: City of Gaithersburg Water Park at Bohrer Park is an outdoor swimming facility featuring a deep-lane pool and shallow play area with a 250-foot double waterslide. The park provides wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking, along with on-site restrooms and picnic areas for visitors.

Name: Classic Waterslides
Description: Classic Waterslides in Riverdale operates as a water park open Monday through Saturday from 11 AM to 5 PM, with admission at $12.95 per person ages 3 and up and free entry for children under 3 (who must wear swim diapers and waterproof covers). The facility features waterslides and offers shaded cabanas available for hourly rental, a snack bar with frozen treats starting at $1, and accommodations for private parties. Children under 3 must comply with swim diaper requirements; outside food and beverages are prohibited except for cake and water.

The venue offers picnic areas, barbecue grills, a playground, and a dog park, along with restrooms and wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking. Free parking is available, and the park accepts credit and debit cards. It is open daily.

Name: Cobblestones Water Park
Description: Cobblestones Water Park in Glen Allen operates a large concrete swimming pool and is open Tuesday through Sunday, 10 AM to 5:30 PM, with seasonal variations (weekends only from late August through Labor Day). The facility charges $85 per person for season passes (reduced to $40 after mid-July) and offers group rates of $13 per person for parties of 15 or more on weekdays. An event deck with six rentable sections is available for private celebrations, and the park includes restrooms and picnic areas. Originally established in the 1950s as Overhill Lake, the park was rebranded and renovated in 2005.

Wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms are available, and active-military discounts are provided. Advance ticket purchase is recommended for this paid facility.

Description: Coral Cove Water Park in Carol Stream features body slides, a splash pad with spray play structures, a zero-depth entry pool, a diving board, and a dry playground area. The park operates Saturdays and Sundays from noon to 5 PM during the season and welcomes groups, birthday parties, and private rentals. Winfield residents can purchase discounted season and daily passes, with season passes available at local recreation centers. Facilities include picnic areas and restrooms.

The facility offers on-site dining and a bar, along with amenities including restrooms, lockers, cabana rentals, and picnic areas. Wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking are available at no charge, and the park accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments. Advance ticket purchase is recommended, and the venue hosts live performances and offers party services.

Name: Cowabunga Canyon Waterpark
Description: Cowabunga Canyon is a water park located at 7055 S Fort Apache Road in Las Vegas that operates seasonally from May through April. The facility offers season passes for $114.99 that provide unlimited visits during the 2026 summer season, free parking, discounted food and merchandise, and priority entrance. The park features picnic areas, restrooms, and on-site amenities including food service and retail shops. Individual day tickets are also available for purchase through the park's website.

Description: Cranberry Township Community Waterpark features two splash pads—one designed for toddlers and another for older children—along with a range of additional aquatic amenities including a diving board, water slide, climbing wall, and dump bucket. The facility operates within North Boundary Park and includes eight 25-meter lap lanes, a wading pool area, lounge chairs, a sun deck, and access to picnic tables and umbrellas. Beyond water play, the park provides a playground, sand volleyball court, concession stand, and restrooms, with the broader park also offering hiking trails and a disc golf course.

Name: Crestwood Aquatic Center
Description: Crestwood Aquatic Center, located in Whitecliff Park, operates as a membership-based facility featuring a 25-yard by 25-meter lap pool with diving boards, a large flume slide, climbing wall, family play pool with three slides and interactive features, lazy river, lily pad challenge obstacle course, and zero-depth beach entry. Daily admission starts at $8 for residents and $14 for nonresidents (half price after 4:30 p.m.), with season passes available for individuals and families; children under 3 are free. The facility includes restrooms and a concession stand, with family changing rooms available on-site.

Name: Crystal Beach Waterpark
Description: Crystal Beach Waterpark in Woodward, Oklahoma is an all-ages water park with pools and slides. The facility provides restrooms, food service, and picnic areas, along with an adjacent playground for additional recreation. Wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking are available, and the venue accepts credit and debit cards. Party services are offered, and the park operates daily.

Name: Crystal Springs Family Waterpark
Description: Crystal Springs Family Waterpark in East Brunswick is New Jersey's first municipal waterpark, featuring an activity pool, family pool, kiddie pool, lap pool, lazy river, recreational pool, spray park, and water slides. The facility operates weekends only until June 29, then daily throughout the season, with paid admission and height requirements (visitors over 48 inches can access most areas). Amenities include a concession stand, available life jackets, accessible facilities meeting ADA standards, and picnic areas within the larger East Brunswick parks system. The park is smoke-free, alcohol-free, and glass-free, with lifeguards certified through StarGuard ELITE.

Name: DelGrosso’s Amusement Park and Laguna Splash Water Park
Description: DelGrosso's Amusement Park includes Laguna Splash Water Park, an Italian-themed water facility featuring a lazy river, wave pool, children's play area, water slides, and interactive water structures. The water park operates seasonally as part of the larger amusement park complex in Tipton, Pennsylvania, with admission available through all-day fun passes, season passes at multiple tiers, or as an add-on to ride-only tickets. The facility offers picnic areas, restrooms, and catering options including birthday party packages. Admission pricing includes all-day passes, school group rates, and season pass tiers ranging from $85 to $125.

Description: Dorney Park & Wildwater Kingdom combines an amusement park with Wildwater Kingdom, a major waterpark complex in Allentown, Pennsylvania. The facility features over 60 rides and attractions throughout the park, plus one of the largest waterparks in the Northeast, along with themed areas like Planet Snoopy for younger children. Admission is paid; the park offers season passes and special pre-K passes for young children. The venue operates seasonally and includes typical park amenities such as restrooms, picnic areas, food concessions, and entertainment options.

Name: DreamWorks Water Park
Description: DreamWorks Water Park is an indoor water park in East Rutherford, New Jersey, featuring a wave pool, lazy river, and waterslides alongside movie-themed attractions for children. The facility offers on-site dining, mini golf, an arcade, lockers, and cabana rentals, with amenities including restrooms, picnic areas, Wi-Fi, and an adjacent playground. Wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking are available at no charge, and the venue accepts multiple payment methods and offers active-military discounts. Advance ticket purchase is recommended, and the park operates daily with live performances and party services available.

Description: Enchanted Island is a children's amusement park located within Phoenix's Encanto Park, featuring eleven rides designed for younger children aged 1 to 10, including a historic carousel, pedal boats, bumper boats, a climbing wall, and a parachute tower. The park operates Wednesday and Friday 11am–4pm, Saturday 10am–8pm, and Sunday 12–8pm, with free admission and ride-specific ticketing or wristband options (unlimited ride wristbands normally $28.50). Amenities include shaded picnic areas, restrooms, a splash zone for all ages, and a gift shop; outside food and beverages are not permitted. The 7.5-acre venue accommodates private events such as birthday parties and corporate picnics and is located on Encanto Boulevard west of 7th Avenue in central Phoenix.

The facility operates most days from 6am–7pm (closed Tuesdays), with weekend hours 10am–6pm, and charges $14 for children ages 3–15 and $19 for adults, with discounts available for group visits and multi-visit punch cards. Beyond water attractions, the venue includes two hot tubs, sauna, steam room, and fitness facilities, plus food service and a gift shop on-site. Note that during September through March, competitive swim team practices limit public pool access on certain weekday afternoons.

The park offers free admission and operates Thursday through Sunday from 10 AM to 4 PM, with restrooms, water fountains, and the year-round Dish & Spoon Café serving food and beverages throughout the grounds.

Description: Fantasy Lake Adventure Park in Wake Forest operates a dedicated water park section with an inflatable water park, kayaking, and paddle boarding activities available in four daily sessions. The venue includes a splash pad for children ages 4 and under, a kids zone for ages 1-4, and waterfront cabana rentals, along with chair and umbrella rentals at picnic areas. Water park sessions run Monday–Friday 11:30am–6:30pm and Saturday–Sunday 9am–6:30pm, with all passes sold online only and advance waivers required. On-site amenities feature lockers, lifeguards, changing facilities, restrooms, and concessions offering snacks and drinks.

Name: Fins Up Water Park - Seasonal
Description: Fins Up Water Park operates seasonally at Margaritaville at Lanier Islands in Buford, opening in May each year. The facility features 13 waterslides, a wave pool, and a dedicated children's area, with daily admission at $59.99 for general admission, $44.99 for children ages 4–7 and seniors, and free entry for children under 3. A $20 parking fee applies to all vehicles, though season pass holders park free; discounted tickets are available for military, first responders, healthcare workers, and educators with valid identification. The park includes access to nearby LandShark Landing at no additional charge and offers online booking discounts.

Name: Fondy Aqua Park
Description: Fondy Aqua Park features three 90-foot inflatable waterslides, an inflatable obstacle course with climbs and jumps, dueling ziplines, and watercraft rentals including paddle boards and kayaks. The facility offers a sandy beach with shallow water play area, a shaded picnic zone, and fishing in a designated area. Admission options include an Open Water Pass covering most attractions and watercraft rentals, as well as an all-day pass that combines access to the aqua park with the adjacent Fondy Sports Park; children under 54 inches receive a $10 discount.

Name: Frankenmuth Jaycee Spray Park
Description: Frankenmuth Jaycee Spray Park is a water play area in Frankenmuth, Michigan. On-site amenities include restrooms and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It is open daily.

Name: Frog Falls Aquatic Park
Description: Frog Falls Aquatic Park in Dover, New Jersey operates daily from 11 AM to 7 PM and welcomes families, kids, and toddlers. Access requires membership through an online registration process and a photo ID badge picked up in person at the Picatinny Visitor Center. The facility operates under Department of Defense water safety policies with a Certified Pool Operator on staff and includes a lightning early warning system for visitor protection.

Name: Funcity Adventure Park
Description: Fun City Adventure Park is an indoor play facility in Fort Wayne offering over 15 attractions including trampoline courts, a ropes course, ninja obstacle course, climbing wall, foam pit, arcade machines, and sports activities like basketball and dodgeball. Admission is priced by duration, with 1.5-hour sessions at $24 for general admission and $20 for toddlers (42" and under), or all-day passes available for $30 and $24 respectively; jump socks are required and cost $3.50. The facility operates daily with extended weekend hours, opening at 10 AM on Saturdays and Sundays, and stays open until 10 PM on Friday and Saturday evenings.

Name: Grand Bear Falls Indoor Waterpark
Description: Grand Bear Falls is a 24,000-square-foot indoor water park located in North Utica, Illinois, near I-80. The facility features a wave pool, lazy river with whirlpool, a slide tower with body and tube slides (48-inch height requirement), a kids' splash tower with kiddie pool and family slide, and a 15-person hot tub. Day passes are available, though they are unavailable most Saturdays, holidays, and high-season weeks to prioritize overnight resort guests. Amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, shade, and on-site dining via the Wave Cave concession area offering pizza, hot dogs, nachos, and beverages.

Name: Grand Bear Resort at Starved Rock
Description: Grand Bear Falls is a 24,000 square foot indoor water park located at the Grand Bear Resort in North Utica, featuring a wave pool, lazy river with whirlpool, slide tower with body and tube slides (48-inch height requirement), kids splash tower with kiddie pool and family slide, and a 15-person hot tub. The water park operates year-round with off-season hours Thursday through Sunday, though day passes are limited most Saturdays, holidays, and peak weeks to accommodate overnight resort guests. Water slides are unavailable when outdoor temperatures drop below 35 degrees. On-site dining is available at the Wave Cave, which serves pizza, hot dogs, nachos, and beverages, and outside food and beverages are not permitted.

Name: Great Waves Waterpark
Description: Great Waves Waterpark in Alexandria, Virginia features seven waterslides ranging from high-speed racing slides to slower twisting courses, plus a wave pool with tubes for guests to ride the surf. Young children have access to a dedicated kids zone and splash pad, while Paradise Play offers a beach-themed climbing and play structure with various interactive elements. The park also includes a wave pool, picnic areas, food service, and operates seasonally beginning Memorial Day weekend, with additional winter activities available mid-November through February. Paid admission applies, and the facility maintains on-site restrooms and offers rental cabanas for group gatherings.

Admission is free, and parking is available nearby at The Lofts at Headwaters Park garage with rates of $1 per hour (first 15 minutes free, $8 daily maximum). The facility operates seasonally with open swim sessions from May through September at varying weekend and weekday schedules, with admission ranging from $5 for members to $10 for non-members per session. Additional amenities include water basketball and volleyball courts, shaded umbrella seating, family changing areas, and an on-site snack bar; swimming lessons and water aerobics classes are also available.

Amenities include wheelchair-accessible entrances, restrooms, and free parking; advance ticket purchase is recommended. The venue provides active-military discounts, live performances, party services, and accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments.

Description: North Valleys Splash Park opens seasonally from Memorial Day through Labor Day at North Valleys Regional Park in Stead, Nevada, featuring an aviation-themed design with over 20 water features and 60 spray heads, including a replica of a restored 1940s military aircraft. Admission is $5 per person, with free entry for children under 2 and seniors 62 and older. The park operates from 10:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. weekends only until the Washoe County school summer break, then daily through Labor Day weekend. Three covered pavilions are available for rent, and outside food and umbrellas are permitted, though glass, alcohol, and pets are prohibited.

Description: Northacres Spraypark is a water play area in Seattle, Washington. Admission is free. On-site amenities include restrooms, an adjacent playground, and party services. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. The venue provides free parking.

Name: Northside Park Swimming Pool
Description:
Northside Park Swimming Pool is a water play area in Fort Wayne, Indiana. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking. It is open daily.

The Department offers 11 Splash Pads for your enjoyment.  

There is an activation bollard (green) that needs the top touched and the water will run for a 4-minute cycle. Simply touch the bollard again for more fun! The use of the Splash Pads is free!

Please note that dogs are not allowed within 100 feet of any Splash Pad. This is for the safety of park users.

Name: Oasis Water Park
Description: Oasis Water Park spans 7 acres at Arizona Grand Resort & Spa and features an 8-story slide tower with three slides (Free Fall, Roadrunner, and Sidewinder, requiring 48" height minimum), a zero-entry wave pool with 2-foot swells and depths from 1–5 feet, a 25-person heated hot tub called Caliente Springs, Wild Cat Springs with spray jets for younger children, and Zuni River, a side-by-side tubing river. Access is included with resort stays; day passes and cabana rentals are available for non-resort guests on select dates through ResortPass. On-site dining includes The Oasis Bar & Grill with food and beverages, plus additional resort pools (Sedona, Mountainside, Camelback, and an adults-only lap pool) open 6am–10pm daily.

Name: Ocean Dunes Waterpark
Description: Ocean Dunes Waterpark, situated within Upton Hill Regional Park in Arlington, operates as a free-admission water play venue with a 500-gallon dumping bucket, water slides (including an open 230-foot slide and a 170-foot enclosed slide), waterfalls, squirters, fountains, and tube slides centered around a zero-depth play structure. The main pool provides additional swimming and wading space, while a central feature includes platforms and interactive elements designed for both children and adults. The venue is staffed with licensed lifeguards and offers concessions, restrooms, and picnic areas for families, plus nearby attractions like mini golf and hiking trails within the regional park.

Name: Open Water Park
Description: Open Water Park is a water park in Seattle, Washington. On-site amenities include restrooms and picnic areas. It is open daily. The water play is designed for visitors of all ages.

Name: Otter Cove Aquatic Park
Description: Otter Cove Aquatic Park in St. Charles offers multiple swim options including open swim, lap swimming, and a dedicated splash park area during morning hours. Admission varies by program type and residency status, with children under 2 entering free and open swim ranging from $13 to $18. The facility accommodates group visits of 10 or more with discounted rates, and residents can reserve sessions in advance by providing proof of residency at each visit. Lap swim, twilight swim, and splash park hours are available throughout the season.

Name: Otter Cove Splash Park
Description: Otter Cove Splash Park in St. Charles is a public aquatic facility offering both open swim and dedicated splash park hours. Admission varies by residency status, with splash park access available during morning hours at $5 for residents and $7 for non-residents, while open swim sessions cost $13 for residents and $18 for non-residents. Children under 2 swim free, and group discounts apply for parties of 10 or more. The facility also offers lap swim and twilight swim options, with lap lanes available during most operating periods on a first-come, first-served basis.

Name: Otter Creek Waterpark
Description: Otter Creek Waterpark sits within Northside Park in Greenville and offers four water slides ranging from a kiddy slide to body slides and a tube slide exceeding 100 yards, with a 32-foot tall slide tower. The facility includes a 7,000-square-foot leisure pool with beach entry and back-side sprays, plus a dedicated 2,400-square-foot splash pad. Admission ranges from $11 to $14.50 depending on height and age, with free entry for children under 2, and the park provides shade structures, picnic areas, a concession stand, locker rentals, and party hut availability.

Name: Our Special Harbor Spray Park
Description: Our Special Harbor is a fully accessible spray park in Franconia Park with a Chesapeake Bay theme, featuring computerized water mazes, water buckets, and a spraying osprey nest. A quieter beach area with soft bubblers and interactive water tables serves younger children. Admission is free for walk-in visitors on a first-come, first-served basis, though group reservations of 10 or more are available for a fee ($7 for Fairfax County residents, $12 for non-residents). The facility operates during summer season with hours listed under Franconia Rec Center, and has a maximum capacity of 247 people.

Name: Palm Island Indoor Waterpark
Description: Palm Island Indoor Waterpark in Batavia features two body flumes, a splash area with interactive attractions, a heated spa maintained at 98.5 degrees, and a pool with a basketball hoop. The facility also includes a family arcade with a redemption center and plans to reopen a concession stand. Open Sundays from 10 AM to 1 PM and Saturdays from 10 AM to 7 PM with free admission, it offers restrooms, shade, and picnic areas for visitors.

The facility includes Hurricane Cove, a zero-depth leisure pool with fountains and spouts that also accommodates three slides (Pipeline, Sidewinder, and Wipeout), along with Gator Crossing water walk; Splashdown, a 12-foot dive well with diving boards and a drop slide; Dolphin Cove, an 8-lane lap pool; and Turtle Cove, a shallow zero-depth tot pool designed for children under 48 inches with its own small slide. Amenities include full-service concessions, locker rooms, swimming lessons, and special events throughout the summer, plus the park provides picnic areas and restrooms for visitors.

The park spans more than 400,000 gallons of water attractions and provides complimentary lounge chairs and inner tubes, along with amenities including party pavilions, cabana rentals, food service, and a gift shop. Day passes are available with pricing based on height and residency status, with discounts for seniors, military personnel, and children under 3 who enter free. The waterpark operates weekends only (Saturday and Sunday, 11 AM–6 PM), with weekday evening rates available after 4 PM during the operating season.

Name: Phillips Park Family Aquatic Center
Description: Located in Aurora at 828 Montgomery Road, Phillips Park Family Aquatic Center operates as a co-owned facility with the City of Aurora and offers multiple water slides including two drop-off slides, an enclosed twisting flume, and two winding body flumes, plus a zero-depth leisure pool. Young children can enjoy dedicated areas with spray guns, a waterfall, a small slide, and a dumping coconut tree feature. The facility provides a sand play area with seating and shade, lap-lane swimming during designated hours, and sand volleyball courts. A snack bar serves light refreshments, outside food is permitted (beverages must be factory-sealed), deck chairs are available, and online advance ticket purchase is recommended.

Name: Piedmont Park Aquatic Center
Description: Piedmont Park Aquatic Center is a public outdoor swimming facility in Atlanta featuring four lap lanes, beach entry with a current channel, and a recently renovated pool deck with accessible amenities and shade structures. The center operates seasonally from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day weekend, with general admission available daily and extended hours for season pass holders. The facility includes pool-level locker rooms, showers, and concessions, and operates on a cash-free system accepting credit cards and digital wallets. The adjacent Legacy Fountain Splash Pad offers free public access with over 70 jets reaching up to 30 feet high, plus nearby restrooms and seating areas.

Name: Pine Lake Waterpark
Description: Pine Lake Waterpark in Berne features multiple water attractions including racing, curly, and kiddie slides, a splash pad, a bobbers area, a tower with jumping platforms at 10, 20, and 30 feet, a cable ride, and lily pads. The park operates seasonally with shallow water attractions open until 8 pm and deeper features closing around 6 pm nightly. Admission is $12 for ages 10+, $10 for ages 4–9, and free for children under 4, with individual season passes at $150 and family passes at $300. The facility offers group rates for parties of 20 or more and includes picnic areas, restrooms, and concession stands on-site.

Name: Pioneer Waterland & Dry Fun Park
Description: Pioneer Waterland & Dry Fun Park combines water attractions and land-based amusement in a single outdoor facility near Chardon. The water side includes multiple slides, an activity pool fed by an artesian well, splash areas, and paddle boats, while the grounds also feature go-karts, miniature golf, batting cages, and jumping pillows. Operating daily from 11 AM to 7 PM through Labor Day (weather permitting), the park welcomes groups, birthday parties, and corporate events and offers picnic areas for guests. Military, junior, and senior discounts are available at the gate.

Name: Pirate's Cove Waterpark
Description: Pirate's Cove Waterpark in Lorton features a large pirate-themed play structure with a 300-gallon dumping bucket, two waterslides, water-spraying palm trees, a main swimming pool, a separate tot pool with a clamshell slide, and Buccaneer Beach sand area. The park operates Memorial Day Weekend through Labor Day and charges $8.50 per person on weekdays and $11.00 on weekends and holidays. Amenities include two picnic areas available for group reservations (minimum 15 passes), Captain's Galley concessions, restrooms, shaded seating with umbrellas, and a large deck area. Aquatic classes and birthday party packages are available.

Name: Pirates Bay Waterpark Leesburg
Description: Pirates Bay Waterpark sits on Weiss Lake in Leesburg and features multiple water slide towers with options ranging from gentle family-friendly slides to more intense rides, along with designated areas for younger children including a smaller twisting slide and splash zones. The park operates daily from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. CST from late May through early August, then weekends only through early September, with general admission at $24.99 (discounted rates available for seniors and military). Amenities include free parking with admission, restrooms, picnic areas, and on-site concessions, though outside food is not permitted. Children under 3 enter free, and Coast Guard-approved flotation devices are permitted in the water (though not on slides).

Name: Pollock Community Water Park
Description: Pollock Community Water Park in Oshkosh operates from mid-June through mid-August, with open swim daily from noon to 7 PM. The facility features water slides, a zero-depth entry pool, lazy river, sand play area, splash pad, and designated tot time sessions for children five and under. Amenities include restrooms with shower facilities, concessions, and picnic areas throughout the grounds.

Name: Quassy Amusement & Waterpark
Description: Quassy Amusement & Waterpark in Middlebury, Connecticut combines amusement rides with water attractions, including waterslides alongside kiddie rides, a junior roller coaster, and thrill rides. The facility is wheelchair accessible with designated parking and provides restrooms and picnic areas for visitors. Admission is required for entry.

Name: Raging Rivers WaterPark
Description: Raging Rivers WaterPark in Grafton, Illinois operates seasonally and offers tiered season pass options ranging from $69.99 to $220, each providing unlimited visits throughout the 2026 season along with varying perks. Pass holders enjoy benefits such as discounts on food and merchandise, access to special events including concerts and movie nights, tube rental options, and reduced rates on cabana rentals. The facility includes general parking (free with higher-tier passes), picnic areas, and restrooms. Additional perks vary by pass level, with premium members receiving invitations to exclusive events like Adult Night and Lumberjacks Opening.

Name: Raging Waters Los Angeles
Description: Raging Waters Los Angeles operates as a full-scale water park in San Dimas featuring over 50 attractions including Aqua Rocket (a hydromagnetic water coaster), multiple tube and body slides at varying difficulty levels, a 30,000-square-foot water playground for younger children, a one-million-gallon wave pool, and a quarter-mile lazy river. The park is open during summer months and offers admission through single-day tickets (Summer Kick-Off pricing at $39.99) and season passes. Amenities include picnic areas, restrooms, cabanas available for rental, online parking pre-purchase options, and a cashless payment system; outside food and coolers are not permitted, though water bottles are allowed.

Name: Raging Waves Waterpark
Description: Raging Waves Waterpark in Yorkville is Illinois' largest water park, featuring attractions such as the Great Barrier Reef Wave Pool, Wonambi, Aussie Mat Dash, Crocodile Mile, and a lazy river. Day-pass admission costs $59.99 at the gate or discounted online, with weekday pricing at $54.99, and season passes available starting at $35 more than a single day ticket. The park offers food concessions throughout the grounds, private cabanas, picnic areas, and online parking pre-purchase options, operating on a cashless basis with no outside food or coolers permitted. Limited-time summer promotional tickets are available for $39.99.

Name: Red Oaks Waterpark
Description: Red Oaks Waterpark is a water park in Madison Heights, Michigan. It is a paid facility. Buying tickets in advance is recommended. On-site attractions include a lazy river and a wave pool. On-site amenities include restrooms, food service, picnic areas, lockers, and party services. The venue provides paid parking.

Name: River Country Water Park
Description: River Country Family Water Park in Muskogee features water slides, a lazy river, and beach areas for swimming and recreation. The park operates seasonally from late May through the summer, with varying daily hours ranging from noon to 8:00 p.m. depending on the day of the week, and remains closed Mondays except for Memorial Day and Labor Day. Season passes are available for $60 per person (ages 3 and up), and the park also offers a special "Walk Against the Flow" event on Tuesday evenings for ages 16 and up at $3 per entry. The facility provides restrooms and picnic areas, and outside food and beverages are not permitted on the premises.

Name: Rivertown
Description: Rivertown is a water play area in Kings Mills, Ohio. It is a paid facility. Buying tickets in advance is recommended. On-site amenities include restrooms, an on-site restaurant, an on-site bar, and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It accepts credit cards and debit cards.

Name: Rogers Aquatics Center
Description: Rogers Aquatics Center is an aquatic center in Rogers, Arkansas. It is a paid facility. Buying tickets in advance is recommended. On-site attractions include a lazy river. On-site amenities include restrooms, an on-site restaurant, lockers, and party services. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms.

Description: Golfland Sunsplash in Roseville is a multi-attraction complex anchored by a water park with more than 30 rides and features, including waterslides and night slide experiences available on select evenings. Day admission ranges from $44.99 to $62.99 depending on the day and age group, with the park opening Memorial Day weekend and operating seasonally. Beyond the aquatic area, the venue also offers miniature golf, go-kart racing, laser tag, bumper cars, gel blaster games, virtual reality experiences, and arcade entertainment, with various combination packages available to visit multiple attractions.

Daily admission ranges from $8 to $14 depending on age and time of visit, while season passes are available starting at $80 for individuals or $200 for families. The center offers swim lessons across five skill levels, open swim programs, and group camp rates, with restrooms and poolside loungers available for visitors.

Showers, restrooms, and picnic areas are available on-site, and the park also hosts birthday party packages for special events.

The park operates seasonally through Labor Day and offers tiered season pass options (Silver, Gold, and Prestige) that provide unlimited visits, with the Silver Pass including general parking. Amenities include picnic areas and restrooms throughout the grounds. The facility is adjacent to Six Flags Over Georgia amusement park.

Name: Soak City Waterpark
Description: Soak City is a 20-acre water park located within Kings Dominion amusement park in Doswell, Virginia. The facility features water slides, splash pads, a wave pool, and a lazy river, with Coconut Shores offering a separate mini-wave pool and 45-foot multi-level interactive play structure. Soak City admission is included with Kings Dominion park entry. The venue operates seasonally and offers amenities including picnic areas, restrooms, and dining options.

Description: Soak City is a family water park in Mason, Ohio, featuring over 15 water rides and various concessions. The facility provides cabanas for guests seeking relaxation between activities. Amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, wheelchair-accessible entrances, and parking. Admission is required to enter the park.

Name: SomerSplash Waterpark
Description: SomerSplash Waterpark in Somerset, Kentucky features a wave pool, body slides, kiddie play area with sprinklers and dumping bucket, wading pool, and high-intensity water slides. The lazy river, bowl slide, and tube slides are temporarily closed for repairs. The park offers shaded areas, cabanas, changing rooms, restrooms, and concessions; visitors can purchase tickets online to skip entry lines. Admission for a family of five with lunch runs approximately $100, and the facility maintains lifeguard coverage throughout different sections.

Name: SoundWaves at Gaylord Opryland
Description: SoundWaves at Gaylord Opryland Resort is an indoor/outdoor water park located within the Nashville resort property, featuring wave pools and water rides designed for guests of all ages. The facility includes dining options, adult-only areas, gift shops, and operates daily from 10 AM to 8 PM with paid admission. Amenities include picnic areas and restrooms throughout the facility. The water park offers both indoor and outdoor spaces, making it accessible year-round regardless of weather.

Name: Spivey Splash Water Park
Description: Spivey Splash Water Park is a water park in Jonesboro, Georgia. On-site amenities include restrooms and picnic areas. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. The water play is designed for visitors of all ages.

Name: Splash Central Waterpark
Description: Splash Central Waterpark in Huron, South Dakota features waterslides and a lazy river alongside a swimming pool, making it a regional destination for summer recreation. The facility sits adjacent to Central Park, which offers nature trails and picnic grounds for additional outdoor activities. The waterpark welcomes families and groups, with on-site restrooms and picnic areas, and can accommodate special events like birthday parties and family reunions through its Campus Center.

Name: Splash Country Water Park, Aurora
Description: Located in Aurora, Illinois, this water park features a zero-depth entry pool with interactive elements for children, plus a 1,100-foot lazy river with dumping buckets, water jets, and rapids. The facility includes two tube slides (one enclosed, one open), a dedicated splash area with spray guns and waterfall for kids under 48 inches, sand volleyball courts, and a sand play zone with shade and seating. A snack bar serves beverages and light refreshments, and visitors may bring outside food and beverages into the park. Lap swimming is available during designated times.

Name: Splash Harbour Water Park
Description: Splash Harbour features two 42-foot water slides: the Smugglers Run tube slide for one or two riders with twists and sprays, and the Pirates Plunge body slide that travels through darkness before emptying into a plunge pool. The park includes a 600-foot lazy river with waterfalls and misting features, along with an expansive sun deck offering both sunny and shaded seating areas and private cabana rentals. Additional attractions on-site include miniature golf, gem mining, arcade games, and a rum bar. Operating daily from 10 AM to 5 PM, the park provides restrooms and picnic facilities for all ages.

Name: Splash Lagoon
Description: Splash Lagoon is an indoor water park in Erie, Pennsylvania featuring nine water slides, multiple pools, hot tubs, and a large wave pool capable of generating substantial waves. The facility includes a multi-level interactive tree house structure, ropes course, and a 6,500-square-foot arcade with over 100 games, all maintained at a tropical 84-degree temperature year-round. Three on-site hotels—Wyndham Garden, Hawthorn Inn & Suites, and Comfort Inn & Suites—are connected to the resort. Group packages and discounts are available for parties of 15 or more, including options for birthday celebrations, field trips, and scout groups.

Description: Splash Mountain Water Park in Ocean City, Maryland features 16 water slides and attractions including the Aqualoop (a 360-degree looping slide), Stealth (a 45-foot half-pipe), the Master Blaster water roller coaster, Rapids Ride river rafting, Black Hole slide, Wave Pool, and a pirate-themed treehouse with water guns and interactive elements. The park offers three kiddie pools, a Lazy Lagoon family activity pool, and a lazy river, along with picnic areas and full restrooms. During mid-June through the summer, character mermaids appear Wednesday through Sunday from noon to 2 p.m. to interact with guests. Admission is paid, and the park is staffed with certified water safety personnel.

Located next to Green Ridge Recreation Center, Splash Valley charges separate admission and operates during summer months only.

Infants ages 2 and under can enter free with the purchase of a reusable swim diaper, and group packages are available with advance booking for parties of 20 or more.

The park offers pavilion and cabana rentals for groups, lockers, four concession areas, and catering options, with group discounts available Tuesday through Friday with advance registration. The facility is located along the Jekyll River and maintains clean grounds with scenic water views. The park operates daily during the season and welcomes families and groups looking for water recreation. Amenities include picnic areas and restrooms on-site.

Name: Sun Outdoors Frontier Town Water Park
Description: Sun Outdoors Frontier Town Water Park is an Old-West-themed family amusement complex in Berlin, Maryland, featuring waterslides and a lazy river alongside mini-golf. The facility offers restrooms, an on-site restaurant and bar, picnic areas, and an adjacent playground, with wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking available. Advance ticket purchase is recommended, and the venue accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments. It operates daily and hosts live performances and party services.

Name: Super Splash Park
Description: Super Splash Park is a seasonal water park located at 625 S. Lewis Lane in Carbondale that operates from late May through August, with extended hours during June through mid-August (Tuesday–Sunday, 12:00 PM–6:00 PM). The facility features an aqua climbing wall (new for 2026), a competition pool with lap swimming lanes, a lazy river for walking, and a water slide (48-inch height requirement). Daily admission ranges from free for children under 3 to $10 for non-resident adults, with season passes and group discounts available; families can bring coolers up to 30 quarts and pack their own snacks. Amenities include concessions, tables for dining, and supervision requirements for young children in the water.

Name: Swanston Park
Description: Swanston Park's splash pad features multiple water features and an interactive splash pad area, operating seasonally from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day, 10am to 7pm daily. Admission is free and no reservation is required to use the splash pad. The 10-acre neighborhood park also includes basketball courts, tennis courts, sand volleyball, playgrounds, restrooms, and a community center, with picnic areas available for rent. Dogs must be leashed, and the park is located at 2350 Northrop Ave in Sacramento.

Name: THE COVE at VERDURE
Description: THE COVE at VERDURE is a water play area in Amarillo, Texas. On-site amenities include restrooms and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It is open daily. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Tarpon Springs Splash Park
Description: Tarpon Springs Splash Park is a maritime-themed splash pad in Tarpon Springs, Florida, featuring colorful water sprayers and covered seating areas. The facility includes restrooms, free parking, and wheelchair-accessible entrances, along with an adjacent playground. Party services are available, and the venue operates daily.

Name: Terminus Wake Park
Description: Terminus Wake Park is a water play area in Cartersville, Georgia. Buying tickets in advance is recommended. On-site amenities include restrooms, food service, an adjacent playground, and party services. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments. It features active-military discounts and live performances. It is open daily. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

The climate-controlled facility is part of a larger resort complex that includes 324 suites, a hotel lodge, and numerous recreational amenities such as a bowling alley, laser tag center, high ropes course, arcade, and indoor playground. Free parking and Wi-Fi are available to guests throughout the resort.

The park includes Tiny Tides, an expanded kids zone for children under 54 inches tall with dedicated water play areas. Amenities include eight food outlets, private cabanas for rent, picnic areas, free life jackets, and tube rentals. The waterpark operates seasonally and charges paid admission; season passes are available with perks like early entry and dining discounts.

Name: The Yards Park
Description: The Yards Park is a water play area in Washington, District Of Columbia. Admission is free. On-site amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking. The venue provides free parking and accepts credit cards. There is a dog park on site. It is open daily.

Name: Tomahawk Lake Waterpark
Description: Tomahawk Lake Waterpark spans 200 acres in Sparta, New Jersey, and features multiple water slides including Black Snake, Sioux-A-Slide, Sitting Bull, Geronimo, Rocky Mountain, Apache Plunge, and Crazy Horse Run, with a new Drop Slide coming for the upcoming summer. Younger children can access Papoose Land for riders under 4 feet tall with slides, lily pads, and play structures, while Cherokee Corner serves kids 5 feet or shorter with additional slides and interactive features. The facility includes a 20-acre lake for swimming and boating, picnic areas with over 800 tables, an 18-hole miniature golf course, changing facilities, and a snack bar. General admission includes parking, beach access, changing facilities, and use of picnic tables, though water slide and boat rides require additional fees; season passes are available.

Name: Tomahawk Lake
Description: Tomahawk Lake Waterpark spans 200 acres in Sparta, New Jersey and features a 20-acre natural swimming lake, a white sand beach, and numerous water slides including Black Snake, Sioux-A-Slide, Sitting Bull, Geronimo, Rocky Mountain, Apache Plunge, and Crazy Horse Run. Younger children have access to Papoose Land with slides, lily pads, and play structures for kids under 4 feet tall, and Cherokee Corner with rides for children 5 feet or shorter. The park includes an 18-hole miniature golf course, over 800 picnic tables, changing facilities, a beer garden with live weekend music, and refreshment stands; boats and slides require additional charges beyond admission. The park operates daily from 10 AM to 5:30 PM and offers season passes for unlimited general admission.

Name: Torzewski County Park
Description: Torzewski County Park spans 70 acres along Pero Lake in Lapeer, Michigan, offering a mix of recreational facilities for families and outdoor enthusiasts. The grounds feature a playground, nature trails, horseshoe pits, a softball field, sand volleyball court, disc golf course, and covered pavilions with charcoal grills for gatherings. Open daily from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m., the park combines open fields with wooded areas, providing a natural setting for picnicking, sports, and casual recreation.

Name: Treasure Island Waterslide and Cabanas
Description: Treasure Island Waterslide sits at Gulf Front Park on Treasure Island Beach and features a giant blue "Hippo" waterslide alongside dry attractions including a bungee trampoline, Kraken dry slide, and pirate bounce/combo rides. The venue operates daily year-round (weather permitting), with off-season hours from 11am–7pm and peak season hours from 10am–10pm. Cabana and umbrella rentals are available, including oversize cabanas with mesh ventilation panels, and a free waterslide ride is offered with daily cabana rentals during a limited promotion. Tickets are available for purchase on-site.

Name: Turtle Splash Water Park
Description: Turtle Splash Water Park operates seasonally in West Chicago, opening for pre-season weekends at the end of May before transitioning to regular hours from early June through mid-August, with daily operations from noon to 6:30 p.m. Admission costs $12 for residents and $15 for non-residents, with reduced rates of $6 and $8 respectively after 5 p.m., while children under 2 enter free. Located at 129 W. National Street within Reed-Keppler Park, the facility includes restrooms and picnic areas, and operates as part of a larger park district property that also houses other recreational attractions.

Description: Van Nuys/Sherman Oaks Aquatic Center operates year-round with lap swim and recreation swim sessions throughout the week, including early morning and evening hours on weekdays. Daily admission is affordable, with children and seniors paying $1, adults $4, and those with disabilities $1 regardless of age. The facility offers swim lesson registration in multiple sessions throughout the year and sells multi-entry passes for regular swimmers. Restrooms are available on-site.

Description: Venture River Water Park is Western Kentucky's sole water park, located in Eddyville and operating daily during the season with one-price admission covering all water attractions. General admission is $32, with reduced rates for guests under 54 inches ($26), seniors 60+ ($15), and free entry for children under 2; afternoon tickets and season passes are also available. The park provides complimentary lounge chairs, inner tubes, and life jackets, along with paid locker rentals, shower facilities, concessions, a gift shop, and free parking. Supervised by certified lifeguards, the facility welcomes families and enforces safety rules including swim diaper requirements for infants and mandatory adult supervision for children 15 and younger.

The centerpiece interactive play structure features fountains, squirters, and platforms in shallow water alongside a kiddie slide, while a separate splash pad area includes water cannons, showers, sprinklers, and buckets. A large main pool provides additional swimming space, and amenities include a miniature golf course, the Paradise Café with shade umbrellas, restrooms, and changing areas. Admission is free.

The lagoon offers kayak and SUP rentals, lessons, boat tours, and floating cabana rentals, operating daily 10 AM to 4:30 PM during summer months with extended hours available. The facility also includes a surf park (Wai Kai Wave) open daily 12:30–7 PM, multiple dining options, retail shops, and cabana rental areas. Admission is paid, with various pass options including full-day and afternoon entry.

Description: Wild Rivers Waterpark in Irvine operates seasonally with varying ride availability depending on the school calendar; after mid-August, not all attractions are guaranteed to be open as staffing adjusts. Admission pricing is tiered by height for children under 48 inches, with free entry for children age 2 and under, and discounted senior rates available for guests 63 and older. The park offers accessible facilities including parking, picnic areas, and restrooms. Note that ticket purchases are final with no refunds or exchanges, and the park may close periodically for maintenance.

Name: Chickasawaves Waterpark
Description: Chickasawaves is a water park in Leakesville featuring three distinct play areas: Colossal Splash with a 20-foot tower containing three slides, two jump platforms, and a rock wall; Big Splash offering over 30 obstacles, a 25-foot action tower with multiple slides, a 33-foot Mega Blob, and two racing courses; and Lil' Splash, a dedicated zone for children under 7 and 45 inches tall with a Figure 8 slide, Frog Jump, and Tunnel. Open weekends only (Saturday and Sunday, 10 AM–6 PM), the park offers all-day and two-hour session tickets, with group discounts and season passes available; parents supervising in Lil' Splash and spectators at the shore do not require admission. On-site amenities include The Haven Bar & Grill, restrooms, picnic areas, parking, RV hookups, and cabin rentals, making it part of the larger Chickasawhay Hideaway resort complex.

Name: Grand Paradise Waterpark
Description: Grand Paradise Waterpark spans 7 acres in Collins, Mississippi, and features thrill slides including FreeFALL, AquaTwist, Wipe Out, Tropical Splash, Grand Falls Racer, and Blue Typhoon, along with a lazy river float, interactive Water Fort with tipping buckets and water play structures, a shallow splash pad area for young children, and a traditional pool with slides. The park opens for the season beginning May 23, 2026, operating daily starting at 10am, with cabana rentals available for half or full days. Admission requires tickets or season passes for guests 42 inches and taller, with covered facilities available for group events, and amenities including restrooms, picnic areas, and parking.

Name: Geyser Falls Water Theme Park
Description: Geyser Falls Water Theme Park in Philadelphia, Mississippi is a large water park featuring a tropical island theme with multiple slides and rides, including a wave pool. The venue provides on-site dining options and an adjacent playground for additional recreation. Wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms are available throughout the facility.

Name: Liberty Lagoon
Description: Liberty Lagoon in Baton Rouge operates from late May through early September with a mix of daily and weekend hours depending on the season. The facility features a bowl slide, the Shockwave attraction, a lazy river, a splash pad, and the Purple Plunge, along with a playground and standard amenities including restrooms and parking. Children under 13 must be accompanied by an adult, and non-swimmers are required to wear Coast Guard-approved life vests. The venue enforces a clear bag policy and comprehensive safety guidelines to maintain a secure environment for all visitors.

Name: Blue Bayou Water Park
Description: Blue Bayou Water Park in Baton Rouge features multiple water attractions including Conja, an enclosed tunnel slide that opens to sunlight, Atchafalaya Run with twists through swamp-inspired waters, and Hurricane Bay, a wave pool with rolling swells. The park offers concessions with food and beverage options, and provides standard amenities including parking, restrooms, and picnic areas. Located off I-10 at 18142 Perkins Road East near Highland Road, the park operates seasonally with varying daily hours; visitors should check the operating calendar for specific dates and times before visiting.
Address: 18142 Perkins Rd E, Baton Rouge, LA 70810

Name: Aqua PARDS
Description: Aqua PARDS is a waterpark in Denham Springs offering a beach-style entry point with a gentle slope, interactive splash zones, super slides (40-inch height minimum), and Crooked Creek, a lazy river with provided tubes (48-inch height minimum). The facility operates daily from 5:30 AM to 9 PM and includes amenities such as restrooms, parking, a snack bar, life jacket and locker rentals, and covered pavilion rentals with shade and seating. The waterpark welcomes families, kids, and toddlers and is designed to be accessible to visitors of all ages.
Address: 30372 Eden Church Rd, Denham Springs, LA 70726

Name: OCNJ Watersports Aqua Park
Description: This 8,500-square-foot inflatable obstacle course on the bay features over 20 water-based challenges including slides, monkey bars, diving boards, and climbing obstacles. Sessions start at $40 per person, with discounted multi-pass packages available (5-pass and 10-pass options offer 20–30% savings). The park operates daily from 9 AM to 7 PM, with specific time slots dependent on tide conditions; advance online booking is required.

Name: Breakwater Beach Waterpark at Casino Pier
Description: Breakwater Beach Waterpark at Casino Pier in Seaside Heights features a lazy river, wave pool, and water slides alongside a go-kart track. The facility accommodates visitors of all ages with shallow areas for toddlers and hot springs for adults. Amenities include an on-site restaurant and bar, arcade, picnic areas, lockers, and party services, with wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking available. Advance ticket purchase is recommended, and the park is open daily and accepts multiple payment methods.

Name: Island Aqua Park
Description: Island Aqua Park is a water play area in Margate City, New Jersey. Buying tickets in advance is recommended. On-site amenities include restrooms and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It accepts credit cards and debit cards.

Name: OC Waterpark
Description: OC Waterpark is a seasonal beachfront water park in Ocean City, New Jersey, featuring slides and a lazy river alongside a mini-golf course. The facility offers restrooms, an on-site restaurant, picnic areas, lockers, and an adjacent playground, with wheelchair-accessible entrances and restrooms available. Advance ticket purchases are recommended, and the venue provides paid parking, accepts multiple payment methods, offers party services, and extends active-military discounts.

Name: SeaSpray Park
Description: SeaSpray Park features an interactive water playground with slides, a climbing bus structure, cascading water features, and a large tipping bucket, alongside themed water sculptures. The facility operates daily from 10 AM to 6 PM and welcomes families and children of all ages. Onsite amenities include accessible facilities, parking, restrooms, a playground area, and a food concession offering burgers, chicken fingers, salads, and ice cream. The park also accommodates birthday parties and group events with dedicated seating areas.

Name: Ocean Oasis Water Park + Beach Club
Description: Ocean Oasis Water Park + Beach Club is a water park in Wildwood, New Jersey. Buying tickets in advance is recommended. On-site attractions include a lazy river. On-site amenities include restrooms, an on-site restaurant, picnic areas, lockers, an on-site bar, an adjacent playground, and Wi-Fi. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances and restrooms.

Name: Water Ways
Description: Water Ways in Julian offers water play across multiple attractions including slides (with a 44-inch height requirement), a lazy river, pool, and kiddy island. The facility is free for children under 3, $6 for those under 44 inches, and $15 for taller guests and adults, with tube rentals and unlimited mini-golf included in admission. Amenities include restrooms, accessible facilities, parking, a playground, shelters available for rent, and on-site concessions. The venue operates daily from 11 AM to 6 PM and allows outside coolers for picnicking, making it suitable for families with children of various ages.

Name: ACE Adventure Resort | Whitewater Rafting West Virginia
Description: ACE Adventure Resort is a 1,500-acre family-owned property in Oak Hill that features a spring-fed mountain lake water park alongside whitewater rafting and additional outdoor activities. The resort offers free admission to the water park for children staying at its on-site cabins and provides amenities including restrooms, picnic areas, and parking. Beyond the water park, visitors can enjoy over 30 miles of hiking and biking trails, zip lines, scenic overlooks, and guided whitewater rafting trips through the New River Gorge.

The facility provides parking, picnic areas, restrooms, and is designed to accommodate guests of all ages and abilities.

Description: The Hub H20 Family Waterpark is a 9-acre facility in Ponca City, Oklahoma near Kaw Lake, featuring water slides, a lazy river, and Kiddie Cove designed for children 6 and under with adult supervision. The park also offers bumper boats, go-karts, and 18-hole miniature golf included with admission, along with a snack bar and rental pavilions for private events. Description: The Pattee Foundation YMCA Water Park in Monmouth operates seasonally, opening May 30, 2026, with community swim available Monday through Saturday from noon to 6 PM and Sundays from 1 PM to 5 PM during the summer months. The facility provides restrooms, shade, picnic areas, and parking for visitors. Swim lessons and fitness classes are offered when the pool is not in use for community swim, and seasonal passes and rental options are available by calling 309-337-4453.

Name: River's Edge Splash Pad
Description: River's Edge Splash Pad operates daily from 11 a.m. to 8 p.m. during the summer season, typically from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day weekend (weather permitting). Located within the 42-acre River's Edge Park in Waite Park, the splash pad is ADA accessible and sits adjacent to the Sauk River. The surrounding park provides parking, restrooms, picnic areas, a playground, and a concession stand for visitor convenience.

Description: Wild Woods Water Park is a 30,000-square-foot indoor facility in Otsego featuring multiple water attractions including three four-story waterslides, a lazy river, hot tub, vortex pool, wading pool, and basketball hoops. The park operates Friday 4–9 PM, Saturday 10 AM–9 PM, and Sunday 10 AM–4 PM, welcoming both hotel guests and the general public. On-site concessions offer pizza, pretzels, frozen cocktails, smoothies, and other food and drink options, though outside food and beverages are not permitted. The facility provides restrooms, parking, picnic areas, and playground amenities for families visiting with children.

Name: Cascade Bay Water Park
Description: Cascade Bay is an outdoor water park in Eagan featuring a zero-depth entry pool, leisure pool, seven waterslides, lazy river, and sand play area. The facility also offers mini-golf and concessions on-site, along with accessible amenities including restrooms, parking, and picnic areas. Morning and evening fitness classes, lap swims, and water walking programs are available for visitors of various ages.

Name: Bunker Beach Water Park
Description: Bunker Beach is Minnesota's largest outdoor water park, situated within Bunker Hills Regional Park in Coon Rapids and featuring a wave pool, lazy river, splash pad, and water slides. The facility operates daily from 11:30 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. between June 6 and August 30, with general admission at $20.50 and reduced twilight rates available after 4 p.m. Locker rentals are available at multiple sizes, and entry to the regional park requires a separate vehicle permit ($7 daily or $30 annually). The park closes when temperatures drop to 62°F or below, during severe weather, or electrical storms, with limited refund options for weather-related interruptions.
Address: 701 County Rd A, Coon Rapids, MN 55448

Name: Splash Valley Water Park
Description: Splash Valley Water Park, recently reopened in 2025 with renovations and a new name, features a zero-depth leisure pool, sprayground splash pad, innertube and body slides, and a lazy river with zero-depth entry. The park operates daily from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m., June 5 through August 23, with select extended evening hours and specialized programming including tots-only swim times and water walking sessions. Standard admission is $14, with season passes and discounted entry options available for residents, non-residents, and students. Amenities include picnic areas, lawn games, shaded seating, food concessions, restrooms, and rental options for cabanas and picnic tables.
Address: 14421 Johnny Cake Ridge Rd, Apple Valley, MN 55124

Name: Water Parks of Minnesota
Description: Water Parks of Minnesota is a water park in Rochester, Minnesota. On-site amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, and an adjacent playground. It accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments. It features active-military discounts.
Address: 4051 E River Rd NE, Rochester, MN 55901

Name: K & K Tubing
Description: K & K Tubing is a water play area in Detroit Lakes, Minnesota. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments.

Name: Splash Pad (Heritage Square)
Description: Heritage Square Splash Pad in Wilkesboro features 29 water jets of varying heights and shapes arranged in an Ohio Star quilt pattern, with outer jets designed for younger children. Visitors activate the splash pad by stepping on a circular pad, which triggers a 5-minute cycle of water play. The free facility sits on the lawn of the Wilkes Heritage Museum and includes restroom access via portable facilities at the adjacent Community Commons. The splash pad is open to families and children of all ages.

Name: H2OBX Waterpark
Description: H2OBX Waterpark in Powells Point offers water slides and a lazy river-style attraction called Adventure River for visitors of all ages. The facility provides free admission and includes amenities such as parking, picnic areas, playgrounds, and restroom facilities to accommodate families spending the day at the park.

Name: White Lake Water Park
Description: White Lake Water Park in Elizabethtown features a 2,000-square-foot swimming pool, a 100,000-gallon beach pool, and a 5,000-square-foot wading area with three kiddie slides, bucket dumps, and interactive water structures, all with a fenced-in wading zone for safety. Guests can also enjoy a 600-foot lazy river, bumper boats, a splash deck with a sinking submarine and octopus slide, and access to a sun deck for lounging. The facility includes on-site dining options, an ice cream shop, a beach wear store, and allows coolers for a $10 fee; height rather than age determines child pricing in accordance with North Carolina state law.

Name: Winston Waterworks Water Park
Description: Winston Waterworks Water Park is a water park in Winston-Salem, North Carolina. On-site attractions include a lazy river. On-site amenities include restrooms, food service, and picnic areas. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances.

Description: Located within Civic Park in O'Fallon, Alligator's Creek is an outdoor aquatic center featuring three water slides, a one-meter spring diving board, a zero-depth beach-entry lazy river, a splash pad for children of varying abilities, a floating bridge, an interactive water playground, and a family whirlpool. The facility operates seasonally from late May through early September, with varying daily hours throughout the season. Amenities include a modern bathhouse, large concession stand, and lap swimming pool alongside the recreational water features. Admission is charged daily, and the center welcomes all ages with accessible facilities and ample parking available.

All visitors must pay admission or use a pass regardless of swimming plans. The center operates during the outdoor aquatic season and hosts programming such as fitness classes and camps for various age groups.

Description: Splish Splash Water Park in Calverton, New York is a large water park featuring themed body and tube slides, including drop slides, alongside a lazy river and wave pool. Admission is free, though advance ticket purchase is recommended. The facility offers restrooms, an on-site restaurant and bar, picnic areas, lockers, and cabana rentals, plus an adjacent playground and party services. Name: Sunrise Splash Park
Description: Sunrise Splash Park is a seasonal outdoor water facility in Greeley, Colorado, featuring a splash pad and sprinkler areas for water play. The park provides picnic tables for visitors and includes on-site restrooms for guest convenience.

Name: Water World
Description: Water World in Federal Heights is a large outdoor water park serving Colorado with attractions spread across multiple themed areas including Thunder Bay Wave Pool, Wild Isle, Alpine Springs, and the North Shore Area with Cowabunga Beach and Turtle Bay. The park operates seasonally with weather-dependent hours; visitors should call 303-427-7873 for current operating status and hours. Amenities include restrooms, parking, and picnic areas throughout the grounds, with cabin rentals and lockers available in select locations. Admission tickets are available for advance purchase, and the park offers rain-check policies for weather-related closures exceeding an hour.
Address: 8801 N Pecos St, Federal Heights, CO 80260

Name: The Splash at Fossil Trace
Description: The Splash at Fossil Trace is a 10-acre outdoor aquatic facility in Golden featuring multiple pools and water attractions for families. The zero-depth leisure pool includes a play structure, small slides, spray fountains, and a 500-gallon dumping bucket, while a separate shallow splash pad serves younger swimmers. Two large tube and body slides—Splish (180 feet) and Splash (151 feet)—offer thrilling rides, and a 25-meter lap pool with 8 lanes accommodates serious swimmers. The grounds also feature an expansive sandbox with interactive structures, lounge chairs, picnic tables, shaded areas, a bath house with changing facilities and lockers, a pro shop, and on-site concessions.

Name: Elitch Gardens
Description: Elitch Gardens is a combined amusement and water park located in central Denver that operates seasonally throughout 2026. The facility offers unlimited access to both its theme park rides and water park attractions for season pass holders, with day tickets also available for single visits. Amenities include free parking for pass holders, restrooms, picnic areas, and accessible facilities throughout the grounds. The park hosts special events and character appearances throughout the year and welcomes school groups and large parties with advance booking options.

Name: Point Mallard Park
Description: Point Mallard Water Park in Decatur opens May 23rd for the 2026 season and includes a wave pool, lazy river, kids' splash area, flume slides, Olympic pool, pro bowl, and sky pond slide. The facility sits within the larger Point Mallard Park and offers concessions, a gift shop, and cabana rentals. Free admission applies, and the park provides parking, restrooms, playgrounds, and is accessible to families and children.
Address: 2901 Point Mallard Cir SE, Decatur, AL 35601

Name: Gulf Islands Waterpark
Description: Gulf Islands Waterpark in Gulfport offers a variety of water attractions ranging from high-speed slides to a lazy river, with admission available through day tickets or season passes purchased online or at the gate. The park provides complimentary parking, tube rentals, and life jacket use with all admissions, plus free fountain beverages from Pepsi. Children under two enter free with a completed waiver, and the park operates on a seasonal schedule with special event days. Amenities include picnic areas, restrooms, and accessible facilities throughout the grounds.

Description: Great River Water Park is an indoor aquatics facility located within the Oxford Community Center in Saint Paul's Summit-University neighborhood, featuring two water slides, a lap pool, children's activity pool, and a diving board. The facility operates during fall, winter, and spring months with varying hours throughout the week and offers swimming lessons at no cost for Saint Paul residents under 18. On-site amenities include a sauna, restrooms, playground, picnic areas, and accessible facilities, making it a year-round option for community swimming and aquatic programming.

Name: Venetian Waterpark
Description: The Venetian is a 25,000-square-foot indoor heated waterpark located at the Holiday Inn & Suites in Maple Grove, featuring two four-story slides, a zero-entry pool (Bambini Piscina) designed for toddlers, basketball hoops, and an arcade. Water slides and play structures operate Friday through Sunday, with extended hours on select holidays, while the pool and spa remain accessible daily. Access is limited to registered hotel guests; each room booking includes five wristbands and no day passes are available. The facility also offers a 20-person spa, dining area with adult beverages, and nearby shopping and attractions.

Name: Great Wolf Lodge | Minnesota
Description: Great Wolf Lodge | Minnesota is an indoor water play facility in Bloomington, Minnesota. It identifies as women-owned. Admission is free. On-site amenities include shaded seating and Wi-Fi. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: New Hope Aquatic Park
Description: New Hope Aquatic Park is a water play area in New Hope, Minnesota. On-site attractions include a lazy river. On-site amenities include restrooms, food service, and party services.
Address: Civic Center Park, 4411 Xylon Ave N, New Hope, MN 55427

Name: Lost Kingdom Water Park
Description: Lost Kingdom Water Park in El Paso features multiple themed pools and attractions for different ages and skill levels. The facility includes Temple Drop with dual slides, the Forgotten Cenote leisure pool with a family slide, Mayan Lanes for open swimming and diving with a climbing wall, Macaw Lagoon with zero-depth entry and interactive features for young children, and the Jaguar Jungle play structure. On-site dining is available at Tres Milpas Terrace, and the park operates Friday through Sunday from 11 AM to 6 PM, with extended hours available on weekdays after 3 PM for twilight admission. Amenities include restrooms, parking, picnic areas, and playground facilities; the park is cashless and accepts credit cards and mobile payment.
