Description: Chapoteo Water Park in El Paso features multiple pools and water attractions including Calavera Plunge with enclosed racing flumes, Chalupa Springs leisure pool with a current channel and basketball hoops, Lago Azul recreation pool with El Valiente climbing wall, and Lagarto Lagoon zero-depth entry pool for young children. The park operates Thursday through Sunday from 11 AM to 6 PM and includes a playground, picnic areas with free shaded seating and rentable cabanas, concessions at La Olla, parking, and restroom facilities. Admission tickets are valid for the full day, with twilight rates available after 3 PM on weekdays, and the park operates on a cashless payment system accepting credit cards and mobile pay.

Name: Oasis Water Park
Description: Oasis Water Park in El Paso features a wave simulator called Flash Flood Rush, a dual-slide tower named Hueco Plunge, a climbing wall attraction with water splash landing, and the Sunset Lagoon area with a lazy river, play structure, and basketball courts. The park includes a zero-depth kiddie pool with a small slide and interactive water features, plus poolside dining and shaded seating options. Operating Monday through Friday 6 AM to 9 PM and Saturday 6 AM to 2 PM, the park offers daily admission tickets as well as twilight pricing after 3 PM on weekdays, and accepts all major credit and debit cards. Amenities include restrooms, playground equipment, picnic areas, accessible facilities, and parking.

Name: Camp Cohen Water Park
Description: Camp Cohen Water Park in El Paso features multiple pools and slides for different age groups and thrill levels. The Falls offers three enclosed and open-air slides, while Shallow Waters includes a leisure pool with basketball hoops and access to a current channel and interactive playground. The Wild Lagoon provides zero-depth entry for young children, and Rapid Waters accommodates recreational swimmers with a 12-foot climbing challenge. The park operates seasonally with twilight admission available after 3 PM on weekdays, offers shade structures and paid cabanas, and operates cashless with food service available.
Address: 9700 Gateway N Blvd, El Paso, TX 79924

Name: Wet 'N' Wild Waterworld
Description: Wet 'N' Wild Waterworld in Anthony, Texas operates with varying hours, typically 11am–6pm on weekdays, and charges admission ranging from $44–$49 depending on the day (with discounts for ages 1–3 and free entry for infants under 1). The park offers picnic tables available for reservation or first-come seating, island and general table options with natural shade from trees, and allows guests to bring their own food and beverages at no charge. Amenities include a concession area (Ribbit Café) serving burgers, chicken, hot dogs, and specialty items like funnel cakes, as well as rentals for propane and charcoal grills and cabanas with included tubes and seating. Additional features include parking, restrooms, playgrounds, and accessibility accommodations.

Name: Williamstown Splash Pad
Description: Williamstown Splash Pad is a free outdoor water play venue operating daily from 9 AM to 8 PM. The facility welcomes families, kids, and toddlers with accessible amenities including parking and restroom facilities on-site.

Name: Suffoletta Family Aquatic Center
Description: Suffoletta Family Aquatic Center in Georgetown features over 18,000 square feet of water attractions, including a 1,200-square-foot splash pad designed for children 10 and under, a 7,860-square-foot leisure pool with interactive play features, a 700-foot lazy river, and a 200-foot water slide requiring a minimum height of 48 inches. The facility operates seasonally with daily admission and season pass options available, and includes amenities such as concessions, picnic tables, cabanas, and event rental spaces. All guests have access to restrooms, parking, and surrounding green space, with the center designed to accommodate visitors of all abilities.

Name: Blast Off Bay
Description: Blast Off Bay is a water park in Goddard featuring giant slides, winding currents, splash zones, and family-friendly play areas suitable for multiple age groups. Two slides, Big and Little Dipper, require riders to be at least 48 inches tall, while other slides are designed for younger children. The park operates seasonally with fall hours Thursday–Friday 4–8 pm and Saturday–Sunday 11 am–7 pm (plus special Thanksgiving hours). Admission is free for children under 2 with a completed waiver; all other guests must purchase a ticket, though observation tickets are available for non-swimmers. The venue includes restrooms, parking, a playground, and is accessible to visitors with disabilities, plus on-site dining and arcade games.

Name: Splash Aqua Park - ICT
Description: Splash Aqua Park's Wichita location operates seasonally from late May through early September, with daily hours from 11 AM to 8 PM through mid-August, then weekends only through the start of September. The facility includes a playground and is designed to accommodate families with children, offering parking and accessibility features for guest convenience.
Address: 860 W Steeple Bay Pkwy, Wichita, KS 67217

Name: Rock River Rapids Aquatic Park
Description: Rock River Rapids Aquatic Park in Derby offers multiple water attractions including slides on a triple structure, drop slides, a high diving board, and lily pad features with height requirements ranging from 42 to 48 inches. The facility operates seasonally during summer months and provides season passes at discounted rates when purchased before May 31, with birthday party packages available starting at $85.50. Amenities include a snack bar, restrooms, parking, and a playground, with accessible facilities for families with young children who require adult supervision in the water.

Name: Pep's Point Water Park
Description: Pep's Point Water Park is a seasonal lakeside family amusement center in Hattiesburg, Mississippi, featuring a sand beach, water slides, canoeing, and mini-golf. The facility offers on-site restrooms, picnic areas, and RV camping with hookups, along with wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking. Free parking is available, and the venue accepts credit cards and debit cards.

Name: Splash of Fun Water Park
Description: Splash of Fun Water Park is a water park in Wiggins, Mississippi. On-site attractions include a lazy river. On-site amenities include restrooms, food service, picnic areas, and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It is open daily. The water play is designed for visitors of all ages.

Name: Gold Rush Indoor Waterpark
Description: Gold Rush Indoor Waterpark is an indoor water facility at the Double JJ Resort in Rothbury that welcomes families and guests of all ages. Operating daily from 4 to 9 PM, the park provides locker rentals, restrooms, shade areas, parking, and picnic facilities for visitors. The venue enforces strict safety policies including lifeguard supervision, swim diaper requirements for infants and toddlers, and Coast Guard-approved life jackets only. On-site food service is available through Rustler's Roost and other dining options on the lobby level, though outside food cannot be brought into the water park.

Name: Lower Huron Metropark - Turtle Cove Family Aquatic Center
Description: Turtle Cove Family Aquatic Center is the largest water facility within the Huron-Clinton Metroparks system, located at Lower Huron Metropark. The center includes two waterslides, a lazy river, a zero-depth entry pool with a portable lift for accessibility, and a 300-gallon dumping bucket. Guests can enjoy shade umbrellas throughout the facility, and changing rooms, lockers, and showers are available both indoors and outdoors.
Address: 40151 E Huron River Dr, Belleville, MI 48111

Name: Splash Universe Resort
Description: Splash Universe Resort in Dundee, Michigan operates year-round as an indoor waterpark resort featuring waterslides, a lazy river called River Raison, and an arcade. The facility includes an on-site hotel with 163 guest rooms, a heated indoor pool, dining options at the Treehouse restaurant and bar, and premium cabana rentals. Admission is free for guests, with parking and various amenities available including a fitness center, gift shop, and vending machines.

Name: The Aqua Pit
Description: The Aqua Pit in Coldwater offers water-based activities including The Hydro Zone (an inflatable water jungle gym requiring a minimum of 6 years old and 48 inches tall), kayaking, and paddleboarding around a lake, plus a beach area with swimming and lawn games like volleyball and cornhole. Admission is flexible, ranging from hourly activity passes ($17 for one activity) to all-day passes ($40) and seasonal passes; beach-only day passes are $5 per person. The facility provides parking, restrooms, and concessions including Dippin' Dots, and requires waivers for all visitors ages 2 and up.

Name: Waterford Oaks Wave Pool
Description: Waterford Oaks is a 185-acre recreational preserve in Waterford Township, Michigan, featuring a wave pool alongside a bicycle motocross track, sand volleyball court, and sledding hill. The facility provides restrooms and food service for visitors enjoying its various attractions.
Address: 1702 Scott Lake Rd, Waterford Township, MI 48328

Name: Wake in the Woods Aquapark and Campground
Description: Wake in the Woods Aquapark features an inflatable floating obstacle course where visitors ages 6 and up can jump, climb, and slide, with pricing at $25 per hour or $45 for two hours per person. Located at a lakeside campground in Lake Ariel, the facility also provides lake swimming and fishing access, along with on-site dining including a snack bar, food truck, and ice cream stand (with free delivery from Memorial Day through Labor Day). The property includes restrooms, parking, picnic areas, a large pavilion, and accessibility accommodations to support families and groups.

Name: Guppy Gulch Park
Description: Guppy Gulch Park is a water play area in Delta, Pennsylvania. Buying tickets in advance is recommended. On-site amenities include restrooms, food service, and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. The venue provides paid parking and accepts credit cards and debit cards. It is open daily.

Name: The Dublin Wave Waterpark and Aquatic Center
Description: The Wave Waterpark in Dublin features a six-slide tower, a splash zone with a 500-gallon tipping bucket, shallow play pool, interactive spray elements, and a climbable structure with kiddy slides. The facility operates seasonally from Memorial Day through Labor Day (11 a.m.–6 p.m. daily June 5–August 13, and Saturday–Sunday 11 a.m.–6 p.m. May 27–June 4), with admission providing access to all water attractions including the outdoor Paul McCreary Sports Pool when not in use for swim meets. The Wave also includes an indoor natatorium, cabana and lounger rentals (additional fee), accessible facilities, restrooms, picnic areas, and parking. For specific admission prices and details, visitors should consult the Dublin Recreation Guide website.

Name: Soaring Eagle Waterpark and Hotel
Description: Soaring Eagle Waterpark and Hotel in Mt Pleasant features a lazy river and wave pool alongside a full-service hotel with dining and recreational facilities. The waterpark offers free admission and includes an arcade, picnic areas, and food service. Wheelchair-accessible entrances and restrooms are available, along with complimentary parking and multiple payment options including credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments.
Address: 5665 E Pickard Rd, Mt Pleasant, MI 48858

Name: Beach Waterpark
Description: Beach Waterpark is an oceanside water park in South Padre Island, Texas, offering both outdoor and indoor amusement attractions including a lazy river. The venue provides seasonal passes and recommends purchasing tickets in advance. On-site amenities include restrooms, dining options, a bar, picnic areas, locker and cabana rentals, an adjacent playground, and party services. The facility is wheelchair accessible with free parking, accepts multiple payment methods, offers active-military discounts, and features live performances.
Address: 33261 State Park Rd 100, South Padre Island, TX 78597

Name: Great Wolf Lodge | Colorado Springs
Description: Great Wolf Lodge | Colorado Springs is a resort water park in Colorado Springs, Colorado. Admission is free. On-site amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, and Wi-Fi. The water play is designed for visitors of all ages.

Name: Sea Lion Aquatic Park
Description: Sea Lion Aquatic Park in Lisle offers separate pools for different age groups and skill levels, including a tot pool for young children and a lap pool for serious swimmers. The facility operates seasonally during summer months with multiple admission options: daily passes, season passes (with resident and non-resident rates), and digital punch cards offering ten visits at a discounted rate. Children under 3 are admitted free, and the park offers early swim times for tots under 6 and seniors age 50 and older. The aquatic center provides restrooms, parking, snack bar services, and hosts birthday parties and special events.

Name: Wings & Waves Waterpark
Description: Wings & Waves Waterpark is a year-round indoor water play facility in McMinnville featuring a virtual reality slide alongside traditional water attractions. The park operates select hours Thursday through Sunday, with free admission and on-site parking, restrooms, playground equipment, and shaded areas available for visitors. Open Friday evenings from 4:30–8:30 PM, Saturday sessions at 10 AM–2 PM and 3–7 PM, and Sunday from 11 AM–3 PM, the venue welcomes families and children seeking water-based entertainment in a climate-controlled setting.
Address: 460 NE Captain Michael King Smith Way, McMinnville, OR 97128

Name: The Funplex
Description: The Funplex is an amusement park with water attractions in Mt Laurel Township, New Jersey. Admission is free. On-site amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms.

Name: Baylor Beach Park; Water Park & Campground
Description: Baylor Beach Park features a two-acre swimming lake with a gradually sloping sand bottom fed by spring water and chemically treated daily. Water attractions include a 90-foot tube slide, kiddie slides, diving boards, log rolls, fountains, sprayers, and dumping buckets, along with a separate one-acre lake for paddleboats and aquabikes. The park operates seasonally during summer months and offers additional activities such as miniature golf, playground equipment, basketball and sand volleyball courts, and cornhole, with picnic shelters and a pavilion available for groups. Admission is free, and the facility includes restrooms, parking, and a concession stand.

Name: Liberty Oak Splash Park
Description: Liberty Oak Splash Park in Hyde Park offers free water play during its summer season, typically open daily from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m., with evening hours adjusted as daylight shifts throughout the season. The unstaffed facility includes a playground, accessible amenities, restrooms, and parking. As an unstaffed venue, there are no lifeguards present during operation.
Address: 402 E Hyde Park Ave, St Joseph, MO 64504

Name: Zenner Family Aquatic Center
Description: Zenner Family Aquatic Center operates from late May through early September at Lions Club Park in Killeen, with extended hours on weekends and afternoon openings on weekdays. The facility features multiple slides including a bowl slide, plunge slide, and two racing slides, along with a water playground with children's slides, zero-depth entry area, and dedicated splash pad. A 25-meter lap pool with diving board, shade structures, picnic tables, and a full bathhouse with family restrooms support daily visits. Day passes range from $2 to $10 depending on age, with season passes and group rental options available, and the center offers swim lessons and adaptive hours for families with special needs.
Address: 1800 E Stan Schlueter Loop, Killeen, TX 76542

Name: Summer Fun Water Park
Description: Summer Fun Water Park in Belton offers free admission and welcomes guests to bring their own food and beverages, though cooler fees apply. The park features a lazy river and hosts adult-only evening events for ages 21 and up with live music. Free parking is available, and the family-owned facility accommodates picnicking and group gatherings.

Name: Hawaiian Falls Waco
Description: Hawaiian Falls Waco is a seasonal water park in Waco offering multiple attractions including a wave pool, water slides, and a lazy river, along with a splash ground for younger children. The facility provides swim lessons for visitors of various skill levels. Amenities include accessible parking and restroom facilities, as well as a wheelchair-accessible entrance to accommodate guests with mobility needs.

Name: Kalahari Outdoor Water Park
Description: Kalahari Outdoor Water Park in Baraboo features a splash pad alongside a dry playground, basketball hoops, and yard games spread across the resort grounds. Day passes are available for non-overnight guests, though availability is limited and advance online booking is recommended. The facility operates daily from 11 AM to 7 PM and provides parking, picnic areas, restrooms, and accessible amenities for families and children.

Name: Springs Water Park
Description: Springs Water Park is an indoor water park located at The Ingleside Hotel in Pewaukee offering tube slides, body slides, a lazy river, an activity pool, and a zero-depth children's area called Waukesha Water Works. The facility features an indoor/outdoor hot tub, arcade games, and a snack bar with food and beverages. Open Thursday 3–8PM, Friday–Saturday 10AM–8PM, and Sunday 10AM–7PM, the park offers free admission and includes amenities such as restrooms, parking, picnic areas, and playground access.

Name: Popee's Cajun Water World
Description: Popee's Cajun Water World is a small water park in Robert, Louisiana, featuring a giant water slide where visitors can climb and descend. The venue operates Saturday and Sunday from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m., with admission options ranging from $15 for two hours to $25 for all-day access; group rates are available for parties of seven or more. The park includes a concession area serving burgers, chicken, seafood, and other homemade food items, plus a pavilion space available for private events and parties. Amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, and parking, with accessibility features available for guests.

Name: Surf 'n Slide Water Park
Description: Surf 'n Slide Water Park is a lakeside aquatic facility in Moses Lake featuring a large pool, three water slides, a tubing river, and a surfing simulator. The park provides restrooms, picnic areas, and an adjacent playground for visitors. Wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms are available on-site.

Name: salmoondion
Description: salmoondion is a water play area in Tucson, Arizona.

Name: Great Wolf Lodge | Pocono Mountains
Description: Great Wolf Lodge | Pocono Mountains is an indoor water play facility in Scotrun, Pennsylvania. On-site amenities include shaded seating. The venue is described as LGBTQ+ friendly. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Fenwick Fun Park
Description: Thunder Lagoon is a waterpark featuring six slides including the Black Hole enclosed body slide and Twister double slide, a 400-foot tropical lazy river with interactive water features, an activity pool with spray jets and water play, a shallow toddler splash zone, and a signature tipping Viking ship attraction that releases 250 gallons of water. Located in Fenwick Island, Delaware on Route 1 with free parking and accessible restrooms, the park operates seasonally in 2026 with tickets sold at the gate (no reservations required) and a multi-day discount structure offering 20% off day two and 40% off day three visits. The facility welcomes families with children of all ages and offers group packages for birthday parties and special events.

Name: Sahara Sam's Oasis Water Park
Description: Sahara Sam's Oasis Water Park in West Berlin, New Jersey operates as both an indoor and outdoor facility offering year-round water play. The park provides membership options starting at $6.99 per month, and single-day tickets are available online with various pricing tiers depending on the day of the week and advance purchase. The venue includes amenities such as restrooms, parking, picnic areas, and accessible facilities, and offers additional attractions like VIP cabanas and arcade games for visitors of all ages.

Name: Jungle Jim's
Description: Jungle Jim's operates Delaware's largest waterpark alongside mini golf and batting cages in Rehoboth Beach. The facility includes a wave pool, lazy river, activity pool, kiddie pool, kid's spray ground, and several large water slides, with height restrictions (42 inches minimum) for major slides. The park operates seasonally from late May through summer, typically 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. daily (weather permitting), with lockers, bathhouse facilities, restrooms, and parking available; outside food and coolers are prohibited, though one personal water bottle per person is permitted.
Address: 36944 Country Club Rd, Rehoboth Beach, DE 19971

Name: Killens Pond Water Park
Description: Killens Pond Water Park in Felton, Delaware is a state park featuring 27-foot-high twisting waterslides and a kiddie pool, along with beach volleyball. The facility offers on-site restrooms, food service, picnic areas, lockers, and an adjacent playground. Wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms are available, with paid parking required. Advance ticket purchase is recommended.

Name: White Water Mountain
Description: White Water Mountain is the water park component of Midway Speedway Park in Rehoboth Beach, and features body slides, tube slides, a lazy river, a kiddie pool, and an Olympic-size swimming pool. The facility is part of a larger entertainment complex that also includes go-kart racing and mini golf. Amenities include daybed and cabana rentals (with lockers, coolers, and Wi-Fi), and season passes offer discounts on rental upgrades. The park operates seasonally and closes during cool weather periods.

Name: Viking Golf & Go-Karts
Description: Viking Golf & Go-Karts is a water play area in Fenwick Island, Delaware. On-site amenities include food service. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Wild Bear Falls Water Park
Description: Wild Bear Falls Water Park is an indoor water play facility in Gatlinburg, Tennessee. On-site attractions include a lazy river. On-site amenities include restrooms, an on-site restaurant, an arcade, shaded seating, lockers, an on-site bar, an adjacent playground, and Wi-Fi. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments. It is open daily.

Name: Soaky Mountain Waterpark
Description: Soaky Mountain Waterpark in Sevierville, Tennessee is an aquatic amusement center featuring tube rides, tunnel flumes, a wave pool, and a lazy river. The facility offers wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking, along with on-site amenities including restrooms, a restaurant, bar, picnic areas, lockers, and cabana rentals. Party services and live performances are available, and advance ticket purchases are recommended.

Name: Lake Days Aqua Park
Description: Lake Days Aqua Park is a water play area in Carlton Landing, Oklahoma. Buying tickets in advance is recommended. On-site amenities include restrooms and cabana rentals. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It accepts credit cards and debit cards. It is open five days a week, including weekends.

Description: Summer Splash Aqua Park in Paragould features a floating inflatable water park with three primary attractions: a launch blob for launching riders into the air, an arch swing slide, and a volcano structure with steep racing slides. The park operates weekends only (Saturday and Sunday, 11 AM to 7:30 PM) and offers multiple admission options including all-day passes, half-day passes, one-hour sessions, and season passes, with group discounts available for parties of 10 or more. Amenities include private cabanas and premier seating areas, an on-site food truck, accessible facilities, restrooms, a playground, and ample parking. The venue sits at Crowley's Ridge State Park on Lake Ponder and welcomes families and children of various ages.

Description: Wild Water Express in Hinton, West Virginia is a free water facility open Tuesday through Saturday from 11 AM to 6 PM, and Sunday from 1 PM to 6 PM (closed Mondays). The venue includes amenities such as parking, restrooms, and a playground, along with a café on-site. It welcomes families and children with accessible facilities available.

Description: Shipwreck Cove Town of Duncan is a pirate-themed water park in Duncan, South Carolina, featuring a lazy river, pools, and waterslides. Admission is free, and the facility offers restrooms, lockers, an on-site restaurant, and a snack bar. Additional amenities include wheelchair-accessible entrances, free parking, an adjacent playground, Wi-Fi, and party services. The venue operates two days per week including weekends and offers active-military discounts.

Name: Discovery Island
Description: Discovery Island Waterpark sits within Simpsonville's Southside Park and features two main water slides (a 185-foot body slide and a 270-foot tube slide on a 25-foot tower), a wave simulator FlowRider, a lazy river, and a zero-depth splash-and-play section with small slides for younger swimmers. Admission ranges from free for children under 2 to $15.50 for guests 48 inches and taller, with discounted rates for younger children and seniors. The facility offers shade structures, a sundeck with lounge chairs, a concession stand, lockers, and party huts, and operates seasonally during summer months.

Name: 7th Inning Splash Park
Description: 7th Inning Splash Park, located at Lakeside Park in Piedmont, features a giant 270-foot funnel slide that drops 3 feet into the main pool, two additional water slides on an 8-foot tower, and a baseball diamond-shaped splash pad covering 5,000 square feet. The facility includes a traditional lap pool with separate shallow and deep sections, shade structures, a sundeck with lounge chairs, party huts, and a concession stand. Admission ranges from free for children under 2 to $9 for those 48 inches and taller, with special rates for seniors and younger visitors. Lockers are available for $7, and the park enforces height restrictions and swimming ability requirements on all slides.

Name: Montage Mountain Resorts
Description: Montage Mountain Resorts waterpark in Scranton features a wavepool, lazy river, and kiddie pool with cabana rentals available at various price points. The facility operates seasonally from late May through early September with weekend-only hours in late May, transitioning to daily 11am–6pm service from mid-June onward. Admission is free, and the venue provides changing rooms, showers, restrooms, lockers, lifeguard supervision, and on-site food service. Entertainment offerings include weekly games and dancing events in the Fun Zone, plus special programming such as adult nights and kids' swim events throughout the season.

Name: The Huether Family Aquatics Center
Description: The Huether Family Aquatics Center in Yankton offers multiple pools and water attractions for all ages. The facility features a Spray Zone with twelve spray jets, a zero-depth Family Pool with a play structure and slides, an Adventure Pool with a Wiggle Bridge and climbing wall, diving boards, water slides, a lazy river with spray channel and vortex pool, and basketball hoops. Open daily with extended hours throughout the week, admission is free and the center includes accessible facilities, parking, restrooms, and a snack bar. The aquatic center also sits adjacent to Fantle Memorial Park, which provides sheltered picnic areas and additional recreational activities.

Name: Wayne County Family Aquatic Center
Description: Wayne County Family Aquatic Center spans over 22,000 square feet and accommodates up to 2,000 visitors at once in Detroit. The facility operates seasonally from late June through the end of summer, open Wednesday through Sunday from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. (with pool closure at 6:30 p.m.). Admission is charged separately for Wayne County residents and non-residents, with free swim diapers provided for those who need them. The center enforces proper swimwear policies and prohibits outside food and beverages.

Name: Water Warrior Island
Description: Water Warrior Island is an aquatic playground located within a Michigan State Park, featuring water slides, runways, swings, jumping pillows, and inflatable bouncers connected in a single complex. The facility includes the Warrior Whoa Slide, a launch-style water slide designed for thrills. Access requires a Michigan Recreation Passport, available for purchase at the park entrance or online. The obstacle course layout challenges visitors with climbing, jumping, balancing, and strength activities suitable for families and children.

Name: Ray’s Splash Planet
Description: Ray's Splash Planet is an indoor water park located on the Irwin Creek Academic Center campus in uptown Charlotte, operated through a partnership between Charlotte-Mecklenburg Parks and Recreation and Charlotte-Mecklenburg Schools. The facility welcomes families and offers swim lessons, birthday parties, and summer camps in addition to recreational water play. Open daily from 4–7:30 PM, the venue provides accessible facilities with parking and restrooms available.

Name: Great Wolf Lodge | Concord
Description: Great Wolf Lodge | Concord is an indoor water play facility in Concord, North Carolina. Admission is free. On-site amenities include shaded seating and Wi-Fi. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Carowinds
Description: Carowinds is a large amusement park straddling the North Carolina–South Carolina border that features over 60 rides alongside a dedicated waterpark area. The park operates seasonally and offers family-friendly attractions including live entertainment, a themed kids' area, on-site lodging options, and dining throughout the grounds. Amenities include parking, picnic areas, and restroom facilities to support day visitors and guests staying at the adjacent hotel or campground.

Name: Six Flags Darien Lake
Description: Six Flags Darien Lake is an amusement park in Corfu, New York, featuring seven roller coasters, live entertainment shows, and three children's themed play areas. Daily admission starts at $35 online and $70 at the gate, with season passes available from $55, and the park offers group discounts, birthday packages, and special pricing for bring-a-friend tickets. The venue includes playgrounds, restrooms, picnic areas, parking, and is accessible to guests of all abilities. Free Pre-K passes are available for children ages 3–5 with a valid 2026 season pass or membership.

Name: Mountain Park Aquatic Center & Activity Building
Description: Mountain Park Aquatic Center features both indoor and outdoor pools with varied depths and attractions. The indoor facilities include a 25-yard by 25-meter lap pool with spectator seating and a year-round instructional pool, while the outdoor leisure pool offers zero-depth entry and water attractions including two giant waterslides, a lazy river, bubble bench, vortex, and interactive water play structures. The outdoor leisure pool operates seasonally on Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, and Labor Day from noon to 6:00 p.m. The facility sits within Stone Mountain Park alongside an activity building, paved trail, accessible parking, and restrooms.
Address: 1063 Rockbridge Rd SW, Stone Mountain, GA 30087

Name: WaterWorks Park
Description: WaterWorks Park in Redding operates daily from 10AM to 6PM throughout the summer season, with select extended hours and closures noted on specific dates. The park offers tiered admission pricing based on age and height, with children under 2 entering free and discounted twilight rates available from 3PM–6PM daily. Facilities include accessible grounds, parking, playgrounds, and restrooms, with on-site dining options and a cashless payment system called Splash Cash accepted at multiple food and retail locations throughout the venue.

Name: River Splash
Description: River Splash is a water play area in Anderson, California. On-site amenities include restrooms and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Palmetto Falls Water Park
Description: Palmetto Falls Water Park in Columbia features a 10,000-square-foot family pool, five water slides with height requirements (36 inches for smaller slides, 48 inches for tower slides), an 800-foot lazy river with zero-depth entry, a 600-square-foot splash pool, and a 2,500-square-foot kiddy pool. The park operates Wednesday through Thursday from 12–5PM, Friday and Saturday from 11AM–6PM, and Sunday from 12–5PM, and closes Monday and Tuesday. Amenities include a snack bar for concessions, accessible facilities, restrooms, a playground, and picnic areas; outside food and beverages are not permitted. The park offers common-use Coast Guard-approved life jackets and enforces height and safety requirements for slides and water features.

On-site amenities include restrooms, an on-site restaurant, an arcade, picnic areas, lockers, cabana rentals, an on-site bar, an adjacent playground, Wi-Fi, and party services. Description: This 22-acre water park operates seasonally from mid-May through early September and charges separate admission beyond general park entry. The facility features multiple body slides including Cannonball Falls (357 feet), Wahini Falls (394 feet), and Jurahnimo Falls (a 76-foot plunge), along with a wave pool called Blue Lagoon, a 2,150-foot lazy river, and Discovery Bay, a multi-level interactive play structure. The park provides restrooms, picnic areas, and parking for guests.

Name: Thundering Surf Waterpark
Description: Thundering Surf Waterpark in Beach Haven features six serpentine tube slides with varying difficulty levels, a 36-foot mat racing slide called Rainbow Rapids, a lazy and wild river attraction with tipping buckets and interactive elements, and a dedicated toddler area with foam slides and spray features. Additional attractions include Cowabunga Beach with mini racer slides and animal-themed sprayers, a FlowRider surf simulator, and private cabanas with shade and seating. The park offers accessible facilities including parking, restrooms, and picnic areas, and has operated as a family-owned venue since 1977.

Name: Castaway Island
Description: Castaway Island is a water play area in Salem, New Hampshire. Buying tickets in advance is recommended. On-site attractions include a lazy river. On-site amenities include restrooms, an on-site restaurant, an arcade, lockers, cabana rentals, an on-site bar, and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It accepts credit cards and debit cards. It is open daily. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Water Wizz of Cape Cod
Description: Water Wizz of Cape Cod features multiple water slides including a recently renovated high-thrill slide with a colorful semi-transparent tunnel, three tube slides down Thunder Falls (two double-rider and one single-rider option), and Mussel Beach, a wave pool with 5-foot waves generated every 10 minutes that accommodates swimmers of all levels. The park operates daily from 10 AM to 7 PM and offers season passes with unlimited visits plus discounts on food and merchandise, as well as variable daily ticket pricing purchased online. Amenities include accessible facilities, parking, and restrooms, and guests may bring one cooler per person with a required cooler pass.

Name: Great Wolf Lodge | New England
Description: Great Wolf Lodge | New England is an indoor water play facility in Fitchburg, Massachusetts. Admission is free. On-site amenities include shaded seating and Wi-Fi. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Fins Up! Water Park
Description: Fins Up! is an indoor water park located within Margaritaville Resort Cape Cod in Hyannis, featuring water slides (with a 48-inch height requirement) and a lazy river. The facility operates Monday–Thursday 3:00 pm–8:00 pm, Friday–Saturday 10:00 am–9:00 pm, and Sunday 10:00 am–8:00 pm, with extended hours during school vacation breaks. Day-pass visitors can rent towels for $8.50, while resort guests receive complimentary towels and a 50% discount on admission. The park includes restrooms, parking, and picnic areas, and accommodates all ages, though children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult; outside food and drinks are not permitted.

Name: Fairmont Aquatic Park
Description: Fairmont Aquatic Park is a water play area in Fairmont, Minnesota. On-site amenities include an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It is open daily.

Name: Sleepy Eye Family Aquatic Center
Description: Sleepy Eye Family Aquatic Center is an aquatic center in Sleepy Eye, Minnesota. On-site amenities include restrooms, food service, and party services. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances.

Name: Mustang Waterpark
Description: Mustang Waterpark operates seasonally from late May through early September, with weekend-only hours (10:30 AM–5 PM Saturday–Sunday) expanding to daily operation from early June through mid-August. The park features two 600-foot curved waterslides, a 38-foot half-pipe tube ride called the Stampede, and separate kiddie pools with three mini-slides and two waterfall mushrooms for younger children. General admission is $33 for guests 42 inches tall or over, $29 for children 42 inches or under, $25 for seniors 65+, and free for children 12 months or younger. The facility sits within Lopez Lake Recreation Area, approximately 10 miles east of Arroyo Grande, and offers amenities including picnic areas, reserved party spaces, cabana rentals with food service, certified lifeguards, restrooms, parking, and a playground.

Amenities include on-site dining and a bar, picnic areas, lockers, cabana rentals, restrooms, wheelchair-accessible entrances, and complimentary parking. On-site amenities include restrooms, food service, shaded seating, lockers, cabana rentals, an adjacent playground, and party services. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments. It is open daily. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Deep River Waterpark
Description: Deep River Waterpark in Crown Point operates daily from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. from late May through mid-August, then weekends only through Labor Day. The facility features multiple slides including speed slides, tube slides, body slides, and a six-lane mat racer, plus a wave pool, slow river ride, interactive family play structure, and children's water play zone. Amenities include parking, restrooms, picnic areas, and shade structures, with the park accessible to all ages.
Address: 9001 E Lincoln Hwy, Crown Point, IN 46307

Name: Freedom Springs Greenwood Aquatics Park
Description: Freedom Springs Greenwood Aquatics Park operates seasonally from late May through early September, with extended hours Monday through Saturday and reduced weekend hours on Sundays. The facility features water slides with multiple twists and turns, a lazy river, and play structures suitable for toddlers through older children, along with cabana rentals for groups. A lazy river, live music performances on an island stage, and special programming like adult-only nights and seasonal events round out the venue's offerings. The park accommodates 1,200 visitors at capacity and provides parking, restrooms, and accessibility features.

Name: River Run Family Water Park
Description: River Run Family Water Park in New Albany features multiple water attractions including waterslides, a lazy river, a bowl slide, a steamboat water play structure, and a dedicated toddler splash pool. The park operates Thursday through Tuesday from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m., with on-site lockers, restrooms, a concession stand, and a tiered lawn area. Birthday parties are available at reserved times with food and drink packages included, and group rates apply to organizations with advance registration. Height and age restrictions apply to certain attractions, with children under 10 requiring adult supervision.
Address: 224 W Daisy Ln, New Albany, IN 47150

Name: The Waterpark
Description: The Waterpark in Carmel operates seasonally from late May through early September, with daily hours from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. through mid-August, then weekends only at reduced hours. The facility features a wave pool (FlowRider®), lazy river, adventure slides, an AquaClimb® wall, and an interactive children's pool, alongside shaded cabana rentals available by the day. Day passes and season passes are available for purchase, with resident discounts offered, and the park provides standard amenities including restrooms, parking, picnic areas, and concessions; lockers are also available for a small fee.
Address: 1195 Central Park Dr W, Carmel, IN 46032

Name: Hurricane Alley Waterpark
Description: Hurricane Alley Waterpark is a seasonal water park in Corpus Christi, Texas, featuring a wave pool and lazy river alongside slides and thrill rides. The facility offers restrooms, an on-site restaurant and bar, picnic areas, and cabana rentals, with an adjacent playground for additional recreation. Wheelchair-accessible entrances and restrooms are available, along with paid parking that accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments. Active-military discounts are provided.

Name: Aquatica Orlando
Description: Aquatica Orlando is a water park featuring marine life shows, waterslides, and aquariums with up-close encounters with dolphins, penguins, and other animals. The park includes a lazy river and wave pool, along with amenities such as restrooms, on-site dining and bar service, locker and cabana rentals, Wi-Fi, and party services. Admission is free, though advance ticket purchase is recommended. The venue offers wheelchair-accessible entrances and free parking, accepts multiple payment methods, provides active-military discounts, and operates daily.

Name: Treasure Cove Water Park
Description: Treasure Cove Water Park is a water park in Orlando, Florida. Admission is free. On-site attractions include a lazy river and a wave pool. On-site amenities include restrooms, an on-site restaurant, an arcade, picnic areas, an on-site bar, an adjacent playground, and Wi-Fi. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. The venue provides free parking and accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments. It features active-military discounts. Admission is free to the park itself, though individual attraction sessions require tickets; special promotions include discounted passes on specific days. The venue provides amenities including food service, cabanas, restrooms, parking, and picnic areas, making it suitable for families seeking varied outdoor activities.

Name: CoCo Key Water Park
Description: CoCo Key is a 54,000 square-foot water park in Orlando that combines indoor canopy-covered and outdoor pools with 14 slides and water rides, including attractions like Boomerango, Surfer's Splash, and Over the Falls, plus interactive splash zones and family-friendly play areas. Located on International Drive as part of a resort property with 391 guest rooms, the park is available daily from 11 AM to 8 PM and includes water park admission with resort stays (additional passes available for purchase). The facility provides cabana rentals, poolside dining at Callaloo Marketplace & Bar, lifeguard supervision, accessibility features, and restrooms, with operations subject to weather conditions and potential closures during lightning or temperatures below 59°F.

Name: Orlando Watersports Complex
Description: Orlando Watersports Complex operates dual cable wake systems and a separate aquapark facility with varying seasonal schedules. The cable park runs March–October from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. and November–February from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m., while the aquapark operates April–August from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. and September–March from noon to 6 p.m. The venue offers lessons, rentals, and a kids program for ages 6–12, along with amenities including a pro shop, dockside grill, lockers, restrooms, parking, and a beach area. Multiple discount programs are available, including Kids Day (50% off), Family Day (50% off for groups of 3–5), and various specialty sessions like Wakeboard Wednesday and Saturday boat rides.

Name: CoCo Key Resort and Water Park Orlando
Description: CoCo Key Resort and Water Park is an indoor-outdoor water facility spanning 54,000 square feet with 14 slides and rides, two pools, and interactive water play zones for guests of all ages. The park features named attractions such as Boomerango, Surfer's Splash, Over the Falls, and Parrot's Perch, along with private cabana rentals for those seeking shaded relaxation. Resort guests receive up to four complimentary water park passes with their stay (daily resort fee of $45 applies, waived for stays of 7+ nights), with additional passes available for purchase. The facility includes dining options, on-site parking, and is located on International Drive near major Orlando attractions; hours vary by weather and daily conditions.

Name: Universal Volcano Bay
Description: Universal Volcano Bay is a water park in Orlando featuring high-thrill slides and rides alongside relaxed pool areas, including a lazy river and wave pool. The venue offers restrooms, on-site dining, lockers, cabana rentals, an adjacent playground, Wi-Fi, and party services, with wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking available. Advance ticket purchase is recommended, and the park operates daily with paid parking and multiple payment options accepted.

Name: Reunion Resort Water Park
Description: Reunion Resort's private water park features an aquatic playground with water cannons, rope bridges, spray jets, and a large dumping bucket, plus a lazy river with waterfalls and water slide access via complimentary tubes. A main water slide accommodates guests 42 inches or taller (30–280 lbs), while most other attractions suit children of all ages in pools with a maximum depth of 4 feet. The park operates year-round daily from 10 AM to 5 PM (hours vary seasonally) and is exclusively available to Reunion Resort guests, WorldMark by Wyndham guests, and members of partner programs, who receive complimentary access with their stay. Amenities include cabana rentals with shade and seating, a lazy river, games such as ping pong and cornhole, restrooms, picnic areas, playground facilities, and parking; food and beverages may be purchased on-site, though outside food and coolers are not permitted.

Name: Surfari Water Park at The Grove Resort
Description: Surfari Water Park is an on-site water park at The Grove Resort in Winter Garden, Florida, featuring a FlowRider Double Surf Simulator, dual water slides, a 695-foot lazy river, and a zero-entry pool. The facility includes a dedicated kids' activities pool and is open daily from 10 AM to 8 PM. Water park access is complimentary for all registered resort guests. The park offers parking, picnic areas, playgrounds, and restrooms to accommodate visitors.
Address: 14501 Grove Resort Ave, Winter Garden, FL 34787

Name: Disney's Blizzard Beach Water Park
Description: Disney's Blizzard Beach Water Park in Bay Lake, Florida is a themed aquatic venue featuring a lazy river, waterslides, and a designated kids' zone. The park offers free admission and operates daily with wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking available. On-site amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, and an adjacent playground for additional recreation.

Name: Ship Wreck Island Water Park
Description: Ship Wreck Island Water Park is a water park in Kissimmee, Florida. Admission is free. Buying tickets in advance is recommended. On-site attractions include a lazy river. On-site amenities include restrooms, an on-site restaurant, an arcade, picnic areas, an on-site bar, an adjacent playground, and Wi-Fi. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. The venue provides free parking and accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments. It is open daily.

Active-military discounts and live performances are available.

Name: Disney's Typhoon Lagoon Water Park
Description: Disney's Typhoon Lagoon Water Park in Lake Buena Vista, Florida, features water slides, a children's splash area, and a swimming lagoon with wave-like swells. The park provides free admission and includes restrooms, picnic areas, and an adjacent playground. Wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and accessible restrooms are available on-site.

Name: Sesame Place Philadelphia
Description: Sesame Place Philadelphia is a Sesame Street-themed amusement park in Langhorne featuring rides, water slides, a lazy river, and a wave pool. Admission is free, though advance ticket purchase is recommended. The venue offers on-site dining, an arcade, locker and cabana rentals, restrooms, Wi-Fi, and party services, along with wheelchair-accessible entrances and complimentary parking. Additional amenities include live performances, active-military discounts, an on-site bar, and an adjacent playground, with the park open daily and welcoming all guests.

Name: Three Bear Waterpark
Description: Three Bear Waterpark is an indoor facility at the Holiday Inn Express & Suites in Brainerd featuring multiple slides including two 300-foot slides, a 1,000-gallon dumping bucket, a lazy river, activity pool with basketball hoops, and separate tot and younger children's slides, all filled with 250,000 gallons of heated water. The park operates year-round with extended summer hours and includes lifeguard supervision, locker rooms, a food bar, and family and adult hot tubs. Hotel guests receive waterpark access included with their stay, while day passes for outside visitors start at $20 on weekdays and $30 on Saturdays, though capacity limits apply and advance contact is required.

A 50-meter competition pool provides lap lanes, diving platforms, and slides. The park operates daily from mid-May through mid-August, then weekends only through Labor Day, with extended hours during the week and night swim sessions on select Tuesdays.

Description: Wetlands Waterpark in Great Bend operates daily from 12:30 to 5:30 PM during the summer season, opening the Saturday before Memorial Day with extended Family Swim Night hours on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 7:00 to 9:00 PM. Admission is affordable, with children ages 3–17 charged $3.00, adults $4.00, and children under 2 free; discounted punch passes are available for $40 (15 admissions). The facility includes restrooms, parking, picnic areas, and a playground, and offers group rates for parties of 10 or more. The park requires a forecasted high temperature of at least 75 degrees to open and may close due to inclement weather without refunds.

Name: Oceans of Fun
Description: Oceans of Fun is a water park situated within the larger Worlds of Fun theme park complex in Kansas City, Missouri, which spans over 325 acres across multiple international-themed areas. Description: Aqua Land Splash Pad is a water play area in Newmarket, New Hampshire. On-site amenities include an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It is open daily.

Name: Water Country Water Park
Description: Water Country Water Park in Portsmouth, New Hampshire is a large aquatic facility featuring themed pools, water slides, and an adventure river for family recreation. The park provides free admission and includes on-site restrooms, picnic areas, and an adjacent playground. Wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restroom facilities are available for visitor convenience.

Name: River Ranch Water Park
Description: River Ranch Water Park in High Springs features a 15,000 square-foot wave pool, a 600-foot lazy river, a water slide (for children 42 inches and taller), and two sand volleyball courts. The facility operates mid-April through the end of August and is primarily reservation-based, though specific Community Event Days allow walk-up admission with payment at the gate. Amenities include covered picnic areas, restrooms with shower facilities, locker rentals, and snack machines. Groups of any size can book private events, and evening sessions are available for larger parties.

Description: SouthTown Wake Park is a water play area in Rock Hill, South Carolina. Buying tickets in advance is recommended. Name: Neptune Island Waterpark
Description: Neptune Island Waterpark in Hartsville features multiple water attractions across its sprawling grounds. The facility includes Piratesville Splash Pad with water jets, cannons, dumping buckets, and slides for younger guests, along with larger attractions like the Castaway Bay Wave Pool, Endless Abyss Lazy River, and several speed and tube slides with varying height requirements. The park operates seasonally from mid-May through Labor Day, with general admission opening May 17, 2026, and offers both daily tickets and season passes at multiple price points. Amenities include lockers, restrooms, parking, and picnic areas to support visitors throughout their stay.

The venue includes a lazy river and go-karts, along with an arcade, food service, and picnic areas. Wheelchair-accessible entrances and restrooms are available, with on-site paid parking that accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments. Hotel guests receive complimentary waterpark passes with their room reservation, with pass quantities varying by accommodation type. The waterpark is within walking distance of Arnolds Park Amusement Park and features accessible amenities including restrooms, parking, picnic areas, playground access, and shaded areas.

Description: Splashway Waterpark in Sheridan, Texas is a family-friendly water park offering a lazy river, wave pool, and mini golf, with free admission (advance ticket purchase recommended). Description: Six Flags Great Escape Lodge & Indoor Waterpark is an amusement park with water attractions in Queensbury, New York. Admission is free. On-site amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, shaded seating, and Wi-Fi. The venue is described as LGBTQ+ friendly.

Name: Salty Pirate Waterpark
Description: Salty Pirate Waterpark is a compact outdoor water park in Emerald Isle, North Carolina, featuring tube and mat slides along with a dedicated children's area and deck space. Admission is free, and the facility offers restrooms, food service, an arcade, picnic areas, and lockers. Parking is complimentary, party services are available, and the venue accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments, with active-military discounts offered.

Description: Willow Lakes Resort Community is a water play area in Logan, Utah. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Crystal Hot Springs
Description: Crystal Hot Springs in Honeyville offers hot spring swimming and waterslide access daily from noon to 11 PM. General admission is $18 for adults, with discounted rates for children under 3 (free), seniors, military, and college students; waterslide access costs an additional $2 per person. The facility features lockers available for rent and welcomes families, children, and toddlers with group discounts available for parties of 20 or more. Outside food is not permitted, and the venue provides parking, restrooms, and accessibility accommodations.

Name: Colburn Park & The Old Cannery Splash Pad
Description: The Old Cannery Splash Pad at Colburn Park in Fife operates seasonally from late May through summer, with limited weekend hours in late May and early June before expanding to daily operation from mid-June onward. The facility opens at 9 a.m. to sunset Tuesday through Sunday, and noon to sunset on Mondays, with restrooms available during operating hours. Visitors can enjoy the splash pad grounds or reserve one of two private cabanas (Orca and Octopus) available daily from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. for gatherings and birthday parties, each accommodating up to 10 people with seating and amenities.

Description: CaliBunga Waterpark in San Jose operates seasonally on weekends, opening at 11 AM and closing at 5 PM on Saturdays and Sundays. The park offers season passes that pay for themselves within two visits, along with single-day tickets for seasonal access. Visitors can rent private cabanas throughout the grounds, which include amenities like tables, chairs, food service, and secure storage. The facility provides parking, picnic areas, restrooms, and a playground, making it suitable for families and children.

Description: Aqua Adventure Water Park in Fremont offers tiered daily admission pricing, with separate rates for residents and non-residents. Children under 48 inches pay a reduced fare, while children 3 and under wearing swim diapers cost $4. The park also sells season passes for 2026, with all ticket purchases being non-refundable and non-transferable.

Name: Oak Hill Park Splash Pad
Description: Oak Hill Park Splash Pad is a water play area in St Louis Park, Minnesota. On-site amenities include an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It is open daily. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Wapakoneta Waterpark
Description: Wapakoneta Waterpark is a water park in Wapakoneta, Ohio. On-site amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It is open daily.

Name: Niles Park District Oasis Waterpark
Description: Niles Park District Oasis Waterpark in Niles, Illinois is a public aquatic facility featuring a zero-depth entry pool, splash pad playground, and water slides. The venue provides on-site food service, picnic areas, and an adjacent playground, along with wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It operates daily.

Name: Mystic Waters Family Aquatic Center
Description: Mystic Waters Family Aquatic Center in Des Plaines operates seasonally from late May through mid-August, with extended hours on weekends and weekdays during peak season. The facility features multiple water attractions including Beluga Beach splash pad, Otters Run with slides and concessions, Dolphin Bay, and Crocodile Cove, along with a lazy river. Amenities include free lockers, complimentary lifejacket checkout, picnic areas where outside food is permitted, shaded cabanas available for reservation, and accessible facilities with ample parking and restrooms throughout the center.

Name: Burbank Park District Water Park (Seasonal)
Description: Burbank Park District Water Park operates seasonally during summer months with evening hours from 4–7 PM daily. The facility provides parking, picnic areas, restrooms, and accessibility accommodations for all ages and families. Registration for programs and activities is available both online and in person, with resident rates available upon proof of residency.

Name: The Water Works Indoor Water Park
Description: The Water Works is an indoor aquatic facility within Schaumburg's Community Recreation Center, featuring three water slides, a rapid water channel, sprayground, diving pool, lap pool, zero-depth entry pool, and whirlpool. Open swim hours vary seasonally, running from late afternoon through evening during spring and expanding to daytime hours from late May through early August, with admission fees for residents starting at $10 per person. The facility includes family changing rooms and requires children age 8 and under to have guardian supervision; certain slides have height requirements of 42 and 48 inches. During summer, three additional outdoor pools—Archer Island (with slides and children's spray area), Bock Pool (with diving boards and climbing wall), and Meineke Pool (with Olympic-sized lap pool and diving platform)—provide extended water recreation options.

Name: Park District of Forest Park Aquatic Center
Description: Park District of Forest Park Aquatic Center is an aquatic center in Forest Park, Illinois. On-site amenities include restrooms. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. The water play is designed for visitors of all ages.

Name: Splash Harbor
Description: Splash Harbor operates seasonally from June through August, with weekday hours from noon to 6 p.m. and weekend hours from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. Admission is affordable, with single-day passes available for $3 at the gate, punch passes ranging from $12 to $20, or a family season pass for $100. Residents can attend free with proof of a Splash Pass. The facility welcomes families and includes restroom facilities on-site.

Name: Itasca Water Park
Description: Itasca Water Park features a zero-depth main pool with eight lanes, vortex sprayers, and bubbler bench seating, alongside a dive well offering both high and low diving boards and a drop slide. The facility also includes a family interactive pool with play equipment and a 185-foot waterslide. The park operates seasonally and offers free admission, with a $2 resident discount available for those with a SPLASH ID Card. Lifeguards are on duty during operating hours, and the park provides restrooms, parking, and picnic areas for visitors.

Name: The Beach Waterpark
Description: The Beach Waterpark is a water park in Wood Dale, Illinois. On-site amenities include restrooms and picnic areas. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances.
Address: Located at, 161 W Commercial St, Wood Dale, IL 60191

Name: Lily Pad Splash Pad
Description: Lily Pad Splash Pad is a water play area in Chicago Ridge, Illinois.

Name: Skokie Water Playground
Description:
The Skokie Water Playground is the larger of the two outdoor aquatic facilities at the Skokie Park District, next to the Oakton Community Center, at the corner of Skokie Blvd. and Oakton St.

Take a leisurely dip in our 14,000 square foot main pool with beach entry, play in our fully accessible splash pad, take a ride down one of our three big slides or take the challenge and stand beneath the big red bucket and get drenched by 300 gallons of water! Then take a break and visit our concession stand and have a cool drink or a frozen treat.

Name: Rainbow Falls Waterpark
Description: Rainbow Falls Waterpark in Elk Grove Village is a seasonal water park featuring a tropical theme with multiple pools and water rides, including a large four-way slide. The facility provides restrooms, picnic areas, wheelchair-accessible entrances, and dedicated parking for visitors.
Address: 200 Rev Morrison Blvd, Elk Grove Village, IL 60007

Name: Splash in the Boro Waterpark - Statesboro, Bulloch County
Description: Splash in the Boro is a year-round aquatic facility in Statesboro that serves all ages with swimming lessons, aquatic exercise programs, and swim team activities. The center operates Monday through Thursday from 6 a.m. to 8 p.m. and Friday from 6 a.m. to 2 p.m., with Saturday lap swimming from 8–10 a.m. ($7) and family fun swim from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. ($10). The venue accommodates group outings, birthday parties, and corporate events, and offers parking, picnic areas, and restroom facilities. Visitors can sign up for weather and temperature notifications via text or email.

Name: Whirlin' Waters Adventure Waterpark
Description: Whirlin' Waters Adventure Waterpark spans over 15 acres within North Charleston Wannamaker County Park, offering island-themed water attractions for visitors of all ages. General admission is $24.99 per person, with discounted rates available for children under 48 inches ($19.99), seniors 60 and older ($14.99), and children under 2 (free); afternoon pricing of $15.99 applies Monday–Friday after 3 p.m. (excluding major holidays). The facility provides locker rentals ranging from $10 to $15 depending on size, along with restrooms, parking, picnic areas, and accessible amenities. The waterpark operates seasonally and is currently closed for the season.

Name: Charleston Aqua Park
Description: Charleston Aqua Park is a seasonal water adventure facility operating May through September at Trophy Lakes on Johns Island, featuring a giant floating inflatable obstacle course with slides, monkey bars, climbing walls, bounce platforms, and balance obstacles. Open to ages 6 and up (swimmers only), the park offers 45-minute sessions starting at $18 per person, with life jackets provided and certified lifeguards on duty. The venue also features an above-water ropes course with zipline, cable-pulled boogie boarding, and a summer day camp program. Groups of 10 or more receive discounted rates, and the park accommodates birthday parties, corporate team-building events, and school field trips.

Name: Avalanche Bay Indoor Waterpark
Description: Avalanche Bay is an indoor water play facility in Boyne Falls maintained at a consistent 84 degrees year-round. Guests can choose between full-day passes or evening-only admission options to suit their schedule. The facility includes accessibility features, parking, a playground, restrooms, and shaded areas for families and children.
Address: 1 Boyne Mountain Rd, Boyne Falls, MI 49713

Description: Splash Down Family Water Park in Spokane Valley is a free-admission aquatic facility offering body and tube slides along with a water-balloon-fight area. The park provides restrooms, picnic areas, and wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking. An adjacent playground and concession stand are available on-site. The park operates one day per week.
Address: 11127 E Mission Ave, Spokane Valley, WA 99206

Admission ranges from free for children ages two and under to $8 for ages 6–59, with discounted rates for seniors. The facility includes a playground, snack bar, restrooms, accessible amenities, and parking; children under 12 must be accompanied by a responsible adult 18 or older.

Name: Broadview Heights Splash Park
Description: Broadview Heights Splash Park is a 3,000-square-foot water play area located at 9543 Broadview Road on the Broadview Center campus, adjacent to a playground. The facility operates daily from 11 AM to 8 PM on weekdays and 11 AM to 6 PM on weekends, from Memorial Day through Labor Day (weather permitting), with free admission. Water play features include multiple spray jets and interactive elements, and the site provides restrooms, a concession stand serving hot dogs and snacks, parking, and a pavilion. The park is accessible and welcomes families with children and toddlers.

Name: Water Works Family Aquatic Center
Description: Water Works Family Aquatic Center operates as a seasonal facility within Water Works Park in Cuyahoga Falls and offers a lazy river, deep-end swimming area, and water slides for visitors of all ages. The center requires valid government-issued photo identification for all guests 16 and older and permits season pass holders to bring up to two guests on designated days. Poolside cabanas are available for rent at $60 for members and $75 for non-members, each furnished with seating and a table. The facility provides parking, restrooms, and shade options through its cabana rental program.

Description: Aquatica San Antonio is a South Seas–inspired water park featuring thrill rides, beaches, and an underwater grotto with tropical fish. Description: The Cove Aquatic Center at Crawford features a lazy river, diving board, slide, water basketball court, and separate toddler pool alongside its main swimming area. Admission is free to the facility, which provides accessibility accommodations, parking, and restroom facilities suitable for families and children of all ages. The center enforces a color-banded swim test system for visitors under 16 to ensure safe access to different water areas, with supervision requirements varying by age group. Party rentals are available year-round, including an Island Party package that reserves a private area within the lazy river for groups up to 30 people.

Name: Troy Aquatic Park
Description: Troy Aquatic Park in Troy, Ohio is a water park featuring two giant waterslides, a drop slide, and multiple pools including a zero-depth area for younger visitors. The facility provides on-site amenities such as food service, lockers, and party services, along with wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms.

Name: Currents Waterpark at Embassy Suites Myrtle Beach Resort
Description: Currents Waterpark at Embassy Suites Myrtle Beach Resort operates as an exclusive guest amenity with two separate waterpark areas and a large pool deck. The waterpark features two slides for older children (48-inch minimum height requirement) alongside a dedicated kids' section with smaller slides, water play features, and a dumping bucket, while the main pool deck offers zero-depth entry, a 145,000-gallon pool, and hot tub access. The facility runs daily from 9 a.m. to sunset for the waterpark and 8 a.m. to sunset for the pool, with a pool deck open until 10 p.m., and includes amenities such as shaded seating, food service, restrooms, picnic areas, and parking. Cabanas, fire pits, and kids' activities are available during the summer season, with food and drink service from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. and online ordering extending to sunset.

Name: Myrtle Waves Water Park
Description: Myrtle Waves Water Park features multiple water attractions including the Super Chute body slide with a 20-foot enclosed tube and vertical drop, the Turbo Twisters high-speed enclosed slides, South Carolina's largest wave pool with depths ranging from zero to six feet, and a 330,000-gallon lazy river offering a gentle current tube ride. The park accommodates guests of various ages and heights, with specific height requirements for certain slides and supervision guidelines for younger children. Free admission makes this Myrtle Beach water park accessible to families seeking a full day of water activities with available parking, picnic areas, playgrounds, and restroom facilities.
Address: 3000 Mr. Joe White Ave, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577

Description: Southern Pines Water Park in Dublin, Georgia operates seasonally from late May through early September, with extended weekend-only hours in August and early September. The facility features a lazy river, splash pad, covered and uncovered slides, and an inflatable slide, along with cabana rentals and a concession stand. Amenities include picnic areas, playground equipment, accessible facilities, restrooms, and parking. Season passes are available for purchase during March each year through the Dublin Laurens County Recreation Authority office.

Description: Hurricane Harbor Rockford sits east of I-90 near Rockford and features Illinois' largest wave pool alongside 11 attractions including a 1,200-foot lazy river. Name: MWR Mid-South Splash Park
Description: The Navy MWR Mid-South Splash Park in Millington features motion-activated water apparatus that respond to visitor presence. Located within the secured Naval Support Activity Mid-South base, the facility is restricted to authorized military patrons and their guests, and operates daily from 8 AM to 8 PM. The splash park includes a playground, parking, restrooms, and is designed to serve families and children seeking water recreation during warm months.

Description: Community Splash Pad & Ice Cream Cafe is a water play area in Somerville, Tennessee. On-site amenities include restrooms, food service, an arcade, and an adjacent playground. The park operates seasonally from late May through early August, with public swim sessions running Monday through Saturday from 12:30 pm to 7:00 pm and Sunday from 12:30 pm to 6:00 pm. Admission is free, and the facility offers accessible parking, restrooms, and locker rooms. Children under 10 must be accompanied by an adult age 16 or older, and swimmers must have lifeguards on duty before entering the water.

Name: River Country Water Park
Description: River Country Water Park is a water park in River Ranch, Florida. Admission is free. On-site amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It is open daily.

Name: Lake Eva Aquatic Center
Description: Lake Eva Aquatic Center's Janet J. Smith Aquatic Facility includes a shallow zero-depth entry pool that transitions from a splash-pad area into a deeper 5-foot lap swim section with three 25-yard lanes. The facility operates seasonally from late March through October 2026, with weekend-only hours in spring and fall, daily operation during summer months from noon to 6 p.m., and admission at $5 per person (ages 3 and up). Accessible parking, restrooms, and an on-site concession stand are available, with a weather monitoring system that closes the facility during lightning detection. Children under 13 must be supervised by an adult age 18 or older.

Name: Champions Splash Park
Description: Champions Splash Park is a free water play facility located within Clermont's Waterfront Park, designed for families and young children. The splash pad operates with a maximum capacity of 74 people and enforces rules including mandatory adult supervision, swim diapers only, and shower requirements before entering. Private group rentals are available through the City of Clermont Parks and Recreation. The facility includes restrooms, parking, a playground, and is fully accessible.

Name: Splash Kingdom Air Patrol
Description: Splash Kingdom Air Patrol in Greenville, Texas features a lazy river, water slides including Splash Landing, and splash zones designed for children and families. The park opens May 23, 2026, and operates seven days a week with season passes and daily admission available. On-site amenities include food and beverage options, accessible facilities, restrooms, parking, and a playground. Admission is free, and the facility includes restrooms, parking, and a playground, plus on-site food and beverage options. Private cabanas and group party packages are available for special events.

Name: North Clackamas Aquatic Park
Description: North Clackamas Aquatic Park is an indoor facility maintained at 86 degrees year-round, featuring a lap pool, dive well, and Big Surf wave pool (available weekends during the school year). The park offers free admission with optional annual memberships that provide unlimited access to select programs and facilities, with pricing tiers for residents, non-residents, youth, seniors, and families. The venue includes accessible restrooms, parking, a playground, and offers sensory-friendly swim sessions with reduced noise and lighting for swimmers with sensory sensitivities. Locker keys are available for a $5 cash deposit or photo ID.

Description: Surfari Joes Indoor Wilderness Water Park is an indoor water play facility in Watervliet, Michigan. On-site attractions include a lazy river. On-site amenities include restrooms, an on-site restaurant, an arcade, shaded seating, lockers, an on-site bar, an adjacent playground, Wi-Fi, and party services. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It accepts credit cards and debit cards. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Description: Double JJ Resort in Rothbury, Michigan is a country ranch property offering cozy suites and cabins alongside a water park, golf course, and various activities. Admission to the resort is free, and guests have access to on-site Wi-Fi during their stay.

Name: Splash Country Indoor & Outdoor Waterpark
Description: Splash Country is a year-round waterpark in Branson featuring both indoor and outdoor attractions. The indoor facility includes a 5,000-square-foot wave pool with 3-foot waves, a three-level interactive treehouse with a 1,000-gallon tipping bucket, tube slides, two racing raft rides, a dark raft slide, a 250-foot lazy river, and a basketball activity pool, along with children's areas like Froggie Bog and a dedicated young children's pool. The outdoor section operates seasonally with an interactive playground. Open weekdays 2–9 PM and weekends 10 AM–9 PM, the park is accessible with restrooms, shade, picnic areas, and parking available.
