Description: The Boardwalk at Hersheypark is a water park included with general admission to Hersheypark, operating from May 23 through September 7. The facility features a lazy river, water slides, and lounge seating areas. Admission is bundled with park tickets, which grant access to Hersheypark rides and coasters as well as ZooAmerica. The park offers seasonal and daily ticket options at varying prices, with facilities including restrooms, picnic areas, parking, and accessibility features.

Name: Splash Zone Waterpark At James Island County Park
Description: Splash Zone Waterpark at James Island County Park is a seasonal outdoor water attraction featuring waterslides and a lazy river. The facility offers restrooms, an on-site restaurant, picnic areas, lockers, and cabana rentals, along with wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking. An adjacent playground, Wi-Fi access, and party services are also available on-site.

Name: Splash Island Waterpark
Description: Splash Island Waterpark is a seasonal family water park in Mt Pleasant, South Carolina, featuring a shallow pool with fountains, sprays, and slides, along with a water chute and lazy river. The facility offers restrooms, an on-site restaurant, picnic areas, cabana rentals, Wi-Fi, and party services, with wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms available.

Name: Shawnee Splash Water park
Description: Shawnee Splash Water park is a water park in Shawnee, Oklahoma. On-site amenities include restrooms and picnic areas. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances.

Name: Anderson Aquatic Center
Description: Anderson Aquatic Center is an aquatic center in Normal, Illinois. On-site amenities include restrooms. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking.

Name: Aquaboggan Water Park
Description: Aquaboggan is a seasonal water park in Saco, Maine that operates all summer starting June 27th and runs seven days a week. The park features multiple water slides including the Turbo Drop (48" height minimum), Pipeline (three twisting slides), the Yankee Ripper, and a 750,000-gallon wave pool, plus a toddler splash area with shallow pool and playground equipment. Beyond water attractions, the facility includes mini golf, go-karts (54" height minimum), and bumper boats (48" height minimum, noon–4 p.m. hours). Free parking, picnic areas, lounge chairs, private cabana rentals, and on-site concessions are available.

Name: Pirate Cove Water Park
Description: Pirate Cove Water Park in Council Bluffs features a Z-shaped pool with zero-depth entry, a pirate ship play structure with slide, a diving board, and two water slides (one covered, one open) that empty into a separate splash pool. General admission is $5, or $6 to include slide access, with punch card options available; the park operates daily from noon to 6 p.m. from late May through July. The facility offers shaded seating, concessions, restrooms, parking, and a picnic area, and welcomes families with swim lessons and private party rentals available throughout the season.

The facility includes a splash area alongside the amusement park, offering accessible amenities such as restrooms, parking, snack concessions, and shaded cabana rentals with tables and fans. Online ticket purchases are encouraged, and the venue offers military and healthcare worker discounts at the gate. The park welcomes families and children of all ages throughout its operating season.

Name: WildWater Cullman
Description: WildWater Cullman is a water play area in Cullman, Alabama. Admission is free. Buying tickets in advance is recommended. On-site attractions include a wave pool. On-site amenities include restrooms, an on-site restaurant, lockers, cabana rentals, an on-site bar, and party services. The venue provides free parking and accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments.

Description: Moody Splash Pad is a water play area in Moody, Alabama. On-site amenities include restrooms, food service, and party services. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms.

Name: Santa’s Village Amusement & Water Park
Description: Santa’s Village Amusement & Water Park is a water park in East Dundee, Illinois. Admission is free. On-site amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances.

Name: Atcher Island Water Park
Description: Atcher Island Water Park is a tropical-themed facility in Schaumburg featuring multiple water slides, including a distinctive circular drop slide, plus a children's sprayground with interactive play elements. The park enforces height requirements of 42 inches for flume body slides and 48 inches for the bowl slide. During summer months, three outdoor pools operate alongside the sprayground and playground areas. On-site concessions, restrooms, picnic areas, and additional parking at a nearby school support visitor needs.

Name: Silverlake: The Family Place
Description: Silverlake: The Family Place is a water play area in Erlanger, Kentucky. On-site amenities include restrooms and a basketball court. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. The venue provides free parking and accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments. It is open daily. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Description: Water World in Dothan features multiple body slides of varying heights and intensities, including a 40-foot tower with three slides and a 4-story plunge slide, along with a dedicated Kids Cove area with tippy buckets, water cannons, and an enclosed slide for younger visitors. The park's main attraction is a 450,000-gallon wave pool that generates 3-foot waves every 10 minutes and includes a carpeted beach area. Admission is free, and the park offers on-site parking, picnic areas, restrooms, and accessibility accommodations, plus concessions including snack bars and pizza service.

Name: Days Inn Hotel & Governors' Waterpark, RV Park & Fitness Center
Description: Governors' Water Park is an indoor facility at the Days Inn in Casselton that operates year-round and offers two swimming pools, a five-story children's play structure, and an oversized hot tub. Admission is complimentary for hotel guests and fitness center members, while day passes are available for non-guests. The park provides restrooms, parking, and picnic areas, and welcomes visitors of all ages. Note that the large water slide is currently closed for repairs.

Name: Raging Rivers Waterpark
Description: Raging Rivers Waterpark in Mandan opens seasonally from late May through mid-August, with varying daily hours depending on the time period and weather conditions. The park features an 850-foot lazy river, tube and speed slides of 45 and 66 feet respectively, and a kiddie pool play area with an Aqua Play Unit. Amenities include a bath house, rental areas, concessions, picnic areas, and restrooms. Admission is available through daily passes or season passes at multiple price points, with special discounted programming for young children on select mornings in July.

Name: King's Pointe Resort
Description: King's Pointe Resort in Storm Lake features both indoor and outdoor waterpark facilities with updated slides and amenities for families with children of all ages. The indoor waterpark operates year-round except for seasonal closures in fall and winter, while the outdoor waterpark is seasonal; waterpark access can be added to room reservations at check-in. The resort is situated on Storm Lake and includes on-site dining, fire pits, mini-golf, and direct access to lakeside trails and beaches. Parking is available for guests.

Description: The Adventure Lagoon is a floating aquatic park on a freshwater lake in Anaheim that operates Friday through Sunday from 10:30 AM to 6 PM, with the 2026 season beginning May 21st. The facility features multiple inflatable obstacle structures including the Aquaglide Ring Monsoon XXL, Thunderdome with climbing handles and slides, Kaos bouncing dome, Freefall Supreme and Freefall Extreme slides, Jungle Joe climbing tower, and Monkey Dome. General admission is $35 for ages 6+ on weekdays and $40 on weekends, with reduced rates for seniors (65+) and young children (3-5 for $10, under 2 free), plus additional paid activities like paddleboard and kayak rentals. Description: Brightwater Lagoon in North Fort Myers offers a floating obstacle course, water slide, and splash pad with shallow water features designed for young children. Name: White Water
Description: White Water is a large, island-themed water park in Branson, Missouri, featuring pools, a lazy river, a wave pool, and water rides alongside a dedicated kids' area. The venue offers restrooms, food service, picnic areas, lockers, and shaded cabana rentals available for rent. Wheelchair-accessible entrances and restrooms are provided, and free parking is available on-site. Advance ticket purchases are recommended, and the park also offers party services.

Name: Hurricane Harbor Chicago
Description: Hurricane Harbor Chicago is a water park in Gurnee featuring a lazy river, wave pool, and water-based thrill rides alongside kiddie zones. The venue offers on-site dining, picnic areas, lockers, and cabana rentals, with wheelchair-accessible entrances and restrooms available. Go-karts are also available on-site. Advance ticket purchases are recommended, and paid parking is provided.

Name: Awesome Lazy River
Description: Awesome Lazy River operates on the actual Salt River in Shepherdsville, Kentucky, offering tubing trips that typically last about two hours depending on water levels. The facility is open seasonally for the 2026 season on Saturdays and Sundays, with operating status posted to Facebook by 9 a.m. each day based on weather and dam water release. Life jackets are mandatory for all participants, and children must be at least 5 years old to tube; tubes are available for rent along with paddles, and cooler floats are also offered. The venue provides restrooms and parking, welcomes outside food and non-alcoholic beverages (no glass bottles), and sells water and ice on-site.

Name: Bluegrass Splash Family Aquatic Center
Description: Bluegrass Splash Family Aquatic Center in Hopkinsville features multiple water attractions including a swimming pool, lazy river, splash zone, and two tube slides—Hurricane Alley and Riptide Express. The facility offers hundreds of lounge chairs for relaxation and operates a poolside snack bar called The Snack Attack. Daily admission discounts are available after 4 PM on weekdays (excluding holidays), and a "Funday Monday" promotion offers a buy-one-get-one-free deal. Season passes are available starting at $70 for individuals and $59 for military members with valid active duty identification.

Name: Tropicanoe Cove
Description: Tropicanoe Cove, located within Lafayette's Columbian Park, features water slides including the Riptide Racer, Tiki Twist, Banana Peel tube slide, and Cattail Crik lazy river. The facility operates from late May through early September 2026, with weekend-only hours starting in August, and offers season passes and Family Nights on the first Wednesday of each month. Amenities include parking near Main and Scott Streets, private cabana rentals with shade and concessions delivery, a water walking program for ages 13 and up, and access to the larger Columbian Park for picnicking outside the water park.

Name: Chaos Water Park
Description: Chaos Water Park in Eau Claire offers multiple water attractions including a two-story tube slide called Hurricane Run, a looping body slide (Twister, currently closed for refurbishment), a lazy river, and an indoor aquatic playground with kiddie slides, water gun stations, and an 8-foot dump bucket. The facility operates seasonally with varying hours: Thursday 4–9PM, Friday and Saturday 9AM–9PM, and Sunday 9AM–5PM; admission is free for children under one year, with discounted rates for children under 36 inches. Additional amenities include an activity pool with basketball hoops and lily pads, a double hot tub, free towels, and complimentary life jackets (first come, first serve); the park also offers special pricing like Thursday night swim deals and toddler swim sessions on select Fridays. Parking, restrooms, picnic areas, and a playground are available on-site.

Daily admission is $6 per person for ages 2 and up, with free entry for infants under 2, and group rates available for parties of 15 or more. Located within Wakanda Park, the facility offers restrooms, picnic areas, and parking, with pool rental options and a party room available for special events.

Name: Shores of Asbury RV Resort
Description: The Shores of Asbury is a lakeside RV resort and campground in Anderson, South Carolina, offering day-visit access to its aquatic amenities. The property features the Aqua Zone, a seasonal floating water obstacle course on Lake Hartwell, along with a playground and restroom facilities. Parking and accessibility accommodations are available, and admission is free for day visitors. The resort caters to families, kids, and toddlers seeking recreational water play during the operating season.

Name: Quiet Waters Park
Description: Quiet Waters Park in Deerfield Beach, Florida is a recreational facility offering cable water-skiing, fishing, bike trails, and basketball courts, along with a campground for overnight stays. The park features a playground and provides wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking. Admission is free, and the park is open daily.

Group rates are available for parties of 15 or more, with advance tickets priced at $14 for adults and $10 for children, or walk-up weekend rates of $15 and $11 respectively. Description: Calypso Cove Aquatic Facility is an aquatic center in Margate, Florida. On-site amenities include restrooms, food service, and party services. The venue provides paid parking.

Name: Paradise Cove Water Park
Description: Paradise Cove Water Park sits within C.B. Smith Park in Pembroke Pines and operates seasonally with varying schedules—weekends only through late May, daily during spring break and mid-June through mid-August, and weekends again in late August through September. The park features four tall corkscrew waterslides (395–430 feet long) that empty into a deep plunge pool, Sharky's Lagoon with interactive play elements and three shorter slides for all ages, Parrot's Point designed for children under 5 with a shallow pool and two small slides, and Crazy Creek, a 410-foot meandering tube ride. All-day admission is $15 per person, with discounted rates after 3PM and free entry for children under 1; seasonal passes are also available. Amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, parking, a concession facility, and rentable umbrellas with tables for shade.
Address: 900 N Flamingo Rd, Pembroke Pines, FL 33028

Name: High Falls Water Park
Description: High Falls Water Park is a water park in Jackson, Georgia. Admission is free. On-site amenities include restrooms and picnic areas. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms.

Name: The Dinosaur Place
Description: The Dinosaur Place in Oakdale features a zero-depth water playground alongside its dinosaur-themed attractions, opening May 22 on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays when temperatures exceed 70°F. The water play area includes changing rooms and locker rentals ($5–$8), with restrooms and free parking available throughout the park. Located within a larger dinosaur park that spans 1.5 miles of nature trails with life-sized dinosaurs, a playscape for ages 2–11, and a maze, the facility is wheelchair accessible on well-packed gravel paths. Admission is free to the park, though some activities and lockers carry additional fees.

Description: Sears Splash is a water play area in Abilene, Texas. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Adventure Cove
Description: Adventure Cove is a water park in Abilene featuring a zero-depth beach entry, lazy river, and tall slides (height requirement 48 inches). The facility operates daily with varying hours—Sunday through Monday from 1:00 PM to 7:00 PM, and Tuesday through Saturday from 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Single day admission is available, as well as single and family season passes ($65 and $250 respectively for up to 4 members). The park includes lockers, sells sunscreen and swim supplies, and enforces supervision rules for children under 15; visitors are welcome to bring Coast Guard-approved flotation devices.

Name: Splash Kingdom Timber Falls
Description: Splash Kingdom Timber Falls is a water park in Nacogdoches featuring multiple slides including the Lumberjack and a Lazy River. The park opens May 23, 2026, and operates Monday–Sunday from 11am to 6pm through July 31st, with extended hours starting at 9am on Tuesdays during June and July for Toddler Tuesdays. The venue offers concessions, private cabanas for group events, and season passes; military, fire, and police personnel and their families receive special pass pricing.

A 2024 expansion added new attractions including Salmon Run and Eagle Hunt, a dueling water coaster. The park operates seasonally from late April through September, with special promotional pricing available on select weekends and for certain groups, and offers standard amenities including restrooms, picnic areas, parking, and accessibility accommodations.

Description: Frontier City in Oklahoma City operates Wild West Waterworks as part of its larger amusement park complex. The water park is included with park admission, which starts at $35 for daily tickets or $55 for season passes; group rates and special packages are available for larger parties. The facility offers free parking and is family-friendly, welcoming children of all ages with accessible amenities and playgrounds on-site.

Name: Lost Lakes Adventure Park
Description: Wake Zone is Oklahoma's only cable wakeboarding park, featuring an overhead cable system that can pull up to 8 riders simultaneously without requiring a boat. The facility includes a giant inflatable aquatic playground, a private 80-acre lake for boat lessons, and equipment rentals for wakeboarders of all skill levels. Open late April through the season, the park offers drop-in access, group packages, summer camps for ages 7–15, birthday parties, and onsite food service with pizza and beverages. Admission is free for spectators; cable passes and rentals have separate fees, with discounts available for educators, college students, military personnel, and during happy hour.

The venue features go-karts, an on-site restaurant and bar, picnic areas, lockers, and cabana rentals. Amenities include wheelchair-accessible entrances, restrooms, Wi-Fi, and party services. Advance ticket purchase is recommended, and the park provides paid parking and accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments.

Name: Six Flags Hurricane Harbor Concord
Description: Hurricane Harbor Concord is a waterpark in Northern California featuring more than 18 water slides and attractions, including Break Point Plunge (a 100-foot tall tower with a vertical drop), Big Kahuna (a multi-person raft slide), Splashwater Island (designed for younger children with smaller slides and water effects), and the Kaanapali Kooler lazy river. Daily admission starts at $35, with season passes available from $69, and group rates beginning at $28 for groups of 15 or more. The park offers various ticket options including bring-a-friend discounts, birthday packages, and corporate group packages with meal deals available.

Name: Typhoon Texas Waterpark Houston
Description: Typhoon Texas in Katy combines water slides, a lazy river, and a dedicated kids' area called Typhoon Jr. for visitors of all ages. The park typically opens at 11:00 AM with closing times ranging from 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM depending on the day. Season passes provide unlimited visits, early entry access, discounted guest tickets, food and merchandise discounts, and free parking and tubes. The facility includes restrooms, parking, picnic areas, and accessibility accommodations.
Address: 555 Katy Fort Bend Rd, Katy, TX 77494

Name: Cinco Ranch II Lake House Pool
Description: Cinco Ranch II Lake House Pool is a water play area in Katy, Texas. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Summer Breeze USA RV Resort & Waterpark
Description: Summer Breeze USA RV Resort & Waterpark in Brookshire features a dedicated water park with eight slides, a dumping bucket, and interactive play structures, plus a separate splash pad designed for younger children. The water park operates daily May through August and weekends in September, with specific hours varying by day (generally 11 AM–5 or 6 PM); it is closed October through April. Access is restricted to registered RV resort guests, who pay a resort amenity fee that includes water park, pool, and splash pad use. Facilities include restrooms, parking, and picnic areas throughout the resort grounds.

Name: Kentucky Kingdom & Hurricane Bay
Description: Kentucky Kingdom & Hurricane Bay is a seasonal amusement and water park in Louisville offering both thrill and children's rides alongside water attractions including waterslides, a lazy river, and a wave pool. Admission is free, though advance ticket purchase is recommended. The venue provides restrooms, on-site dining and bar service, locker and cabana rentals, an adjacent playground, party services, wheelchair-accessible entrances, and complimentary parking. Active-military discounts and live performances are available.

Name: Fort Knox Water Park
Description: Fort Knox Water Park operates seasonally from Memorial Day through Labor Day, open Saturdays and Sundays from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m., with day pass admission at $4 for military-affiliated visitors and $7 for non-military patrons. The facility includes water slides (white and blue options with specific descent rules), spray features, a shallow area called Mini Shark Shallows for children ages 6 and under, and log and lily pad crossing activities, all set behind Devers Middle School. Amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, parking, a playground, and accessibility accommodations; the park can accommodate up to 400 swimmers and offers group rates, monthly passes, and private party rentals during designated time slots.

Name: Sandwich Splash Pad
Description: Located at Milestone Park (1250 N. Fairwind Blvd.), this splash pad features 13 spray jets spread across 1,800 square feet of concrete surface. The facility includes two covered shade structures, picnic tables, and restroom facilities. Operated daily from 9 AM to 8 PM, the splash pad welcomes families and children, with water that is recirculated and chemically treated.

Name: Springbank Aquatic Center
Description: Springbank Aquatic Center spans 9 acres and features a spray play area, sand play area, zero-depth pool, lap pool, and water slides. The facility operates daily from 11 AM to 8 PM, with adjusted evening hours (4–8 PM weekdays, 11 AM–8 PM weekends) once school resumes in mid-August. Designed for community residents, the center also includes bocce ball and sand volleyball courts. Weather-dependent closures occur when temperatures drop below 70 degrees or during hazardous conditions.

Name: Centennial Park Aquatic Center (Orland Park Pool)
Description: Centennial Park Aquatic Center (Orland Park Pool) is an aquatic center in Orland Park, Illinois. On-site amenities include restrooms. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily. The water play is designed for visitors of all ages.

Name: Six Flags Great America
Description: Six Flags Great America is a 300-acre amusement park in Gurnee situated between Chicago and Milwaukee, featuring 17 roller coasters, live entertainment, and three children's areas. The park operates seasonally and offers daily ticket admission starting at $45 online, with season passes available from $79. Guests have access to parking, picnic areas, and restrooms throughout the venue. The park also includes Hurricane Harbor Chicago, a separate water park accessible with a dedicated ticket starting at $30.

Name: Silver Rapids Waterpark
Description: Silver Rapids is an indoor waterpark maintained at a constant 84 degrees and spans roughly the size of a football field, featuring surfing opportunities along with general splash and swim areas. Located within Silver Mountain Resort in Kellogg, Idaho, it primarily serves overnight lodge guests but does offer limited walk-up day tickets for groups of 15 or more or individual advance bookings (up to 14 people) subject to daily availability. The facility operates on a seasonal schedule with varying hours, so visitors should consult the waterpark calendar before planning a visit. Amenities include restrooms, playground access, picnic areas, and ample parking.

Description: Cliff's Amusement Park in Albuquerque features Watermania, a dedicated water attraction area that opens May 23rd each season alongside thrill rides, family rides, and a Kiddyland section. The park spans over 30 attractions and provides parking, picnic areas, restrooms, and accessible facilities for visitors. Admission is free to enter the park grounds, with individual ride tickets available for purchase.

Name: Champy's Fun City
Description: Champy's Splash Park is an indoor water facility located within the Comfort Inn & Suites in Plattsburgh, offering year-round aquatic play. The venue features two slides (105 feet and 84 feet tall), water play structures, an open swim area, and zero-depth entry designed for younger children and beginners; a 44-inch height requirement applies to slide access. Admission is $12 per child for Monday through Thursday and $15 Friday through Sunday (3-hour sessions), with reduced rates for infants under one year. The splash park operates Monday through Thursday from 4–8 PM, Friday 4–9 PM, Saturday 9 AM–9 PM, and Sunday 9 AM–6 PM; Comfort Inn hotel guests receive complimentary admission.

Name: Katelman Pool
Description: Pirate Cove Water Park features a zero-depth entry pool with a pirate ship play structure and attached slide, plus two additional water slides (one covered, one open) that drain into a separate splash basin. The facility also includes a diving board and a Z-shaped pool layout. Operating from late May through July with standard hours of noon to 6 p.m., admission ranges from $5 for basic pool access to $6 to include slide privileges, with punch card packages available. The venue offers shaded seating, concessions, swim lessons at multiple skill levels, and private party rentals during evening hours.

Name: Adventure Bay Waterpark
Description: Adventure Bay Waterpark is a water park in Altoona, Iowa. Buying tickets in advance is recommended. On-site attractions include a lazy river and a wave pool. On-site amenities include restrooms, an on-site restaurant, picnic areas, lockers, and an on-site bar. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. The venue provides paid parking.

Name: Banning Lewis Ranch Vista Water Park (Private)
Description: Banning Lewis Ranch Vista Water Park is a private water park within a residential community in Colorado Springs, featuring a beach-entry pool area with a long water slide, bucket dump stations, squirt guns, and lounge chairs. The facility operates seasonally from Memorial Day through Labor Day, with varying hours throughout the season (9am–8pm in late May through mid-June, 10am–7pm mid-June through mid-August, and limited weekday hours in late August through early September). Two lifeguards are on duty during all operating hours. The park includes accessible amenities such as restrooms, picnic areas, parking, and shaded patio seating, making it suitable for families and children of all ages.
Address: 8833 Vista Del Pico Blvd, Colorado Springs, CO 80927

Name: Wild Water Adventure Park
Description: Wild Water Adventure Park is an amusement park with water attractions in Clovis, California. Buying tickets in advance is recommended. On-site attractions include a wave pool. On-site amenities include restrooms, an on-site restaurant, picnic areas, lockers, cabana rentals, an on-site bar, an adjacent playground, and party services. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. The venue provides free parking and accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments. It features active-military discounts and live performances. It is open daily.

Name: Island Waterpark
Description: Island Waterpark is a seasonal water park in Fresno that operates during summer months and features water rides, pools, slides, and designated play areas for children. The park includes a lazy river and wave pool, along with amenities such as restrooms, food service, picnic areas, lockers, cabana rentals, an on-site bar, and party services. Wheelchair-accessible entrances and restrooms are available, and the venue offers paid parking and accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments. Advance ticket purchases are recommended.

Name: Pump House Indoor Waterpark
Description: Pump House Indoor Waterpark in Jay, Vermont features multiple water slides including the Orange, Blue, and Green options, a 65-foot vertical drop called La Chute with a 360-degree rotation, a double FlowRider for surfing simulation, and a current-driven river with rapids that wraps around the park's perimeter. The facility includes a kids' area with a graduated entry point and interactive water play structure, a deepwater activity pool with a climbing wall and basketball court, and a heated outdoor pool open seasonally. Visitors will find an arcade, gift shop, snack bar, and warming shelter on-site, along with restrooms, parking, picnic areas, and shaded zones. The park operates year-round with extended hours on weekends and maintains accessibility throughout the facility.

Wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking are available, and the park accepts credit and debit cards for payment. It operates daily.

Description: Magic Springs combines a theme park and water park in Hot Springs, Arkansas, welcoming families, kids, and toddlers with accessible facilities. The venue operates seasonally from May through October, offering single-day tickets starting at $36.99 for weekdays and $59.99 for any day, with children under 3 admitted free. Season passes ranging from $79.99 to $139.98 provide unlimited visits, free parking, and access to the Summer Concert Series at Timberwood Amphitheater. The park features amenities including private cabana rentals with shade, food service, and seating, plus group discounts for parties of 10 or more.

Description: Big Dam Waterpark, the rebranded successor to Holiday Springs Waterpark, operates during the 2024 season with slides, pools, lazy rivers, and family play areas. The park welcomes guests of all ages and provides restrooms, picnic areas, and accessible facilities for visitors.

Name: Woodland Veterans Park
Description: Woodland Veterans Park is a water play area in Shawnee, Oklahoma. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Velocity Island Park
Description: Velocity Island Park features Yolo County's largest floating obstacle course anchored on a lake near Sacramento, with slides, climbing walls, trampolines, balance beams, monkey bars, swings, and launch pads. Visitors book 50-minute sessions available Saturdays and Sundays from 12pm to 5pm (extended to 11am–5pm starting June 6, with daily summer hours beginning June 5), and receive a complimentary Coast Guard-approved life jacket, safety briefing, and lifeguard supervision. The park includes changing rooms, showers, and spectator areas where non-participating family members can watch from shore at no charge. On-site dining and birthday party packages are available, and the facility is ADA accessible.

Name: Elizabeth Porter Park & Sprayground
Description: Elizabeth Porter Sprayground in Marietta offers water play for families and young children with daily admission fees of $2 for Cobb County residents and $3 for non-residents. The facility operates seasonally from May through mid-September, with extended hours of 10am–8pm during peak summer months (late May through early September) and more limited weekend-only hours in May and September. The sprayground requires advance online ticket purchases and operates on a first-come, first-served basis subject to occupancy limits. The site includes parking, accessible facilities, restrooms, and an adjacent playground.

Name: Seven Springs Water Park
Description: Seven Springs Water Park is a water park in Powder Springs, Georgia. On-site attractions include a lazy river. On-site amenities include restrooms, food service, picnic areas, lockers, and party services.

Name: Dragonland Water Park - Pekin Park District
Description: DragonLand Water Park sits on three acres within Mineral Springs Park in Pekin and operates daily from noon to 5 p.m., May 23 through August 9, 2026. The facility features a zero-depth entry area, two twisting water slides, a sand beach play zone with water equipment, and an extended deck with lounge chairs. Admission is $9 for ages 4 and up, with children 3 and under free; season passes and family rates are available. The park is fully wheelchair accessible and offers concessions, coin-operated lockers, restrooms, picnic areas, and a playground, with extended evening hours on select Tuesday nights starting in June.

Description: Paradise Springs is an upscale water park in Grapevine, Texas, featuring a lazy river, slides, and ziplining attractions. Description: Euless Family Life Aquatic Park is a water play area in Euless, Texas. Admission is free. Buying tickets in advance is recommended. On-site attractions include a lazy river. On-site amenities include restrooms, food service, Wi-Fi, and party services. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking. The venue provides free parking.

Name: Water Works Park
Description: Water Works Park operates daily from May 23 through August 9, 2026, then weekends only from August 15 onward, with Monday–Saturday hours from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. and Sunday hours from noon to 7 p.m. The park offers free daily admission along with tiered season pass options (Silver, Platinum, and All-Access memberships) and group discounts for parties of 10 or more. Amenities include accessible facilities, parking, a playground, restrooms, concessions, pavilion rentals, and cooler passes. The venue welcomes school groups and youth organizations under Cati's Act pre-registration requirements and staffing ratios.

Name: Frisco Water Park
Description: Frisco Water Park features multiple water attractions including Walnut's Treehouse with three slides and 85+ spray jets, the Preston Plunge (a 45-foot mat racer slide), the Pipeline and Green Gusher slides, the Splash Station designed for young children with two slides and spray features, and a Lazy River for relaxation. The park operates seasonally during summer 2026 beginning May 23, with opening day hours from 10:30 a.m. to 5 p.m., and includes amenities such as shade, concession stands, restrooms, parking, and picnic areas. Admission is free for Frisco Athletic Center members; otherwise, access is available through a Splash Pass or event-specific passes ($7 youth, $9 adults for special events). The park also offers sensory-friendly early swim sessions with reduced capacity and no background music for guests seeking a calmer experience.

Name: Frog Pond Water Park at Farmers Branch Aquatics Center
Description: Frog Pond Water Park at Farmers Branch Aquatics Center is a water park in Farmers Branch, Texas. On-site attractions include a lazy river. On-site amenities include restrooms, food service, picnic areas, lockers, an adjacent playground, and party services. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. The venue provides paid parking. The water play is designed for visitors of all ages.

Name: Stanley Fulton Memorial Splash Pad
Description: Stanley Fulton Memorial Splash Pad is a water play area in Hancock, Maryland. Admission is free. On-site amenities include restrooms. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking. The venue provides free parking. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Noah's Ark Waterpark
Description: Noah's Ark Waterpark is a 70-acre water park in Wisconsin Dells featuring a wave pool, lazy river, and slides for both thrill-seekers and younger children. The facility offers on-site dining, an arcade, mini golf, picnic areas, lockers, and cabana rentals, along with live performances and party services. Amenities include wheelchair-accessible entrances and restrooms, paid parking, and an adjacent playground. Advance ticket purchase is recommended.
Address: 1410 Wisconsin Dells Pkwy, Wisconsin Dells, WI 53965

Name: Juniata Memorial Spray Park
Description: Juniata Memorial Spray Park is a water play area in Altoona, Pennsylvania. On-site amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking.

Name: Texas Ski Ranch
Description: Stoke Factory Aqua Park sits within the 70-acre Texas Ski Ranch sports complex on a freshwater lake in New Braunfels. The aqua park features a floating obstacle course with elements including slides, trampolines, climbing walls, and balance beams, designed for ages 6 and up. The park operates seasonally beginning May 25, with extended hours Monday–Saturday 10am–8pm and Sunday 12pm–6pm. A snack shack provides food and beverages on-site, and beach passes are available for $5 if visitors want to enjoy the water without the obstacle course.

The park operates daily from 12:30 to 7:00 p.m. during the season, weather permitting, and includes shade structures, sand volleyball courts, a bathhouse, and concession facilities. Birthday party packages are available, and both daily admission and season passes can be purchased at the facility or online. The park is located at 1200 Scott Street in Beatrice.

Name: Rexburg Rapids
Description: Rexburg Rapids is a family water park in Rexburg, Idaho, featuring a lazy river, kiddie slides, and splash pools alongside food service and concessions. The facility offers wheelchair-accessible entrances and restrooms, on-site lockers, paid parking, and an adjacent playground. Party services are available, and active-military discounts are provided.

Name: Hook's Lagoon
Description: Hook's Lagoon is a pirate-themed splash pad featuring a kiddie ship structure with water sprouts and a shallow pool suitable for young children. The venue also includes Splash Island, a 16,000-square-foot kids' water play area with a small wave pool under a canopy and a lazy river with rafts. Open daily from 10 AM to 7 PM, the facility offers parking, restrooms, and is designed to accommodate families with toddlers and young kids. Both areas emphasize shallow depths and age-appropriate attractions for safe water play.

Name: Castaway Island (TY PARK) (CLOSED FOR SEASON)
Description: Castaway Island operates seasonally at T.Y. Park in Hollywood with varying schedules throughout the year, from spring break through late September, with weekday hours from 10 AM to 4:30 PM and weekend hours until 5 PM. The venue offers free admission and includes restrooms, parking, and accessibility features, plus on-site concessions. Season passes are available at multiple tiers for individual and family visitors, and funbrella reservations can be arranged through the park's reservation system.

Name: Wicked Waves Cape Cod
Description: Wicked Waves is Massachusetts's largest waterpark, located in West Yarmouth on Cape Cod. The facility offers a variety of water attractions and amenities designed for families and children, with parking available on-site. Visitors can purchase daily combo passes or opt for season passes (which include free parking); the park also features additional attractions including an inflatable park and a FlowRider surf simulator. An on-property family resort offers package deals that include complimentary park admission on check-in and check-out days.

Name: The Reef Indoor Water Park
Description: The Reef is Montana's largest indoor water park, spanning roughly the size of a football field with multiple slides including the multi-story Barracuda Blaster and Tropical Twister that empty into a plunge pool. The facility includes a 55,000-gallon wave pool, water basketball, and a dedicated children's play area featuring slides, mini-tubes, squirt guns, tunnels, and a 250-gallon dumping bucket. Seating areas and picnic tables are available both indoors and on an enclosed patio, with food available at Shark Shack. The water park is connected to the Big Horn Resort and welcomes both hotel guests and the general public.

Description: PartyDeSesmas is a water play area in Houston, Texas. On-site amenities include an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking. It is open daily.

Name: Oasis
Description: Oasis is an extensive outdoor water facility in Billings operated by the Better Billings Foundation and Harvest Church, open daily from noon to 7 p.m. from late May through late August. The facility includes tower slides, a wave surfing attraction called Ripbreak-WaveSurfer with height restrictions (42 inches minimum for boogie boarding, 48 inches for flow boarding), and a dedicated shallow water area for children under 42 inches. Admission is $14 daily, with discounts available for seniors, military, groups, nonprofits, and visitors arriving after 5 p.m., while children 3 and under are free.

Name: Last Chance Splash Waterpark & Pool
Description: Last Chance Splash Waterpark & Pool operates seasonally from mid-June through mid-August in Helena, Montana, with a special dog day event in mid-August. The facility features slides, a lazy river, zero-depth entry, a splash deck, a 50-meter pool with diving tank, and lap swim lanes across weekday and weekend schedules with varying availability. Weekday operations begin at 9:30 AM for lap swim and adult water walking, with the waterpark opening at 12:30 PM and all facilities closing at 7:00 PM; weekend hours run from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM. The venue includes restrooms, parking, picnic areas, a playground, and is accessible to families and children.
Address: 1203 N Last Chance Gulch, Helena, MT 59601

Name: Splash Montana
Description: Splash Montana operates at Playfair Park in Missoula, opening for adult lap swimming on May 23, 2026 (weather permitting) and transitioning to regular season hours beginning June 12. The facility offers discounted admission through punch cards and passes, with an additional 20% savings for city residents using a valid CityCard. Children under 7 require adult supervision in the water, and outside food and beverages are prohibited except for water. The venue provides accessibility features, parking, and restroom facilities suitable for families and children.

Guests can access parking, picnic areas, restrooms, and a playground, with amenities for private events, birthday parties, and group gatherings available upon request.

Description: SPAR Waterpark, located on the west side of Calcasieu Parish in Sulphur, features a lazy river with inner tubes and waterslides for older guests, along with Parrot Island entertainment designed for younger children. The facility opened in 2005 and operates as part of Sulphur Parks & Recreation's larger recreational district, which maintains over 550 acres of parks and facilities. The venue includes restrooms, parking, and picnic areas for visitors, and an adjacent aquatic center with two indoor pools available year-round.

Description: Holiday Inn Omaha Downtown features an indoor water park included with hotel stays at no additional admission cost. The property offers contemporary accommodations with Wi-Fi access throughout, a casual on-site restaurant, restrooms, and picnic areas. The venue is LGBTQ+ friendly and welcomes all guests.

Name: Siouxland Splash Waterpark
Description: Siouxland Splash Waterpark in Sioux City operates from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day weekend and features wave pools, water slides, and a lazy river. Day admission includes unlimited rides on all attractions plus complimentary tube usage and parking, with free entry for children under 4 and paid tickets required for ages 4 and up. The park accommodates group events and private celebrations, and offers accessible facilities including restrooms, picnic areas, lockers, and cabanas (the latter available for an additional fee). Guests may re-enter the same day with a hand stamp, and the park provides a range of amenities to support a full day of water play.

Name: Wild Water & Wheels Water Park
Description: Wild Water & Wheels is an outdoor water park in Surfside Beach, South Carolina, featuring tall water slides and pools alongside a winding go-kart racetrack. The facility provides restrooms and picnic areas for guests, with wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking available.

Name: Shark Wake Park 843
Description: Shark Wake Park in North Myrtle Beach features Obstacle Island, a large floating playground with monkey bars, climbing towers, and slides for children 6 and older who are at least 45 inches tall and able to swim. The facility also operates a cable park for wakeboarding, kneeboarding, water skiing, and other towed water sports for participants 10 and older. Sessions run 50 minutes and begin hourly, with arrival recommended 30 minutes before your scheduled time. The park welcomes families, offers free admission, and provides restrooms, parking, and accessibility accommodations.

Name: Fayette Aquatic Center
Description: Fayette Aquatic Center is an aquatic center in Fayette, Alabama. On-site attractions include a lazy river. On-site amenities include restrooms, food service, an adjacent playground, and party services. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It accepts credit cards and debit cards. It features active-military discounts.

Name: Indiana Beach Boardwalk Resort
Description: Indiana Beach Boardwalk Resort in Monticello combines over 45 amusement rides with water attractions including slides, splash zones, and pools overlooking Lake Shafer. The water park operates seasonally, opening May 24th, 2026, with water features closed when temperatures fall below 70°F. The resort offers daily admission tickets and seasonal passes, along with amenities such as restrooms, parking, and accessible facilities throughout the grounds.
Address: 5224 E Indiana Beach Rd, Monticello, IN 47960

Name: Sesame Place San Diego
Description: Sesame Place San Diego is a Sesame Street-themed amusement park in Chula Vista featuring rides, waterslides, a lazy river, and a wave pool alongside parades and live performances. The venue offers on-site dining, lockers, cabana rentals, a bar, restrooms, and Wi-Fi, with wheelchair-accessible entrances and free parking. Amenities include an adjacent playground, party services, active-military discounts, and mobile payment options; advance ticket purchase is recommended.

Name: Knoebels Crystal Pool
Description: Knoebels Crystal Pool holds 900,000 gallons and features a zero-depth entry point plus stepped entry in the shallow end, along with a separate kiddie pool and play area for younger children. The facility includes four slides—two tunnel-style winders with height requirements of 42 inches with an adult or 48 inches alone, and two speed slides requiring 48 inches—plus multiple diving boards in the deep end. American Red Cross-certified lifeguards are always on duty. A refreshment stand, Beach Shop, and pavilion (available first-come, first-served) are available on-site; visitors may bring their own food, chairs, and floatation devices.

Name: Bethel Park Splash Park
Description: Bethel Park Splash Park, which opened in May 2024, features two distinct splash zones designed for different age groups—one with gentle spray features for younger children and another with interactive water elements for older kids and families. Located next to the Bethel Park Community Center on Park Avenue, this ADA-accessible facility operates daily from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m. (with earlier 10 a.m. opening for seasonal members), and entry requires either a daily pass or membership purchased at the Community Center. The park includes air-conditioned restrooms, vending machines, and full staffing during operating hours, and can be reserved for private events starting at $100 for residents.
Address: 2600 South Park Rd, Bethel Park, PA 15102

Name: Wet and Wild
Description: Wet and Wild in Gallipolis operates as a beach and water play facility open daily from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. between Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends. Day passes range from $8 for children under 6 to $18 for ages 6–66, with discounted group rates and family packages available; admission is free for visitors over 66. The venue includes a sand beach with included toys, chairs, and umbrellas, plus canoe and paddleboard rentals, and requires life jackets for all water play. Private party rentals are available with lifeguard supervision, picnic tables, and flexible setup options.

Name: Showboat Resort Atlantic City
Description: Showboat Resort Atlantic City is a water play area in Atlantic City, New Jersey. Admission is free. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

The park operates daily from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m., with attractions and dining running 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. On-site amenities include dining outlets, a retail shop, and 25 cabanas available for rental. The facility provides parking, playground areas, restrooms, and ADA accessibility; outside food and beverages are not permitted, though multiple food options operate within the park.

Name: Grapeland Water Park
Description: Grapeland Water Park is an urban recreational facility in Miami that combines green space with seasonal water attractions. The venue features a lazy river, ball field, and tennis courts, along with amenities including restrooms, food service, picnic areas, and lockers. The park also offers movie screenings and a snack bar, with party services available for group events. Multiple payment methods are accepted, including credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments.

Name: McDonald Water Park
Description: McDonald Water Park is a city-run water park in Hialeah featuring a wave pool, lazy river, and splash pad for toddlers. The facility offers restrooms, food service, an arcade, picnic areas, and an adjacent playground, along with Wi-Fi and party services. Wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms are available, and the park accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments.

Name: Bucky Dent Park
Description: Bucky Dent Park is a 25-acre recreational facility in Hialeah featuring swimming pools, 30-foot waterslides, and a lazy river for aquatic activities. The park also includes sports fields, a recreation center, and gymnasium for various athletic pursuits. Amenities on-site consist of restrooms, an on-site restaurant, arcade games, and an adjacent playground, with wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking available.

Name: Kalahari Indoor Water Park
Description: Kalahari's indoor water park in Baraboo features multiple water attractions including wave pools, lazy rivers, waterslides, and interactive play areas, along with a splash pad and dry playground with basketball hoops and yard games. The facility operates daily from 10 AM to 9 PM and is undergoing a 75,000-square-foot expansion with a retractable roof. Day passes are available for non-resort guests on a limited basis and can be booked online. The resort provides parking, restrooms, picnic areas, shade, and accessibility accommodations.

Name: Astoria Aquatic Center - No Swimming Mondays
Description: Astoria Aquatic Center - No Swimming Mondays is an indoor water play facility in Astoria, Oregon. On-site amenities include shaded seating. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Clive Aquatic Center
Description: Clive Aquatic Center is an aquatic center in Clive, Iowa. On-site amenities include restrooms. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking. It is open daily. The water play is designed for visitors of all ages.

Name: Adventureland Park
Description: Adventureland Park in Altoona, Iowa combines thrill rides with a water park featuring a lazy river and wave pool, along with an arcade, on-site dining, and live performances. Admission is free, though advance ticket purchases are recommended. The facility offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, free parking, lockers, cabana rentals, restrooms, Wi-Fi, and party services, with active-military discounts available.

Name: Altoona Aquatics Park
Description: Altoona Aquatics Park offers pool party rentals with reserved seating areas, tables, and chairs for groups up to 30 guests, with admission included in the $225 rental fee plus $25 refundable cleaning deposit. Two party time slots are available daily (12:30–2:30 PM and 3:30–5:30 PM), and optional food packages including hot dogs, pizzas, and ice cream can be added. The facility operates Monday–Friday from 12–6 PM and Saturday–Sunday from 11 AM–6 PM, with accessible parking and family-friendly amenities. Supervision requirements vary by child age, and the pool enforces specific safety rules including designated diving depths and swim test requirements for certain activities.

Name: Splash-n-Dash Aqua Park
Description: Splash-n-Dash is a floating inflatable water park located at Lake McSwain in Snelling, California, open from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day. The park spans over 200,000 square feet and features three distinct play areas: Colossal Splash with a 20-foot tower housing three water slides, two jump platforms, and a rock wall; Big Splash; and Lil' Splash, a supervised zone for younger children where watching parents enter free. Visitors can purchase all-day or one-hour session tickets, with group rates available for parties of ten or more, and spectators watch for free from shore. On-site amenities include a cafe with food and snacks, beach chair and cabana rentals, parking, and restrooms.

Name: Great Wolf Lodge | Northern California
Description: Great Wolf Lodge | Northern California is a resort water park in Manteca, California. Admission is free. On-site amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, and Wi-Fi. The water play is designed for visitors of all ages.

Name: Seabreeze Amusement Park
Description: Seabreeze Amusement Park in Rochester features a water play area called the Soak zone with a lazy river and the Hydro Racer slide. The park operates seasonally during the summer and offers single-day tickets and season passports available online, with group rates available for parties of 15–49 people. Beyond the water attractions, the venue includes thrill rides, family rides, kiddie rides, and a playground, with parking, picnic areas, restrooms, and accessibility accommodations on-site.

Name: Kahuna Laguna Indoor Water Park North Conway
Description: Kahuna Laguna is a year-round indoor water park located at the Red Jacket Mountain View Resort in North Conway, New Hampshire. The facility features water slides and a wave pool, along with restrooms, picnic areas, and shaded seating. Wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking are available, and the venue operates daily with an adjacent playground on-site.
Address: 2251 White Mountain Hwy, North Conway, NH 03860

Name: Whale's Tale Waterpark
Description: Whale's Tale Waterpark in Lincoln, New Hampshire features multiple water slides and attractions including Akua Beach, a wave pool for surfing. The park operates daily during summer and offers discounted admission of $29 per person for entry after 2 PM. Amenities include free parking, accessible facilities, picnic areas, and restrooms, with complimentary life jackets available at the main entrance for guest safety.

Name: Holiday World & Splashin' Safari
Description: Holiday World & Splashin' Safari is a combination amusement park and water park in Santa Claus, Indiana, offering year-round family entertainment. The property features a water area called Splashin' Safari alongside the main Holiday World amusement park, with operating hours varying seasonally and often running from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. during peak season. Admission is free with the park providing restrooms, picnic areas, playgrounds, parking, and accessible facilities. The venue offers special discounts for military, nurses, first responders, and foster families, and on-site lodging options are available through partner properties.
Address: 452 E Christmas Blvd, Santa Claus, IN 47579

Name: Kingdom Splash Fest - Panama City
Description: Kingdom Splash Fest is an inflatable water park located on Beach Drive in downtown Panama City that welcomes children ages 4 and up. The facility provides life jackets to all participants, maintains on-duty lifeguards, and allows parents to watch from the beach area at no charge. Visitors can purchase daily tickets or season passes online with flexible options for weekday-only or unlimited 7-day access, with no advance reservations or time slots required. The venue operates from a waterfront location and includes parking, restroom facilities, and accessibility accommodations.
Address: 327 W Beach Dr, Panama City, FL 32401

Name: Water Rampage
Description: Water Rampage is a full-scale water park in Lubbock featuring Pirate's Cove for young children, a wave pool, waterslides in the Lost Lagoon section, and a lazy river for relaxation. The park operates daily from noon to 6 PM during its season, which opens May 23rd each year, and offers reserved pavilions with shade for birthday parties and group events. Day parties run during regular hours, while private after-hours events are available from 6:30 to 8:30 PM. The venue includes accessibility accommodations and a snack bar on-site.
Address: 6602 Marsha Sharp Fwy W, Lubbock, TX 79407

Name: Lake Arvesta Farms & Arvesta Sports Complex
Description: Lake Arvesta Farms spans 188 acres and features two separate lakes with water play attractions including 500-foot floating obstacle courses (Wibit), dual 240-foot waterslides, paddleboarding, kayaking, and cable wakeboarding. The venue operates daily from 8 AM to 9 PM and is free to enter, with lifeguards and required lifejackets provided for safety. Amenities include a playground, restrooms, parking, beach areas, concessions (The Trough and Fire Water Bar & Grill), and accessible facilities for families and children.

Name: Big Kahuna's Destin
Description: Big Kahuna's Destin is a water park in Destin, Florida, featuring a lazy river, wave pool, and approximately 40 attractions including tall slides. Admission is free, though advance ticket purchase is recommended. The venue offers on-site dining and a bar, plus amenities such as lockers, cabana rentals, restrooms, and party services. Wheelchair-accessible entrances and free parking are available, and the park accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments.

Name: Schlitterbahn Waterpark Galveston
Description: Schlitterbahn Galveston is a waterpark on Galveston Island featuring a mile-long lazy river system divided into three distinct sections, with water coasters, speed slides like Rohr! and MASSIV, raft rides, and pools. The park includes themed attractions such as Screaming Serpents body slide and an uphill water coaster, plus smaller water play areas designed for children. Amenities include picnic pavilions throughout the grounds, and the facility is accessible with parking and restroom facilities available.

Description: Palm Beach at Moody Gardens is a water park featuring a white sand beach, 650-foot lazy river, wave pool, two 18-foot tower slides, and an Aquarium Adventure play area. The splash pad includes interactive dump buckets, spray arches, and fountains. The park operates daily from May 30 through August 9 (10 AM–7 PM), with weekend-only hours from August 15 through September 27 (10 AM–4 PM), plus special Labor Day weekend hours. Admission is free, and the venue provides restrooms, showers, beach chairs, umbrellas, lockers for rent, dining options, and life jackets for children.

Name: Fun Spot Water Slide
Description: Fun Spot Water Slide in Port Bolivar operates daily from 11am to 6pm and features a water slide open to families and children. Daily admission is $20 per person for all-day access, with season passes available for $150, and private group bookings offered for $250 per hour during morning and evening slots. The facility welcomes coolers, provides on-site food and beverages, offers limited life jackets (though bringing your own is recommended), and includes restrooms and picnic areas. Located at 2061 TX-87 in Port Bolivar, the venue accommodates visitors with accessible facilities and is best reached by calling 409-684-2384 for details or reservations.

Name: Highland Park Aquatic Center
Description: Highland Park Aquatic Center is an outdoor facility in St. Paul that operates seasonally during summer months and features a two-story water slide, splash pad, lap pool, children's activity pool, and diving boards. The center offers swimming lessons at varying rates depending on residency and age, along with water aerobics classes and concessions. Parking, restrooms, and accessibility accommodations are available on-site.

Description: Battle Creek Waterpark sits within Battle Creek Regional Park and caters primarily to families with young children under age 10. The facility features a three-story twisting slide, a shallow pool with zero-depth entry, and sundeck areas with lounging space. Visitors have access to restrooms, showers, and changing facilities, with food trucks sometimes stationed in the parking lot during the season.

Name: C.B. Smith Park
Description: C.B. Smith Park is a 299-acre recreational facility in Pembroke Pines, Florida, featuring a water play area along with sports courts and camping options. The park offers free admission and includes restrooms, picnic areas, barbecue grills, a basketball court, and an adjacent playground. Amenities include wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking, with dogs permitted on the grounds.
Address: 900 N Flamingo Rd, Pembroke Pines, FL 33028

Name: Rapids Waterpark
Description: Rapids Waterpark is a 12-acre outdoor water park in West Palm Beach featuring a wave pool, lazy river, and waterslides. Admission is free, though advance ticket purchase is recommended. The venue offers restrooms, an on-site restaurant and bar, picnic areas, lockers, and cabana rentals, along with party services. Wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking are available, with free parking on-site and payment options including credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments.
Address: 6566 N Military Trl, West Palm Beach, FL 33407

Name: Splash City Adventures
Description: Splash City Adventures in Pensacola, Florida combines dry and wet attractions on a single property. Visitors can enjoy a lazy river, mini golf, and go-karts, along with arcade games and laser tag. The venue offers free admission, free parking, wheelchair-accessible facilities, restrooms, lockers, an on-site restaurant, and party services. Active military receive discounts, and the facility accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments.

Name: Greek Peak Mountain Resort
Description: Greek Peak Mountain Resort is a water play area in Cortland, New York. Admission is free. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Ocean Breeze
Description: Ocean Breeze is a water park in Virginia Beach featuring water slides, a wave pool, and a tubing river alongside 30+ rides. The park offers additional attractions including a lazy river and go-karts, with on-site amenities such as restrooms, dining, lockers, cabana rentals, and a bar. Admission is free, though advance ticket purchase is recommended. The venue provides wheelchair-accessible entrances, free parking, an adjacent playground, party services, and active-military discounts.
Address: 849 General Booth Blvd, Virginia Beach, VA 23451

Description: Melrose Park Playground & Splashpad is a water play area in Chelsea, Alabama. On-site amenities include restrooms and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking. It accepts credit cards and debit cards. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Canobie Lake Park
Description: Canobie Lake Park in Salem, New Hampshire offers free admission to an amusement facility with roller coasters, water rides, and carnival games suitable for children. The park provides on-site dining and bar options, lockers, and party services for groups. Accessibility features include wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, restrooms, and seating areas, along with wheelchair rentals available on-site.

Name: Kim Tam Park at Melanie Springs
Description: Kim Tam Park at Melanie Springs in Uniontown features a natural spring pool where guests can swim and relax, along with floaty rentals and cabana options. The facility operates daily starting at 11 a.m. and includes a concession stand, pavilions available for rent, camping areas, walking trails, basketball courts, and picnic spaces. Visitors should plan to arrive early since early entry begins at 10 a.m., and all guests are required to complete a park entry waiver before admission. Service animals are permitted in most areas of the park but not in the water, beach, or picnic zones.

Name: Jellystone Park™ Akron-Canton
Description: Jellystone Park™ Akron-Canton is a campground and resort in Uniontown, Ohio, that includes Clearwater Park, an outdoor swimming facility with a family swim area, inflatable obstacle course, diving platform, and diving board. The property offers access to numerous amenities during stays, including an 18-hole miniature golf course, a 36-by-36-foot sandbox, outdoor slides, gem mining, a children's playground, and themed activities throughout the season. A dog water park with sprinklers, fountains, and a wading area opened in 2025. Visitors can stay in cabins, RV sites, or tent camping, all with free admission to the water park and other on-site attractions.

Name: Maca Aquatic Center (Maca Pool)
Description: Maca Aquatic Center is a 250,000-gallon water facility located within the 65-acre Maca Park in Tallmadge, Ohio. The complex features a six-lane lap pool, an enclosed flume slide, a speed slide, a zero-depth entry area with a kiddie slide, and a large barrel splash zone, with water heated to 82–84 degrees. Members and guests can use shower facilities, a concession stand, and shaded seating areas, and members may bring up to two guests per visit for $5 each. Annual memberships are available for household members with proof of residency, and ages 2 and under are free; daily admission sales begin at noon.

Name: Henry Moses Aquatic Center
Description: Henry Moses Aquatic Center in Renton offers party tent rentals with included facility admissions for groups of various sizes. Three tent options range from a 10'×10' setup near the lap pool accommodating 10 guests to two 10'×20' tents positioned over the wave pool or north of the lap pool, each accommodating 25 guests, with pricing that varies for residents and non-residents. The facility also permits full-venue private rentals on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday evenings from 7–9 p.m., accommodating up to 500 people with exclusive access. The center features a wave pool and lap pool, with accessible facilities, parking, and restrooms available.

Name: Okatibbee Park
Description: Okatibbee Park is a water play area in Meridian, Mississippi. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Veterans Park - Spray Ground

Description: River Bend RV Resort in Watertown features multiple water play areas including a 300-gallon swimming pool with two large slides and two mini slides, a hot tub, a separate kiddie pool with a lily pad course, and a swimming pond with an inflatable Wibit obstacle course. Day passes are available to the public Sunday through Thursday, granting access to the water features plus additional amenities such as a jumping pillow, fishing pond, canoe rentals, sports courts, and playgrounds. The facility operates during the summer season with day passes available starting at 9:00 a.m., and parking, restrooms, and a Tiki Bar are on-site.

Name: Shelby Farms Park Water Play Sprayground
Description: Shelby Farms Park Water Play Sprayground is a water play area in Memphis, Tennessee. On-site amenities include restrooms and an adjacent playground. Name: Pirates Cove Water Park
Description: Pirates Cove Water Park is a seasonal outdoor facility in Littleton, Colorado, offering leisure and lap pools, a 35-foot slide, and a tubing river. The park includes a lazy river, on-site restaurant, picnic areas, lockers, and party services, along with restrooms and wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking. Advance ticket purchase is recommended, and the venue accepts debit cards for paid parking and concessions.

Name: Roaring Springs Water Park
Description: Roaring Springs in Meridian operates daily from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m., with extended hours until 8 p.m. starting May 30, weather permitting. The park features The Hive, a double-looping water slide with significant g-forces. Cabanas are available for rent and may include access to Friday DJ nights and Saturday dive-in movie nights from June through August, though waterpark admission is purchased separately. Dining options include alcohol service at Pinz Bar, with beverages restricted to the cabana area.

Name: Heath City Water Park
Description: Heath City Water Park features multiple pools including a 50-meter Olympic pool, diving tank, and learning pool, along with an array of water slides such as a 30-foot speed slide and a 229-foot-long high slide. The park includes a lazy river, a 5,500-square-foot water playground with interactive play structures, tumble buckets, water cannons, and spray features, plus lemon drops and funbrellas for shade. Additional amenities include basketball courts, a playground, a shelter, restrooms, and picnic areas. The facility operates daily from noon to 7 p.m.

Name: Columbus Zoo and Aquarium
Description: Columbus Zoo and Aquarium is a water play area in Powell, Ohio. Admission is free. On-site amenities include an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily.

Name: Carlsbad Water Park
Description: Carlsbad Water Park is a water park in Carlsbad, New Mexico. On-site attractions include a lazy river. On-site amenities include restrooms, food service, picnic areas, and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It accepts credit cards and debit cards. It is open daily. The water play is designed for visitors of all ages.

Name: T.Y. (Topeekeegee Yugnee) Park
Description: T.Y. Park in Hollywood, Florida is a water play area featuring two water parks and a swimming lagoon, along with a 2-mile paved walking loop and camping facilities. The park includes restrooms, picnic areas, barbecue grills, a basketball court, and an adjacent playground, with wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking. Free parking is available, credit and debit cards are accepted, and dogs are permitted on-site.

Name: Franklin Splash Park
Description: Franklin Splash Park operates as part of the Franklin Recreation Complex's outdoor aquatic facilities. The splash park runs seasonally from late May through early September, with extended hours through mid-summer (10 a.m.–7 p.m. weekdays, reduced weekend and fall hours) and weather-dependent closures. General admission is affordable, with in-county residents ages 3–17 paying $3 and adults $5, while children under 2 are free. The facility offers accessible parking and restrooms, making it convenient for families with young children.

Name: Dollywood's Splash Country
Description: Dollywood's Splash Country is an amusement park with water attractions in Pigeon Forge, Tennessee. On-site amenities include restrooms and picnic areas. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms.
Address: 2700 Dollywood Parks Blvd, Pigeon Forge, TN 37863

Name: Adventure Oasis Water Park
Description: Adventure Oasis Water Park is a city-owned facility in Independence, Missouri, operating seasonally during summer months. The park features water slides, a splash park, a lazy river, and a swimming pool. Amenities include restrooms, an on-site restaurant, and picnic areas, with wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking available. The facility accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments.

Name: Syracuse Island Splash Pad
Description: This interactive splash pad at Centennial Park welcomes toddlers and older children with water play features accessible at no cost. Operating seasonally from Memorial Day through Labor Day, the facility is open Monday through Saturday from 10 AM to 8 PM, with Sunday closures for system maintenance. The pad uses a filtered and UV-treated recirculating system to maintain water quality while conserving resources. Pavilions, picnic tables, and restrooms are available on-site for visitor convenience.

Name: The Ingleside Hotel
Description: The Ingleside Hotel in Pewaukee includes Springs Water Park, a 45,000-square-foot indoor water park available to hotel guests. The venue offers complimentary parking and is designed to accommodate families, kids, and toddlers with its water play amenities. The hotel provides additional guest services including an indoor pool, fitness center, and on-site dining.

Name: Cool Waters Aquatic Center
Description: Cool Waters Aquatic Center operates seasonally from mid-June through early September, closed Mondays except on Labor Day. The facility features water slides, zero-depth entry for younger swimmers, and interactive water obstacles including logs and lily pads. Children ages 0–2 receive free admission. The center provides parking, restrooms, and accessibility accommodations.

Name: Jellystone Park™ Clay's Resort
Description: Jellystone Park™ Clay's Resort is a lakeside camping and cabin destination in North Lawrence, Ohio, featuring a water park alongside casual dining and entertainment options. Admission to the facility is free, and the venue provides wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms for all guests.
Address: 12951 Patterson St NW, North Lawrence, OH 44666

Name: Three Bears Waterpark Resort & Convention Center, Ascend Collection Near Tomah, WI
Description: Three Bears Waterpark Resort features a 60,000-square-foot indoor waterpark open year-round, with attractions including a lazy river, wave pool, body slides, tube slides, a kiddy pool with bucket drop feature, and a hot tub. The facility also operates a seasonal outdoor waterpark from Memorial Day through Labor Day, which includes additional water slides and children's attractions. Day passes cost $40 per person (ages 4+), $35 for local residents, with children under 3 free; overnight resort guests receive complimentary waterpark access. The venue offers cabanas with televisions and picnic tables available for rent, accommodates birthday parties, and provides picnic areas and restrooms.

Name: The Waters of Minocqua
Description: The Waters of Minocqua is a lodge-style hotel in Minocqua, Wisconsin, featuring rustic rooms and complimentary breakfast for guests. The property includes an on-site restaurant, Wi-Fi access, and a water park. Admission to the water park is free for hotel guests.

Name: Shark Wake Park 561
Description: Shark Wake Park in West Palm Beach features a floating obstacle course called Obstacle Island with slides, climbing towers, and jump platforms, alongside cable wakeboarding and kneeboarding facilities. The park operates daily from noon to 5 PM and offers free admission, with amenities including restrooms, parking, a playground, and accessibility accommodations suitable for families and children.
Address: 1440 Eshleman Trail, West Palm Beach, FL 33413

Name: Calypso Bay Waterpark
Description: Calypso Bay is a free outdoor water park in Royal Palm Beach featuring an 897-foot river ride, lily pad walk, and water playground. The park welcomes families and children with accessible facilities, parking, picnic areas, restrooms, and a playground. Group rates are available on weekends for parties of 15 or more, with advance booking discounts starting at $14 per adult and $10 per child.
Address: 151 Lamstein Ln, Royal Palm Beach, FL 33411

Name: Dolphins Cove
Description: Dolphins Cove is a waterpark facility in Sun Prairie featuring Mussels Beach, Adventure Lagoon, a Jumbo-Tron, and a Tiki Bar alongside traditional swimming pools. The venue operates on a seasonal summer schedule and offers both full summer memberships and daily guest passes ($16 per day for non-member guests accompanied by a member). Amenities include parking, playgrounds, restrooms, and private cabanas available for events. The facility welcomes families and children with supervised guest policies and hosts seasonal poolside events.
Address: 1010 N Bird St Suite 106, Sun Prairie, WI 53590

Name: Calypso Cove
Description: Calypso Cove in Baytown operates seasonally from May 23 through September 1, 2026, offering a smaller, more intimate water play environment suited for younger children and first-time swimmers. The facility provides swim lessons taught by certified instructors at various skill levels, along with birthday party packages that include admission, reserved seating, and food options. On-site amenities include parking, restrooms, a playground, and accessible facilities for guests of all abilities.

Name: Jellystone Park™ Keystone Lake
Description: Jellystone Park™ Keystone Lake is a water play area in Mannford, Oklahoma. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Description: Great Wolf Lodge Indoor Water Park | Sandusky is an indoor water play facility in Sandusky, Ohio. Admission is free. On-site attractions include mini golf. The facility is located within a larger Round Rock Parks and Recreation park system and provides free admission, parking, picnic areas, playgrounds, and restrooms.

The park is open weekends only during the operating season, with Saturday hours from noon to 10 PM and Sunday hours from noon to 9 PM. General admission starts at $39 for a single-day ticket, with season passes available starting at $65, and the facility provides parking, picnic areas, playgrounds, and restrooms for visitors.

Day passes range from $28–$40 depending on duration, with equipment rentals, beginner lesson packages starting at $25, and monthly memberships available for Florida residents; the park also offers summer camps in June, July, and August. Amenities include a spring-fed swimming beach, volleyball courts, concession stands, restrooms, picnic areas, and parking.
