Description: WhoaZone at Whihala Beach operates an inflatable floating obstacle course on Lake Michigan in Whiting, Indiana, featuring slides, jumps, and bounce elements for water-based recreation. The facility provides shaded seating rentals, a snack bar with beach store, parking, restrooms, and hosts group events and birthday parties. Lifeguards supervise the obstacle course during operating hours, and the venue welcomes visitors of varying activity levels, from those seeking high-energy challenges to those preferring a more relaxed beach experience.
Address: Whihala Beach, 1561 Park Rd, Whiting, IN 46394

Name: Casitas Water Adventure
Description: Casitas Water Adventure is a day-use recreation area in Ventura that operates from sunrise to sunset, with entry fees of $10 per vehicle during the off-season (Labor Day to Easter) and $20 on weekends during peak season (Easter to Labor Day). The waterpark itself is closed for the 2025 season, but the grounds offer playgrounds, park showers, restrooms, and parking. Hiking trails, including the Wadleigh Arm trail, are available to visitors. Annual vehicle passes are available for frequent visitors seeking day-use access.

Name: DryTown Water Park
Description: DryTown Water Park in Palmdale features multiple water attractions including slides, a lazy river, and wading pools, along with an on-site café. The facility provides wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, restrooms, and picnic areas for visitors.

Name: H2O'Brien Pool
Description: H2O'Brien Pool is an outdoor aquatic facility in downtown Parker featuring two 182-foot water slides (with height restrictions of 48" and 52"), a zero-depth entry area with an interactive water play structure, a lap pool, and ample deck seating with shade. Open daily from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. weather permitting (with modified hours in late May, early June, and from mid-August onward), the facility charges admission and offers season passes for residents and non-residents, with discounts available for military and first responders. On weekday mornings, children ages 5 and under can participate in a dedicated "Little Squirts" program from 9 to 10 a.m., while adult lap swim and water exercise sessions run from 8 to 10 a.m. The facility includes a snack bar, restrooms, accessible parking, and permits outside food (excluding glass and alcohol) and Coast Guard-approved flotation devices.
Address: 10795 Victorian Dr Suite A, Parker, CO 80138

Name: Bay Aquatic Park
Description: The Bay Aquatic Park in Broomfield operates seasonally from late May through early September, with two daily sessions (10 a.m.–1:30 p.m. and 2–5:30 p.m.) plus evening family swim sessions on select weekdays. The facility includes two body slides, a leisure pool with race slides and waterfall, an interactive play structure, zero-depth entry, lap lanes, a separate toddler pool with slides, and a sprayground. Admission is $5 for residents and $9 for non-residents ages 4 and up (children 3 and under are free with a paying adult), and session tickets must be pre-purchased online. Amenities include locker rooms, concessions, picnic areas, and accessible parking; the park also offers discounted rates for Broomfield residents with a valid ID.

The facility includes several water slides, a lazy river, an interactive activity pool, a dedicated children's area with a tipping waterfall bucket, and adult hot tubs. Open Wednesday through Thursday 4–9 PM, Friday 4–10 PM, and Saturday–Sunday starting at 9 AM, the waterpark offers arcade tokens, party packages with food options, and cabana rentals for group gatherings. Amenities include restrooms, parking, playground facilities, and concessions, with discounts available for Grand Forks residents.

Day passes cost $6, or $8 with slide access; season passes run $55–$60. The facility includes shaded seating, concessions, restrooms, parking, and picnic areas, with private rentals available by advance booking.

Description: Breaker Bay Waterpark is an indoor water facility at Blue Harbor Resort that maintains a constant 84-degree temperature across its 54,000-square-foot space year-round. The park features The Riptide double surf simulator, Molly's Moat lazy river, Lily Hopper, and an outdoor pool available during summer months, along with concessions at Rocky Bottom Snack Bar and The Sand Bar. Summer hours run daily from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. from June 6 through September 7, while off-season hours vary by day from September through May, with community nights offering discounted passes on Thursdays. Day passes are available on Sundays based on availability, and children under 2 are admitted free with an accompanying adult holding a paid pass.

The facility offers daily admission at $6 for adults and $5 for youth (children under 4 are free), along with membership and punch card options for regular visitors. Swimming lessons are available for ages 6 months and up across multiple session dates throughout the summer, with both group and private instruction options. The center welcomes group reservations on weekdays and provides financial assistance to qualifying Winona County residents.

Name: SandVenture Aquatic Park
Description: SandVenture Aquatic Park in Shakopee features a sand-bottom chlorinated pool with a zero-depth beach entry, making it a unique blend of traditional pool and beach amenities. Water attractions include a 300-foot waterslide, two 12-foot drop slides, a pirate ship jumping platform, shallow-end splash pad features, and water sports like basketball and volleyball. The facility offers free admission and includes changing rooms, lockers, restrooms, a themed playground, parking, and on-site food through a partnership with Tommy's Malt Shop. Special programming includes Tot Time sessions on Friday and Saturday mornings from 9:15–10:45 a.m. (June 12–August 15, 2026) for infants and toddlers ages 0–6, as well as swim lessons throughout the summer.

Name: Land of Make Believe
Description: Land of Make Believe is a longtime amusement park in Hope, New Jersey, offering free admission and featuring rides including a roller coaster and Ferris wheel alongside multiple water-based attractions. The facility provides accessible entrances for guests with mobility needs and includes parking, restrooms, lockers, and baggage storage on-site. Families can take advantage of the on-site restaurant and party services, making it suitable for children's outings and group celebrations.

Name: The Fugitive Beach

The park operates seasonally from Memorial Day through Labor Day, seven days a week, with rental equipment available for solo kayaks, tandem kayaks, solo and family tubes, paddleboards, surfboards, and bodyboards, plus helmet and lifejacket rentals. Onsite amenities include restrooms, changing facilities, a shop with concessions, and shaded viewing areas, along with nearby mountain biking and hiking trails. Participants must be at least 13 years old to operate vessels independently, though younger children may participate with an adult.

Name: DropZone Waterpark
Description: DropZone Waterpark in Perris offers day tickets and season passes, with the option to purchase passes that grant access to both this location and The Cove Waterpark in Riverside. The facility includes picnic areas, a playground, and restrooms for visitor convenience. Beyond general admission, the park offers Red Cross swim lessons for all ages and abilities, a themed summer camp program for children ages 5–12, and junior lifeguard training courses focused on water safety skills.

The facility features a zero-depth entry pool with interactive spray elements, an eight-lane lap pool, a shallow children's pool with a slide, a tube slide leading to a lazy river, and enclosed body slides (42-inch height minimum). General admission is $10, with discounted twilight rates of $8 from 4 to 7 p.m. daily and all day Friday; children under 2 are free. The center includes a snack bar with both sunny and shaded seating, restrooms, family changing rooms, and parking.

Name: Kearney Water Trail
Description: The Kearney Water Trail is a 2.3-mile paddling route through Kearney that features two whitewater features added in 2022, offering a unique water experience in Nebraska. The trail runs from a landing and parking area on the northeast side of Yanney Park to an exit on the west side of Central Avenue, and is accessible to paddlers of all skill levels. Admission is free, and the trail typically operates from April through October. Kayak rentals are available through Kearney Paddle Sports.

The park accommodates groups through advance booking and provides parking, picnic areas, and restroom facilities for day-use visitors. Accessibility features are available to ensure all guests can enjoy their visit.

Description: Mitchell Park Pool operates a splash pad accessible to the public during summer months from noon to 5 p.m. daily with paid pool admission. Description: Boji Splash is an indoor water park located within Bridges Bay Resort in Arnolds Park, offering year-round water play for families. Guest accommodations at the resort include complimentary waterpark wristbands with room stays, ranging from 2 passes for standard hotel rooms to 6 passes for larger condo suites. The facility sits connected to the Trestle hotel building, providing convenient access for resort guests, and the resort offers ample parking and shaded areas throughout the property.

Open daily from 10 AM to 7 PM from late May through early September, the facility charges no admission for Greece residents with valid identification, while non-residents pay $5 per child in cash. The park includes playground equipment, restrooms, parking, and is fully accessible to families with young children.

Description: Sun-N-Fun Lagoon in Naples offers a full-service water park with five slides ranging from 220 to 350 feet in length, including the enclosed Sting Ray and the Sea Lion slide that feeds into a 1,250-foot lazy river. The facility features pools for all ages: Shiro's Lagoon for families, Pirates Cove with interactive pirate-themed elements for children ages 5–12, the Tadpole Pool with 18-inch depth for toddlers, and a Dolphin Dive pool with one- and three-meter diving platforms plus lap lanes. The facility operates daily from 9 AM to 8 PM, though it closes annually from December 15 through March 15 for maintenance. Children under 18 must be supervised by an adult, and all visitors are required to shower before entering the water play area. The unsupervised facility welcomes families and children but enforces strict policies regarding conduct and health standards.

It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. The venue provides free parking and accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments. It features live performances. It is open daily.

Name: Schlitterbahn Waterpark New Braunfels
Description: Schlitterbahn New Braunfels is a large water park featuring multiple distinct sections, each with river rides, pools, and waterslides ranging from gentle to extreme. The park includes attractions such as Wasserbahn Racers, a speed-focused multi-lane slide competition, and Schatze's Storybrook Park, which offers a water coaster designed for children, body slides, over 70 interactive water features, spray toys, and a 1,200-gallon tipping bucket. Each section contains swim-up bars, lazy rivers, and children's areas. On-site lodging is available year-round, with waterpark admission available as part of overnight packages during the operating season.

Description: The Faribault Family Aquatic Center, located within North Alexander Park, features two large flume slides, a drop slide, one-meter diving board, climbing walls, zero-depth entry, lily pad walk, kid elephant slide, interactive water features, water basketball and volleyball, a sand pit play area, dump bucket, kids' splash table, and inflatable features. The facility operates with swim lessons weekday mornings, a dedicated tot swim hour for children up to five years old, and open swim daily from noon to 8 p.m. A concession stand, family changing rooms, restrooms, and parking are available on-site. Admission rates and memberships can be found through the facility's pricing page, with water slide access restricted to children 48 inches or taller.

Name: Hermiston Splashpad
Description: The Butte Splash Pad is a 4,500-square-foot concrete splash area located on the south end of Butte Park, adjacent to Funland Playground and the Bark Park. It features multiple spray jets and was resurfaced in 2022 with improved traction and updated finishes. The pad operates daily from 11 AM to 7 PM between Memorial Day and Labor Day, though it may close due to weather or temperature conditions. The facility includes restrooms, parking, and playground access within the larger park setting.

Name: Wedge Slides

Name: Wild Acadia Camping Resort
Description: Wild Acadia Camping Resort's Funzone is located at a family camping destination near Ellsworth and Acadia National Park in Trenton, Maine. The attraction operates seasonally with weekend hours starting Memorial Day weekend, then daily from mid-June through late August, plus select September dates, with typical hours from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. Water features include two 300-foot waterslides (riders must be at least 45 inches tall), a wading pool with spray ground and dumping bucket, and water balloon catapult stations. Additional on-site activities include jump shot basketball trampolines, a large air-filled jumper, mini-golf, gem mining, and a cafe; registered campers enjoy Funzone access during their stay, while day passes are also available for purchase.

Name: LandzEdge Waterpark at Pleasant Hill Lake Park
Description: LandzEdge Waterpark at Pleasant Hill Lake Park features an inflatable on-the-water obstacle course where visitors can run, jump, bounce, swing, and slide through various challenges. The facility operates seasonally during summer months and is located at a lakeside beach setting in northeastern Ohio. Food and beverages are available on-site, and the park includes standard amenities such as parking, restrooms, and picnic areas to support family visits.

Name: Pecan Valley Resort
Description: Pecan Valley Resort is a water play area in Hurricane, Utah. Admission is free. On-site attractions include a lazy river and a wave pool. On-site amenities include restrooms, an on-site restaurant, an on-site bar, an adjacent playground, Wi-Fi, and party services. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. The venue provides free parking and accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments. It features live performances.

Name: Charlestown Family Activities Park
Description: Charlestown Family Activities Park is a water play area in Charlestown, Indiana. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Freedom Park Splash Park
Description: Freedom Park Splash Park operates daily from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. during the summer season (Memorial Day to Labor Day) and offers free admission to military community members with DOD ID cards and their sponsored guests. The facility features a splash park and playground on Lewis Main near Bowl Arena Lanes and includes on-site restrooms, parking, and playground equipment. The venue may extend hours during extremely warm weather conditions.
Address: 41st Division Dr, Joint Base Lewis-McChord, WA 98433

Name: Northside Family Aquatics Facility
Description: Northside Family Aquatics Facility in Colbert, Washington operates during the summer season from mid-June through mid-August, offering two daily public swim sessions lasting three hours each (11:00am–2:00pm and 2:30pm–5:30pm). Online reservations are available up to two weeks in advance, though walk-up entries are accepted on a limited basis. The facility charges per-entry admission based on age, ranging from free for children under two to $8 for adults, and also offers swim lessons throughout the season and a competitive swim team program. The center provides parking, restrooms, and is fully accessible for visitors of all ages and families.

Name: U.P. Sunrise Cottages
Description: U.P. Sunrise Cottages is a lakefront resort on Farmer Lake in Little Lake, Michigan, featuring nine cottages with included access to an inflatable aquapark, kayaks, stand-up paddleboards, and pedal boats. The property includes a beach, playground with slide and swings, five fire pits, yard games (cornhole, ladderball, tetherball, basketball, pickleball), and a rowboat and canoe. All cottages are pet-friendly and equipped with fully stocked kitchens, grills, decks overlooking the lake, and high-speed internet; additional amenities include a camp store with snacks and ice cream, and optional pontoon rentals. The resort operates year-round and serves as a base for exploring nearby attractions in Marquette and Munising.

Name: Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center
Description: Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center offers free admission and operates Monday through Friday from 5:30 AM to 9 PM, with weekend hours from 7 AM to 5 PM. The facility features Buccaneer Bay, a dedicated water play area, along with lap swim, recreational swim, and water exercise programs throughout the day. The center provides accessible facilities, parking, and restrooms for visitors of all ages. Holiday hours may vary, and the venue notes that pools and waterpark attractions are subject to closure without notice.
Address: 13806 La Mirada Blvd, La Mirada, CA 90638

It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. The venue provides free parking and accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments.

Name: Six Flags Great Escape
Description: Six Flags Great Escape is an amusement park with water attractions in Queensbury, New York. Admission is free. Buying tickets in advance is recommended. On-site attractions include a lazy river, a wave pool, and go-karts. On-site amenities include restrooms, an on-site restaurant, an arcade, picnic areas, lockers, cabana rentals, an on-site bar, an adjacent playground, and Wi-Fi. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. The venue provides free parking and accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments. It features live performances. The venue is described as LGBTQ+ friendly and a transgender safe space.

Description: Great Wolf Lodge | Williamsburg is an indoor water play facility in Williamsburg, Virginia. Admission is free. On-site amenities include shaded seating and Wi-Fi. The venue is described as LGBTQ+ friendly. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Description: Cali Splash Park is an inflatable aquapark located on Castaic Lake, featuring over 45 water obstacles including slides, bouncers, and wiggle bridges. The park operates Wednesday through Sunday with two-hour and full-day session passes available, plus season passes valid through September 28 with no blackout dates. Castaic Lake's surrounding area provides additional amenities such as a swimming beach, barbecue facilities, and boat rentals. Children ages 9 and older may participate without a parent or guardian present, though those under 18 require parental waiver authorization.

Name: Sprayground at Dorbrook Recreation Area
Description: Sprayground at Dorbrook Recreation Area is a water play area in Colts Neck, New Jersey. On-site amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking. The venue provides free parking. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Spray 'n Play
Description: Spray 'n Play is a large interactive water play facility at Mike Rylko Community Park featuring over 20 water toys, sprays, and fountains alongside a picnic area. The facility operates daily from 10 AM to 7 PM between late May and late August, with a 70-degree minimum temperature requirement to open. Admission options include individual visits or discounted Splasher Pass punch cards (20 visits for $80–$100 depending on residency). The venue accommodates groups by reservation, offers private rental times for parties and events, and provides parking, restrooms, and accessibility accommodations.

Name: Apopka Splash Pad
Description: Apopka Splash Pad is located within Kit Land Nelson Park and features multiple water attractions including a large dumping bucket (Mega Soaker), pole-mounted splash buckets (Sneaky Soaker), water cannons (Splash Blasters), a mushroom sprayer for toddlers (Fun-Guy), a water curtain feature (Fun-Brella), and ground-level spray jets (Spray Tunnel). The pad operates seasonally from March through October, with varying hours—generally 10 AM to 5 PM during spring, daily during summer (May 25–August 9), and select days in fall—and entry requires temperatures above 70 degrees. Admission is free for individuals and $2 per person for groups of 10 or more. The facility includes accessible restrooms and a large shade pavilion, accommodates up to 74 people, and offers private rental blocks for groups.
Address: Kit Land Nelson Park, 10 N Forest Ave, Apopka, FL 32703

Name: Peak Health Aquatic Center at Mylan Park
Description: Peak Health Aquatic Center at Mylan Park is a 90,000-square-foot aquatic facility in Morgantown that includes multiple pools and water attractions. The center features a 50-meter Olympic pool with diving well, a community pool with zero-depth entry and water slides, a six-lane lap pool, and an outdoor splash pad. The facility is fully accessible and open daily, with extended hours Monday through Friday (6 AM to 9 PM) and shorter hours on weekends. Parking, restrooms, and multi-purpose rooms available for rent complement the fitness amenities on-site.

Description: Splash Factory is an outdoor water playground at 601 E. Grand Prairie Road featuring age-specific play zones with interactive elements including a water wall, ground sprays, play structures, water guns, spray cannons, power geysers, and six touch-activated buttons. The facility operates from Memorial Day weekend through the summer season, Monday–Thursday 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. and Friday–Sunday 1 p.m. to 6 p.m., with admission at $2 per person. The park uses a recirculation and filtration system to conserve water while maintaining safe play conditions for children of different ages.
Address: 601 E Grand Prairie Rd, Grand Prairie, TX 75051

Name: Waco Surf
Description: Waco Surf is a 450-acre water resort in central Texas featuring a wave pool with multiple skill-level waves (Coaster, Runner, Peak, and advanced options), a standing wave called Shredmill, a waterpark with The Wedge 70-foot waterslide with four levels, kids slides, a splash pool, and a lazy river. The facility operates May 9 through September 13, with weekday hours from noon to 6pm and weekend/holiday hours from 11am to 7pm. Admission is free to the grounds, though surfing lessons and wave sessions have separate pricing starting at $75 per hour. Beyond water activities, the venue offers playgrounds, restrooms, parking, and various outdoor recreation including golf, horseback riding, and a kids club.

The facility also includes a Kraken dry slide and Pirate combo bounce for those preferring non-water activities, with covered cabanas available. Operating year-round weather permitting, hours run 11am–7pm during off-season and 10am–10pm during peak season, with tickets sold on-site. The venue caters to kids, teens, and adults with accessible facilities, parking, and restrooms available.

The venue operates daily weather permitting, with off-season hours from 11 AM to 7 PM and peak season hours from 10 AM to 10 PM year-round. Tickets are sold on-site, and the facility offers covered cabanas with mesh panels, restrooms, playground areas, parking, and accessibility accommodations for visitors of all ages.

Name: The Great Outdoors Waterpark
Description: The Great Outdoors Water Park in Lafayette operates daily from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m. from late May through mid-August, then weekends only through early September, with extended evening hours on select weeknights in summer. The facility features a lazy river, water slides, lap pool, and zero-depth play area with interactive elements including an aqua arch and dumping bucket. Day passes range from $7.50 to $12 depending on age and residency status, with season and punch card options available. Comprehensive amenities include accessible pool entry lifts, restrooms, showers, a snack bar, picnic tables, canopy rentals, lounge chairs, and bike racks, plus a complimentary waterproof wheelchair for guests who need mobility assistance in the water.
Address: 500 E South Boulder Rd, Lafayette, CO 80026

Name: Blue Harbor Resort
Description: Blue Harbor Resort operates an indoor water park called Breaker Bay Waterpark featuring slides, a lazy river, and a surf simulator. The 54,000-square-foot facility is available year-round to resort guests, with day passes offered on Sundays based on availability and community nights on Thursdays from 4–8 pm. Parking is available on-site at this Lake Michigan waterfront resort in Sheboygan, Wisconsin, making it accessible for families with children of all ages.

Name: Washington Park
Description: Washington Park is a water play area in Lexington, North Carolina. On-site amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, barbecue grills, a basketball court, and an adjacent playground. Name: Mirada Lagoon
Description: Mirada Lagoon is a 15-acre water facility in San Antonio, Florida, featuring a kids' splash zone with sprays and jets, a water slide, a floating obstacle course, kayak and paddleboard areas, and a volleyball court. Day admission includes complimentary parking and beach loungers, with optional Splash Pass add-ons required for kayaks, paddleboards, and the obstacle course. The venue opens daily from 4–9 PM, with late-day tickets available after 3 PM, and offers discounts for Florida residents, military, first responders, and other verified groups. Amenities include accessible facilities, restrooms, shaded areas like the Gasparilla zone with tiki huts, a swim-up bar, and cabanas available for rental.

Name: Fort Gordon Outdoor Pool and Spray Park
Description: Fort Gordon's outdoor pool and spray park features 20 water spray elements alongside traditional pool amenities, including a toddler slide, bell-shaped shallow pool with beach entry for young swimmers, and a three-story slide with multiple turns for older kids. The facility also offers two diving boards, shaded tents, a covered dining area, and tiered sun-bathing decks. Open seasonally from late May through early September, the complex welcomes families across all ages with various depth options and play structures.

Description: Worthington Water World is a water park in Worthington, Minnesota. On-site amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It is open daily.

Name: Diggerland USA
Description: Diggerland USA in West Berlin, New Jersey combines a construction-themed amusement park with The Water Main, a water park featuring swimming, soaking, and sliding attractions. During summer months (Memorial Day through Labor Day, weather permitting), guests can enjoy both the theme park and water park with various admission options including daily tickets and season passes. The facility offers free parking, restrooms, playgrounds, and accessible amenities, making it suitable for families and children, with admission-free entry for children under 36 inches tall.

Name: Hamilton-Lowe Aquatics Center
Description: Hamilton-Lowe Aquatics Center in Moscow, Idaho opens June 8, 2026, and features a 25-yard lap pool, tumble buckets, an interactive play structure, a toddler moose slide, tube slides, a mini lazy river, diving board, and water basketball. Daily admission ranges from free for children 3 and under to $8.75 for adults 18–64, with season passes available for residents and non-residents. Open swim operates Monday–Friday 12:00 pm–7:30 pm and Saturday–Sunday 11:00 am–7:30 pm, with dedicated lap swim and adult-only times also scheduled. The facility offers a full-service concession area, picnic tables with barbecue grills, lounge chairs, 20-foot shade umbrellas, free WiFi, and restrooms.
Address: 830 N Mountain View Rd, Moscow, ID 83843

Name: Oak Creek Splash Pad
Description: Oak Creek Splash Pad is a water play area in Oak Creek, Wisconsin. On-site amenities include restrooms, an on-site restaurant, and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. It is open daily.

Description: David F. Schulz Aquatic Center operates seasonally from late June through late August within Lincoln Park, featuring water slides, a lazy river, and additional water attractions. The facility closes on Wednesdays and offers free admission for children under 3 years old. The center provides parking, restrooms, and a snack bar, making it accessible for families and children visiting the public pool.

Description: Bananas Fun Park is a water play area in Grand Junction, Colorado. On-site attractions include mini golf and go-karts. It accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments. It is open daily. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

The facility features a giant inflatable aqua playground, professional instruction from experienced coaches, and equipment rentals available on-site. Open late April through September with extended hours on weekends, the park welcomes walk-ins during operating hours and offers group packages, birthday parties, summer camps for ages 7–15, and private boat lessons on an 80-acre lake. Amenities include accessible facilities, parking, restrooms, a playground, and food service with stone oven pizza and concessions.

The center provides two shade pavilions, shower facilities, deck furniture, and on-site concessions, and is located within Randol Mill Park.

Name: Kings Dominion
Description: Kings Dominion in Doswell includes Soak City, a 20-acre water park featuring water slides, splash pads, a wave pool, and a lazy river. Within Soak City, Coconut Shores offers a mini-wave pool and a 45-foot multi-level interactive play structure with dining options. Admission to the waterpark is included with general Kings Dominion admission. The facility provides parking, accessible amenities, restrooms, and a playground, welcoming families and children of all ages.

Name: Morgan Hill Aquatics Center
Description: Morgan Hill Aquatics Center operates daily from early morning through evening, offering recreational swimming along with lap swimming and aqua fitness classes. Daily admission is $12 for youth ages 2–17 and $15 for adults, with free entry for children under 2 and members. The facility includes a small snack bar, picnic and cabana rental options, an 18-hole mini golf course, and a seasonal inflatable obstacle course available on summer weekends. Free parking is provided in two lots, with restrooms and accessible facilities on-site.

Name: Arizona Grand Resort & Spa
Description: Arizona Grand Resort & Spa operates a 7-acre water park called Oasis year-round with multiple attractions including three 8-story thrill slides (the Free Fall, Roadrunner, and Sidewinder, all requiring 48" height minimum), a zero-entry wave pool with depths from one to five feet, a 25-person hot tub called Caliente Springs, a dual lazy river called Zuni River, and Wild Cat Springs with spray jets designed for younger children. The facility includes an on-site bar and grill, and access is complimentary with resort stays (wristbands distributed at check-in based on room type), while day passes and cabana rentals are available for non-guests through ResortPass on select dates. The property also features six additional resort pools with varying daily operating hours, ample parking, and is located six miles from Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport.

Amenities include a concession stand, picnic tables, BBQ grills, float rentals, a bath house, and lifeguard supervision, with outside food and beverages permitted (alcohol excluded). Name: Bend Whitewater Park
Description: Bend Whitewater Park sits along the Deschutes River north of Colorado Avenue Bridge in central Bend, accessible via pedestrian bridge and viewing areas on both sides of the river. The park is free to visit and open daily from 5 AM to 10 PM, with facilities including restrooms, picnic areas, a playground, and parking options at nearby Park & Float, McKay Park, and other satellite locations. The venue serves as a hub for river recreation, particularly tubing, with shuttle services and rental operations available through Park & Float during summer months (mid-June through early September).

Description: Located within Wooton Park at 306 E. Ruby Street, this free splash pad operates daily from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. year-round, though it may close temporarily due to weather or maintenance. The facility accommodates up to 118 visitors on a first-come, first-served basis and provides parking, restrooms, and accessibility features. Supervision is required for children under 12, proper swimwear is mandatory, and guests must shower before entering the water play area.

Name: Star Plunge
Description: Star Plunge is a historic aquatic facility in Thermopolis featuring both indoor and outdoor heated pools supplied by natural mineral spring water, along with water slides, a vapor cave, and hot tubs. The indoor pool maintains temperatures between 94–98°F, the outdoor pool between 90–94°F, and the hot pool reaches 104°F with therapeutic water and air jets. Additional amenities include a baby pool, fountain waterfall, fitness center, playground, sun decks, and a basketball hoop. On-site amenities include food options at the Lunchbox and Splash Bar, water fountains, accessible restrooms, parking, picnic areas, and transportation services available for guests with mobility needs. The complex opens for the 2026 season on May 23 and operates with scheduled closures during school days, offering concessions and situated within a larger park area that includes Zoo Idaho, playground facilities, and a sand volleyball court. Admission includes regular fees and season pass options, with accessible facilities and parking available on-site.

Parking is available on-site, and the property caters to families, kids, and toddlers seeking a combination of accommodation and water park recreation.

The facility operates from March 20 through October 25 daily from 2–10 PM, with limited weekend-only hours from January through mid-March. Sessions are scheduled at set times and include helmet and life vest rentals; basic rental packages with beginner wakeboards and advanced packages with performance wakeboards are available at varying price points. The park features nearly 40 miles of trails suitable for hikers and bikers, with 13 miles of dedicated trailway connecting the Birch Creek and Nails Creek units, plus opportunities for fishing, boating, paddling, and swimming at designated lake access points. Amenities include restrooms with showers at both main units, pavilions and group halls for gatherings, and both developed campsites with water and electricity as well as primitive camping along the trailway. Kids can participate in Junior Ranger programs with explorer packs and activity journals, and the park offers educational programming for school groups.

Name: Kaweah Whitewater Adventures
Description: Kaweah Whitewater Adventures is a water park in Three Rivers, California. On-site amenities include restrooms and picnic areas. The venue is described as LGBTQ+ friendly and a transgender safe space. The water play is designed for visitors of all ages.

Name: Island MetroPark
Description: Island MetroPark features a sprayground with an interactive water play system located next to the main playground, operating daily from 11 a.m. to 7:45 p.m. during the Memorial Day through Labor Day season. The water play area sits within this riverside MetroPark in Dayton, which also offers picnic shelters, two sets of public restrooms, accessible facilities including ADA-accessible restroom stalls, and ample parking. The park is free to visit and accessible via vehicle, public transit, or along the Great Miami River Trail.

Name: Town Point Park
Description: Town Point Park is a landscaped green space along the river in Norfolk, Virginia, featuring fountains, picnic areas, and an adjacent playground. The park hosts seasonal performances and festivals throughout the year and is open daily with free admission. Amenities include restrooms, wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking, free parking, and dogs are welcome.

Name: Orient Land Trust/Valley View Hot Springs
Description: Valley View Hot Springs features multiple natural hot spring pools across its mountain property near Moffat. Visitors can enjoy three easily accessible lower ponds with body-temperature water (91–97°F) surrounded by rock walls, a historic swimming pool with fresh spring water maintained year-round, and the popular Top Ponds reached by a quarter-mile uphill hike offering valley views. The Apple Tree ponds offer warmer water (102–106°F), and the property includes a unique sauna built over a stream with an integrated cooling tub. The site also provides bathhouses and operates free for families, kids, and toddlers to experience this geothermal landscape.

Name: The Cove Aquatic Center at Fretz
Description: The Cove at Fretz Park is a Dallas aquatic center featuring multiple pools including a dedicated toddler pool, a lazy river, and a main swimming pool with a diving board and slide. The facility offers a climbing wall, water basketball, and a crossing activity, along with amenities including shade structures, picnic tables, parking, restrooms, family changing rooms, outdoor showers, and a concession stand. Admission is free, and the center operates structured programs such as lap swim, water aerobics, swim lessons, and swim team registration throughout the week. The facility is ADA accessible and welcomes families and children of all ages.

Name: Kidd Springs Aquatic Center
Description: Kidd Springs Aquatic Center in Dallas features a swimming pool, toddler pool, slide, diving board, and water basketball court. The facility is ADA accessible and includes amenities such as lounge chairs, shade structures, picnic tables, parking, restrooms, showers, and a concession stand. Programs include water aerobics ($6 per visit), lap swim ($6 per visit), swim team registration ($85 for summer), and swim lessons ($72 for 8 classes) across multiple age levels.

Name: Lake Highlands North Recreation Center
Description: Lake Highlands North Recreation Center occupies 29 acres and includes a dedicated sprayground alongside a fitness center, gymnasium, pool, playground, and various sports courts. The facility offers shaded areas and picnic pavilions, with parking available on-site. The center also operates the Wildcat Fun Zone, an indoor play area with climbing structures and interactive features for children ages 0–5, available during select weekday hours for a small per-visit fee or season pass. Daily operations run from 9 AM to 8 PM.

The center charges $6 per visit for lap swim and water aerobics, with swim lessons available for $72 per 8-class session and team registration at $85 for the summer season. Special events like Cardboard Boat Races are held throughout the year, and season passes are available for frequent visitors.

The playground is free to enter and open daily from 6 AM to 1 AM, making it accessible for families with children of all ages. Parking is limited but the venue is easily reached by subway, bus, bike, or ferry, and the entire park is ADA accessible. Additional amenities throughout the park include picnic tables, bike racks, and nearby restroom facilities.

Description: Red Hook Pool in Brooklyn features an Olympic-size pool and a wading pool, both open daily from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. during the summer season, with a cleaning break from 3 to 4 p.m. The facility is free to use and offers various amenities including complimentary swimming lessons for all ages, lap swimming sessions, and free sunscreen. Free swim diapers are available for babies and toddlers, and the pool hosts special programs for teens, seniors, and visitors with disabilities.

Name: Domino Park

The park features a playground with slides, picnic tables, and a volleyball court, along with cycling lanes and views of the East River. Families can visit daily from 6 AM to 11 PM, and the venue offers wheelchair-accessible parking and entrance. Public restrooms are available on-site, making it a practical option for picnics and birthday gatherings.

It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking, and restrooms. The venue provides free parking and accepts credit cards, debit cards, and mobile payments. It features active-military discounts and live performances. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Whealan Family Aquatic Center
Description: Whealan Pool Aquatic Center, located in Chicago's Edgebrook neighborhood within Caldwell Woods, offers a variety of water attractions including a lap pool, zero-depth leisure pool, water playground, kiddie pool, water climbing wall, and water slides to serve swimmers of all ages and abilities. The facility opens May 24, 2026, at 10 a.m., with varying hours throughout the season. Admission is free, and amenities include changing rooms with showers, free deck chairs, a full-service concession stand, and rentals of cabanas, umbrella chairs, and sun shells. The center also hosts swim lessons (registration opens April 15) and pool parties available in two-hour time slots for $250.

Name: Russellville Aquatic Center
Description: The Russellville Aquatic Center operates year-round and includes a competition pool with diving well, therapy pool, and dedicated splash pad area. Day passes cost $4 for children ages 0–11 and $5 for ages 12 and up, with monthly and annual membership options available starting at $25. The facility offers family swim times after noon on weekdays and from 1–5 PM on Sundays, when the splash pad is open; an inflatable obstacle course is available Friday through Sunday during select hours. Party rentals accommodate groups from 20 to 150 swimmers, and the center accepts multiple insurance programs including Silver Sneakers and Renew Active.

Description: Bricktown Water Taxi operates narrated canal cruises through downtown Oklahoma City's entertainment district, with guided tours lasting approximately 40 minutes that highlight historical monuments, murals, and local landmarks. The venue runs year-round weather permitting, with extended summer hours and departures every 15–20 minutes during peak season; off-season schedules vary based on weather and demand. Pricing is age-based with group discounts available for parties of 50 or more, and advance ticket purchase is recommended as tours often sell out. The operation also offers private charters and dinner cruises for larger groups.
Address: 111 S Mickey Mantle Dr, Oklahoma City, OK 73104

Description: Hansen Dam Aquatic Center features water slides with specific height and age requirements (48 inches tall, 7 years or older) and operates seasonally from late May through September. Admission is affordable and tiered by age, with children and seniors paying $1 and adults $4 (cash only). The facility also offers pedal boat rentals on weekends, and is accessed via Dronfield Avenue from Osborne Street in Lake View Terrace. Restrooms are available on-site for visitors.

The facility operates daily from 8 AM to 9 PM and welcomes families, kids, and toddlers during summer months. In addition to water play, the park provides various recreational amenities for outdoor enjoyment.

The park is open daily from 6 AM, closing at 5 PM on Saturdays and 6 PM on other days.

Description: Occoneechee State Park in Clarksville sits on a 48,000-acre reservoir popular with anglers and boaters, offering picnic areas, a playground, hiking trails, and overnight cabin and campground accommodations. The park's splash pad remains closed for the 2025 season and will reopen Memorial Day weekend 2026. Day-use visitors can access the park daily from 8 a.m. to dusk at no charge, with the visitor center open 8 a.m.–4 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 8 a.m.–8 p.m. Friday–Saturday. Additional facilities include boat rentals, a fuel dock, an amphitheater, and an equestrian campground.

Name: Hope Lake Lodge & Conference Center
Description: Hope Lake Lodge in Cortland offers free access to Cascades Indoor Waterpark as part of its resort amenities for guests staying at the property. The lodge provides family-friendly accommodations including suites with full kitchens and fireplaces, plus access to an outdoor pool and hot tub (seasonal), fitness center, and the Bearfoot Den activity center with crafts and games for children. ADA-accessible rooms are available, and the resort includes complimentary parking, WiFi, and shuttle service to nearby ski slopes during winter months.

Name: Wapelhorst Park
Description: Wapelhorst Park in St. Charles features an aquatic center with a speed slide among its recreation amenities. The park operates seasonally from April 1 through November 14 during daylight to midnight hours, with extended winter hours from November 15 through March 31. Beyond the water facility, the 1875 Muegge Road location offers multiple athletic fields, picnic shelters, a fishing lake, and nature trails suitable for families of all ages.

Name: Blanchette Aquatic Facility
Description: Blanchette Aquatic Facility operates from late May through mid-August, with the main complex open daily from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. The facility includes an open flume slide, enclosed flume slide, drop slide, kiddie pool with attached slides, diving boards, and a climbing wall, with specific height requirements for each attraction. A dedicated Tiny Tot program runs weekday mornings for children six and under, and discounted Family Fun Nights are available Sunday evenings for city residents. Admission requires a City Passport Card or St. Peters Privilege Card for residents, while non-residents must purchase tickets in advance; concessions are available on-site, and children under 12 must be supervised by a guardian 14 or older.

The park itself encompasses Discovery Playground, which opened in 2012, along with paved trails, open lawn areas, wooded sections, and a sledding hill. Located at 2805 Elm Street, the park is part of the City of St. Charles's network of 26 parks and is accessible from dawn to dusk year-round.

Name: Slick City Action Park
Description: Slick City Action Park is an indoor facility in Chesterfield featuring slides exceeding 20 feet tall and inflatable air courts for bouncing activities. The park operates daily from 11 AM to 7:45 PM and welcomes families, kids, and toddlers, with the Junior Jungle area designated for children 3 and under. Special programming includes Little Sliders Club for ages 7 and under ($14.99), Sensory Hours for guests with sensory sensitivities ($19.99), After Hours glow-in-the-dark events ($29.99), and Family Fun Day packages that include food and drinks ($89.99). Admission is non-refundable, and the venue accommodates birthday parties, school field trips, and group events.

Name: Roseville Aquatics Complex
Description: The Roseville Aquatics Complex operates seasonally from late May through early September and hosts recreational swimming, parent-and-tot playtime, swim lessons, and water fitness programs. The facility features a warming pool, lap pool, inflatable obstacle course during recreational swim times, and a spray ground open during summer months. Recreational swim admission is $8 per person, with children under two admitted free, while parent-and-tot playtime costs $5 per adult-child pair. Summer swim passes are available for individuals ($64) and families up to four members ($165), offering season-long access to the complex.

Description: Blairtown Park is a water play area in Rock Springs, Wyoming. On-site amenities include restrooms, picnic areas, barbecue grills, and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances and parking. It is open daily. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Name: Rock Springs Family Recreation Center
Description: Rock Springs Family Recreation Center is a multi-sport indoor facility that includes pools open year-round with a lazy river and Red Cross-certified swimming instruction. The center operates extended hours most weekdays (5 AM–9 PM) and offers admission-based access to its amenities, which also feature racquetball courts, a gym with weights and cardio equipment, basketball courts, and an ice arena operating August through April. Classes in various activities are included free with facility entry, and the venue welcomes families with young children.

The park features accessible play areas with inclusive equipment, restrooms, picnic sites, and plenty of grounds for families to explore alongside the water features. Recently renovated north and south play areas include equipment designed for children of varying abilities, with ADA-compliant accessibility throughout.

Name: Howard Park
Description: Howard Park is a water play area in South Bend, Indiana. Admission is free. On-site amenities include an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily.
Address: 219 S St Louis Blvd, South Bend, IN 46617

Name: O'Brien Park
Description: O'Brien Park is a water play area in South Bend, Indiana. On-site amenities include an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily.
Address: 321 E Walter St, South Bend, IN 46614

Name: Bel-Aire Park
Description: Located off Kentucky Avenue in southern Wayne Township, Bel-Aire Park spans 14.7 acres and features a spray pad alongside other recreational amenities including a basketball court, walking trail, and shelter. The park provides free admission and is open daily from 8 AM to 9 PM, with accessible facilities, parking, restrooms, and a playground available for families and children.

Name: Tarkington Park
Description: Tarkington Park's splash pad operates seasonally, opening in late May through the end of the season, and is located within this north-side Indianapolis community park that also features tennis and basketball courts, a multipurpose field, and a performance shelter. The facility includes restroom access via the Tea's Me Community Café (open Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–3 PM) and offers parking and playground amenities for families and children. The splash pad sits alongside other recreational attractions and is part of a park complex that welcomes visitors during extended hours, including 24-hour access on Saturdays.

Name: Garfield Park
Description: Garfield Park is a 122-acre public park on Indianapolis's near southside that includes an aquatic center where visitors can swim. The park also features a conservatory, sunken gardens, arts center, playground areas, and trails, with free admission and amenities including restrooms and parking. As the city's oldest park, established in 1873, it offers multiple recreational opportunities alongside its aquatic facilities.

Name: Windsor Village Park
Description: Windsor Village Park is a 5-acre community facility in Indianapolis that includes a splash pad alongside a playground, basketball court, pickleball area, indoor gym, and game room. The park operates with varying hours throughout the week, with restrooms, parking, and accessible facilities available. The splash pad provides seasonal water play during warm months, making it a recreational option for families visiting this renovated center that has served the area since its 1953 establishment.

Description: Richmond Hill Park is a water play area in Asheville, North Carolina. Admission is free. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily.

Name: Malvern Hills Park
Description: Malvern Hills Park is a water play area in Asheville, North Carolina. Admission is free. On-site amenities include an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily.

Name: Evergy Plaza
Description: Evergy Plaza is a downtown Topeka community gathering space that includes a splash pad alongside a fountain display, yard games, and a 16-foot fire pit. The plaza operates daily from 7 AM to 10 PM and is free to visit, with amenities including accessible facilities, parking, a playground, and restrooms. Shade pavilions and multiple stages provide spaces for the 200+ annual events and programs hosted throughout the year.

Name: Lorain County Metro Parks
Description: Hollstein Reservation within the Lorain County Metro Parks system features an inclusive playground with a splash pad along with swings, slides, and a fishing pond, designed to accommodate children of all ages and abilities. The 48-acre reservation also includes a walking trail through wooded areas that connects to Beaver Creek, as well as the Amherst HealthPlex, a 50,000-square-foot facility offering aquatic programs and recreational activities for members and non-members. The venue operates Monday through Thursday from 6 a.m. to 8 p.m., Friday 6 a.m. to 5 p.m., Saturday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., and Sunday 11 a.m. to 5 p.m., with accessible facilities, parking, and restrooms available.

Name: Lake Minnetonka Regional Park
Description: Lake Minnetonka Regional Park features a 20,000-square-foot nautical-themed play structure with climbing nets, cargo hold elements, and multiple slides accessible to children of all abilities, plus a chlorinated sandy-bottom swimming pond with a maximum depth of six feet. The park provides changing rooms, a concession stand, and beach umbrellas for swimmers, along with picnic areas, hiking and biking trails, a fishing pier, and a boat launch. Open daily from 6 AM to 10 PM year-round, the park is free to access and includes parking, restrooms, and playground facilities.

Name: Heron Landing Community Park
Description: Heron Landing Community Park spans just over 20 acres in the Anatolia residential community of Rancho Cordova and provides free access to visitors. The park features sports fields with lighting, a playground, restrooms, and parking, alongside areas designed for both active recreation and quiet relaxation. The facility remains open year-round, including major holidays when some amenities at other district parks may have limited hours.

Name: Pat & Jim Brockenborough Rotary Health Park
Description: Pat & Jim Brockenborough Rotary Health Park in Paducah features a free splash pad that operates daily from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. during the 2026 season (May 23 through September, weather dependent). The splash pad uses ground sensors that activate water jets when touched, and is located within a larger health-focused park that also includes a playground, walking path, fitness area, picnic spaces, and restrooms. Children under 10 must be supervised by an adult, and proper swim attire is required.

Name: Neshaminy State Park
Description: Neshaminy State Park spans 339 acres along the Delaware River in lower Bucks County and features a children's spray park separate from its swimming pool. The park offers picnic areas, playground access, restrooms, and parking, along with boating access to the Delaware River at an on-site marina. The spray park and pool operate seasonally with specific hours that vary; contact the park office for exact details. Admission is free and the park is located at the intersection of State Road and Dunksferry Road near the PA 132 exit of I-95.

Name: O'Brien Park
Description: O'Brien Park's splash pad operates daily from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m., starting May 26, 2026, and is free to use. Located within this 140-acre county park in North Tulsa, the splash pad is one of many recreational amenities including baseball fields, disc golf, playgrounds, and walking trails. The park provides restrooms, parking, picnic pavilions with grills, and accessible facilities for families and children.

Name: City of Hurricane - Bridge Park (Upper)
Description: The upper level of Hurricane Bridge Park features the Putnam County Bank Sports Complex with four tournament-ready baseball and softball fields, an all-inclusive playground, and a 36-hole disc golf course. The park is accessible via the main entrance beside First Baptist Church of Hurricane and includes restrooms and parking. Future amenities planned for the site include walking trails, shelters, and an amphitheater.

Name: City of Hurricane - Bridge Park (Lower)
Description: Bridge Park's lower section includes playground equipment, accessible facilities, restrooms, and parking for free daily access from 8 AM to 10 PM. The lower area is situated along the Midland Trail side and provides recreational space for families and children within Hurricane's newest park development.

Name: Bull Run Regional Park
Description: Bull Run Regional Park encompasses 1,500 acres in Centreville, Virginia, and includes Atlantis Waterpark with waterslides as its primary water attraction. The park operates daily from dawn to dusk and is free to enter. Visitors can access picnic areas, shelters, playgrounds, restrooms, parking, and hiking trails throughout the grounds, making it suitable for families with children seeking a full day of outdoor activities.

Name: Ballantrae Community Park & Spray Fountains
Description: Ballantrae Community Park's spray fountains operate seasonally from late May through early September, running daily from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. The spray park currently operates with multiple fountains active, though some features including a waterfall are temporarily offline pending a full modernization project scheduled after the 2026 season. The facility is free to access and situated within a larger community recreation center that offers changing rooms, restrooms, and parking. The park is located at 6350 Woerner Temple Road in Dublin, Ohio.

Name: Hamilton Metz Field
Description: Hamilton Metz Field is a water play area in Brooklyn, New York. On-site amenities include an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily.

Name: LeBauer Park @ Greensboro Downtown Parks, Inc.
Description: LeBauer Park's splash pad operates daily from 10 AM to 8 PM and is free to visit. Located within the larger Greensboro Downtown Parks facility, the splash pad is surrounded by playground equipment, restrooms, parking, and a snack bar, making it accessible for families and children of all ages.

Name: Grand Vue
Description: Grand Vue is a multi-activity park in Moundsville that includes a pool designed for families with children of various ages. The venue offers free admission and features a playground, snack bar, accessible facilities, and parking. Additional attractions on the larger property include mini golf, ziplines, and an aerial adventure course, with shuttle service available around the park and to nearby attractions.

Name: Tooele City Parks & Recreation
Description: Tooele City Parks & Recreation is a water play area in Tooele, Utah. On-site amenities include picnic areas. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances.

Name: 95th Street Community Plaza
Description: 95th Street Community Plaza features a free splash pad that operates daily from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. between Memorial Day weekend and Labor Day. The splash pad uses a push-button system with zoned features that cycle through different elements rather than running all at once. Located adjacent to the 95th Street Library at the Frontier Sports Complex, the facility also offers playgrounds, restrooms, parking, and an AED on-site, welcoming families and children of all ages.

Name: Kiwanis Family Park
Description: Kiwanis Family Park in Sanford features the city's only splash pad, which operates seasonally from mid-May through late September with varying daily hours depending on the school calendar. The splash pad is free and includes seating areas with benches, picnic tables, and shaded grass space for visitors. The park also offers an accessible playground with inclusive play equipment, a half-mile paved walking loop, two picnic shelters, restrooms, and parking. Water shoes are encouraged, and children not yet toilet-trained must wear swim diapers.

Name: Bertha Ross Park
Description: Bertha Ross Park is a 15-acre Indianapolis venue featuring a splash pad along with playground equipment, basketball courts, picnic shelters, and restroom facilities. The park operates daily from 8 AM to 9 PM and welcomes families and children seeking water play and recreational activities. Parking is available on-site, and the grounds include shaded, wooded areas alongside open play spaces.

Name: Andrew Ramsey Park
Description: Andrew Ramsey Park is a 2-acre neighborhood facility in the Butler Tarkington area that features a splash pad that opened in summer 2024, along with a playground, picnic tables, and a covered shelter. The park operates daily from 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. and is free to visit, making it an accessible option for families with children seeking water play and outdoor recreation.

Name: Prophetstown State Park
Description: Prophetstown State Park's Aquatic Center operates seasonally from Memorial Day through Labor Day, with hours from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m., though it reduces to weekends only starting mid-August. Admission is $5 per person, with free entry for children age three and younger. The park itself, open daily from 7 a.m. to 11 p.m., offers picnic areas, accessible scenic viewpoints, restrooms, parking, and hiking trails in addition to the aquatic facility. Note that mapping services often provide incorrect directions; visitors should use Exit 178/S.R. 43 north of Lafayette to reach the park.
Address: Park Entrance: 5545 Swisher Road Office:, 4112 IN-225, West Lafayette, IN 47906

Name: South Abington Community Park
Description: South Abington Community Park, located at 642 Northern Boulevard adjacent to South Abington Elementary School, operates its splash park during summer months (weather permitting). The park includes a children's playground, walking trail with covered bridges, basketball courts, picnic pavilion available on a first-come, first-serve basis, accessible restrooms, and parking. The full park grounds are open from dawn through 11 PM daily and admission is free.
Address: 642 Northern Blvd, South Abington Township, PA 18411

Name: Fairview Park
Description: Fairview Park in Bridgeville includes a splash pad within its larger recreational grounds, along with accessible parking, restrooms (both permanent and portable facilities), and multiple playgrounds designed for different age groups. The park offers picnic areas, pavilions available for rental, sports courts and fields, trails, and green space, making it a multi-use community facility suitable for families with children.
Address: Fairview Park, 288 Recreation Rd, Bridgeville, PA 15017

Name: Little Tallapoosa Park
Description: Little Tallapoosa Park's splash pad operates seasonally from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day, open daily from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., and is available on a first-come, first-served basis or can be reserved as part of a pavilion rental. Located within a 330-acre county park in Carrollton that also features trails, fishing ponds, campsites, and picnic facilities, the splash area welcomes day visitors for a $5 per vehicle parking fee. Restrooms, parking, and playground amenities are available throughout the park, making it accessible for families with children.

Name: South County Regional Park
Description: South County Regional Park in Punta Gorda spans 84 acres and includes a splash pad alongside an 8-lane heated competition pool with a separate dive well, shallow play area for children, and a 1-meter diving board. The 84-acre facility offers a shaded playground, picnic pavilion, and concession stand, with parking and accessible amenities including a wheelchair ramp at the diving well. The park operates weekdays from 6:30 AM to 8 PM and weekends from 10 AM to 7 PM.

Name: Windber Recreation Park and Pool
Description: Windber Recreation Park features a public swimming pool open daily from noon to 7 PM with free admission. The facility includes a playground, walking trail, tennis courts, basketball courts, volleyball courts, and a skate park, along with restrooms and picnic areas. The grounds accommodate summer day camps and host community events throughout the year. Parking and accessibility accommodations are available on-site.

Name: Pleasanton River Park
Description: Pleasanton River Park features a splash pad along with a skate park, playground, and exercise area, all equipped with new lighting for evening use. The facility includes restrooms, a pavilion, parking, and walking trails throughout the grounds. Open daily from 6 AM to 10 PM with free admission, the park welcomes families and children to enjoy its various recreational amenities.

Name: Legion Field
Description: Legion Field in Pensacola features a splash pad that operates seasonally from mid-March through October, daily from 9 a.m. to 7 p.m. The pad uses water-conservation technology with a button-activated system that runs for 15 minutes when triggered. Located at the corner of West Gregory and North G Street, the facility also includes a playground, athletic fields, a fitness court, walking trails with solar lighting, covered shelter, and is adjacent to the West Florida Public Library's Westside Branch. The venue offers parking, restrooms, and accessibility amenities for families and children.

Name: Highland Road Community Park
Description: Highland Road Community Park in southeastern Baton Rouge includes a splash pad alongside extensive recreational facilities like tennis courts, disc golf, and a recreation center. The park operates Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 10 PM, and Saturday–Sunday from 8 AM to 6 PM, with parking, restrooms, and a playground available. A covered pavilion with seating for up to 65 people can be rented for events, and an air-conditioned recreation center serves as an additional gathering space.

Name: Forest Community Park
Description: Forest Community Park features a splash pad with interactive spray jets activated by a push button, designed as a water play area with no standing water that cycles on for 2–3 minutes per activation. Located in the southeastern part of East Baton Rouge Parish, this community park also offers a playground, restrooms, parking, walking trails, pavilions available for rent, and a recreation center. The park operates daily from 6:30 AM to 7:30 PM and is designed to accommodate families and children for extended outdoor recreation.
Address: 13900 South Harrell, 13900 S Harrells Ferry Rd, Baton Rouge, LA 70816

Name: Old Settlers Park
Description: Old Settlers Park in McKinney offers free, year-round access to playground equipment designed for multiple age groups, along with basketball courts and covered pavilion space. The park provides parking and restroom facilities, with nearby access to the Gilda Garcia Garza Aquatic Center and the Old Settlers Recreation Center. Open daily from 5:30 AM to 9 PM, the park combines recreational features with inclusive play elements suitable for families and children of varying abilities.

Name: Al Ruschhaupt Soccer Complex
Description: Al Ruschhaupt Soccer Complex operates two phases in McKinney with splash pad water play available at Phase II, along with additional amenities including a playground, lit multi-use practice fields, and a trail. The facility is accessible and free to use daily from 5:30 AM to 11 PM, with parking, restrooms, BBQ grills, shade trees, and a concession facility on-site. Phase II also features inclusive play elements and swings, while both locations are equipped with AEDs and lightning detection systems for safety.

Name: Al Ruschhaupt Soccer Complex Phase 1
Description: Al Ruschhaupt Soccer Complex Phase 1 is a water play area in McKinney, Texas. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily. It includes gentler water features suited to toddlers.

Description: St. Catherine's Park is a water play area in New York, New York. On-site amenities include an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily.

Description: Sherman Creek Waterfront Parks is a water play area in New York, New York. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances.

Name: Gatton Park on the Town Branch
Description: Gatton Park on the Town Branch is a water play area in Lexington, Kentucky. Admission is free. On-site amenities include an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily.

Name: Comiskey Park
Description: Comiskey Park in Dubuque features a splash pad alongside a playground, basketball courts, tennis court, skate park, and sports fields. The park operates daily from 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. from the first Saturday in May through the fourth Sunday in October. Visitors will find shaded picnic shelters, restrooms, parking, and accessible facilities throughout the grounds. The splash pad was completed as part of Phase 1 improvements in 2023, developed with community input on equipment design.

Name: Look Memorial Park
Description: Look Memorial Park is a water play area in Florence, Massachusetts. Admission is free. On-site amenities include an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances.

Description: Huset Park is a water play area in Columbia Heights, Minnesota. Admission is free. On-site amenities include an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily.

Name: Sixteen Sycamores Playground
Description: Sixteen Sycamores Playground is a water play area in Brooklyn, New York. On-site amenities include an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily.

Name: ArtsPark at Young Circle
Description: ArtsPark at Young Circle is a 10-acre community arts venue in downtown Hollywood featuring a splash pad alongside a playground, making it a destination for water play and recreation. The splash pad is noted as one of the park's most popular attractions, drawing families to the free facility that operates daily from early morning to late evening. Located at US 1 and Hollywood Boulevard, the park provides restrooms, picnic areas, parking, and open green spaces for visitors.

Name: Mountainside Park
Description: Mountainside Park is a water play area in Asheville, North Carolina. On-site amenities include shaded seating and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily.

Name: Crater of Diamonds State Park
Description: Crater of Diamonds State Park is home to Diamond Springs Water Park, a seasonal water facility open from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day with certified lifeguards on duty. Admission varies by height, with children under 42 inches paying $10 and those 42 inches and taller paying $12, while family season passes are available for $230. The water park serves as a refreshing break from the park's main attraction—a 37-acre diamond search field where visitors can hunt for natural gemstones and minerals to keep. The park provides restrooms, picnic areas, accessible facilities, parking, and a playground, along with equipment rentals and a visitor center with educational exhibits.

Name: Watercrest Park
Description: Watercrest Park in Ankeny offers a mix of recreational amenities including a playground, basketball court, and walking/biking trails alongside picnic facilities and baby swings. The park provides parking and features picnic shelters and tables, making it suitable for families and young children. Located at 2500 block of NW 43rd Street, the park is accessible during daylight and evening hours daily.

Name: Forsyth Park
Description: Forsyth Park is a water play area in Savannah, Georgia. Admission is free. On-site amenities include an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily.

Name: Gipson Play Plaza
Description: Gipson Play Plaza is a free 18.5-acre recreational facility within Dix Park featuring Watermill Mountain, a waterfall, and splash pad that open daily at 10:00 am. The splash pad operates alongside multiple accessible playgrounds including Slide Valley, Sand Bowl, Sensory Maze, and Swing Terrace, with wheelchair-accessible routes, transfer platforms for slides, and nest swings. Amenities include a centrally-located restroom building with changing cabanas, private shower, outdoor shower, picnic areas with grills, and concessions at the House of Many Porches Market, with free parking available throughout the park.

Name: Pullen Park
Description: Pullen Park is a 66.4-acre public park in Raleigh with an aquatic center, playground, and multiple recreational facilities. The park offers free admission and includes parking, restrooms, and accessibility features for visitors of all ages. In addition to water amenities, the park features pedal boats, a carousel, sports courts, an arts center, and a theater, making it a multi-purpose community destination.

Name: Robert F. Clement Park
Description: Robert F. Clement Park in Littleton spans 60 acres and includes a splash park alongside athletic facilities, playgrounds, and a reservoir. The splash park area offers shelters available for reservation and sits within a larger park that features an inclusive playground, picnic areas, restrooms, and lighted trails. Admission to the park is free, and it operates daily from 5 AM to 10 PM with accessible facilities and ample parking available.

Name: Thomas A. Cloud Memorial Park
Description: Thomas A. Cloud Memorial Park is a 124-acre facility in Huber Heights featuring a seasonal splash pad that operates from Memorial Day through Labor Day at no cost. The splash pad is one of numerous amenities within the park, which also includes a playground, walking trails, sports courts and fields, picnic shelters available for rental, and ADA-accessible facilities including restrooms and parking.

Name: Sycamore Valley Park
Description: Sycamore Valley Park in Danville features a children's water play area with an interactive fountain and water structures that operate seasonally from April through September. The water features run weekdays from noon to 6 p.m. and weekends from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m., weather permitting. Beyond water play, the park includes a playground with slides, swings, and climbers, plus picnic areas with tables and grills, shade structures, and a jogging path. The park is free to visit and open daily during daylight hours, with parking and restrooms available on-site.

Name: Hap Magee Ranch Park
Description: Hap Magee Ranch Park features a water play area with metal tube tunnels that spray water as children run through them, plus ground-level water jets activated by motion sensors. The water features operate seasonally from April through September, with weekday hours from noon to 6 p.m. and weekend hours from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. Located on 17 acres in Danville, the park also includes separate playgrounds for different age groups, walking trails, picnic areas, restrooms, parking, and a dog park.

Name: Hartshorne Woods Park
Description: Hartshorne Woods Park is a water play area in Highlands, New Jersey. Admission is free. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily.

Name: St. Vartan Park
Description: St. Vartan Park is Murray Hill's largest playground, featuring multiple play structures and open areas shaded by mature trees. The park includes asphalt fields on its western side and a field house with occasional programming near First Avenue. It offers free admission and operates daily from 6 AM to 11 PM, with restrooms, parking, and playground equipment available for families and children of all ages.
Address: 1st Avenue &, E 35th St, New York, NY 10016

Name: Washington Park
Description: Washington Park is a water play area in Cincinnati, Ohio. Admission is free. On-site amenities include an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily.

Name: North Sherwood Forest Community Park
Description: North Sherwood Forest Community Park in Baton Rouge features a spray pad alongside numerous other recreational amenities including playgrounds, outdoor basketball and tennis courts, fishing access to a 3-acre lake, and indoor fitness facilities. The community park includes restrooms, parking, and pavilion rental options, making it suitable for families spending an extended day at the facility. Located in the northern portion of East Baton Rouge Parish, the park occupies land that was historically part of a World War II federal depot before being transferred to BREC for public recreation.
Address: 3140 N Sherwood Forest Dr, Baton Rouge, LA 70814

Name: Greenwood Community Park
Description: Greenwood Community Park in Baker features a splash pad with interactive spray jets activated by yellow poles that run for 2–3 minutes per activation. The splash pad operates daily from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. during the operating season. The facility also includes a playground with shade and picnic areas, restrooms, and parking, making it suitable for families with children.

Name: Dorbrook Recreation Area
Description: Dorbrook Recreation Area is a water play area in Colts Neck, New Jersey. Admission is free. On-site amenities include picnic areas and an adjacent playground. It offers wheelchair-accessible entrances. It is open daily.

Name: Cleveland Public Square
Description: Cleveland Public Square's splash pad operates daily from May through September as part of this 10-acre downtown park. The splash pad is one of several recreational amenities at the square, which also includes an expansive lawn, café, restrooms with a changing station, and WiFi access. The park itself is open from 5 AM to midnight daily.

Name: Sooner Park
Description: Sooner Park's splash pad sits within a 53-acre community park at 420 SE Madison Boulevard and features a dedicated play area with water spray elements. The facility operates daily with round-the-clock access and includes restrooms, parking, playgrounds, and accessibility accommodations. The splash pad complements the park's Olympic-sized swimming pool and a 40-foot slide tower added in 2022, which offers three distinct slides of varying speeds for different thrill levels. Picnic tables, pavilions, and shade areas throughout the grounds support extended family visits during warm-weather months.

Name: Barnett Field Splash Pad
Description: Barnett Field Splash Pad in Edmond offers free admission and operates daily from 9:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. during the season from Memorial Day Weekend through Labor Day. The facility provides off-street parking and on-site restrooms for visitor convenience. Children 12 and under require supervision by an adult aged 18 or older, and the pad is maintained as an unsupervised play area where visitors use the facilities at their own risk.
Address: N Kelly Ave &, W Main St, Edmond, OK 73003

Name: Center Park At Centerville
Description: Center Park at Centerville features a splash pad alongside a playground, picnic pavilion, and restroom facilities in an open green space at the corner of North Houston Lake Boulevard and Gunn Road. The splash pad operates seasonally from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. daily and closes after Labor Day. The park also hosts regular community events including Food Truck Friday, farmers markets, and seasonal celebrations.
